jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Associate
jobs.excerpt: About FassetFasset is an American founded banking and investment platform focused on enhancing financial inclusion in emerging markets, enabling individuals and businesses to securely invest from anywhere in the world.
jobs.description:
About Fasset

Fasset is an American founded banking and investment platform focused on enhancing financial inclusion in emerging markets, enabling individuals and businesses to securely invest from anywhere in the world. Founded by Mohammad Raafi Hossain and Daniel Ahmed, Fasset has raised more than $80 million in funding and holds regulatory approvals in several countries, including the UAE, Indonesia, Malaysia, the EU, Türkiye, Pakistan, and others.

About the Role

We're looking for a Retention and Lifecycle Marketing Associate to focus on churn reduction, and increase repeat usage and transactions across our user base. This role directly impacts unit economics and makes our acquisition spend work harder, by ensuring the users we bring in stick around and keep coming back. You'll lead the rollout of our new CRM, design and implement lifecycle journeys, and run ongoing campaigns that keep users engaged at every stage.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the rollout and setup of the new CRM platform, including workflows, segmentation, and integrations
  • Design and implement lifecycle marketing journeys across onboarding, activation, engagement, and win-back stages
  • Build and execute retention campaigns (email, push, SMS, in-app) targeted at reducing churn and driving repeat transactions
  • Segment users based on behavior, value, and lifecycle stage to personalize messaging and offers
  • Track and report on retention metrics, including churn rate, repeat usage, and campaign performance
  • Partner with Performance Marketing to ensure newly acquired users are onboarded into strong lifecycle journeys
  • Collaborate with Product to identify friction points and opportunities to improve user engagement
  • Continuously test and optimize messaging, timing, and channels to improve retention outcomes

What We're Looking For

  • 3-5 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or retention marketing
  • Hands-on experience setting up or managing a CRM platform (e.g. MoEngage, Braze, CleverTap or similar)
  • Strong understanding of lifecycle marketing principles, including segmentation and journey design
  • Analytical mindset, comfortable tracking churn, repeat usage, and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience running multi-channel campaigns (email, push, SMS, in-app)
  • Experience with A/B testing frameworks within CRM platforms
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Product and Performance Marketing
  • Detail-oriented and organized, able to manage multiple concurrent journeys and campaigns

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, consumer apps, or high-growth startups
  • Basic SQL or data analysis skills for deeper segmentation and reporting

You'll Thrive Here If You Lead with HEART

  • Humble Curiosity: you dig into why users churn or come back, testing new journeys and learning from what the data tells you rather than relying on assumptions
  • Enthusiasm: you bring energy to the details of lifecycle marketing, because you know a well-timed message can be the difference between a user staying or leaving
  • Act Like Owners: you treat retention and churn numbers like your own scoreboard, proactively flagging risks and opportunities rather than waiting to be asked
  • Raise the Bar: you sweat the details of segmentation, timing, and messaging, because you know that precision is what makes lifecycle marketing actually work
  • Tenacity: you keep testing and refining journeys even when early results are mixed, because you know retention gains build over time

jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Technical Product Experience Specialist to ensure Military Community and Family Policy (MC&FP) products are useful, usable, feasible, accessible, testable, and aligned to the intended experience before they move through delivery. The role supports the Service Design & Experience team under the MODES III contract. This role serves as a critical integration point between user and service experience strategy and technical product delivery, helping translate research, design intent, stakeholder needs, and business requirements into actionable product requirements and measurable digital experiences.

Working under the Strategic Design and Experience Lead (SDEL), the Technical Product Experience Specialist collaborates across Task 2 Outreach and Engagement and Task 3 IT, Cybersecurity, and Data Operations to maintain alignment between experience objectives and technical execution. The role works closely with UX researchers and designers, experience strategists, architects, product and development teams, QA/test personnel, data and analytics teams, and Government stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle.

The Technical Product Experience Specialist supports product visioning and roadmapping, requirements definition, backlog refinement, user stories and acceptance criteria, design-to-development handoffs, release readiness, and post-release evaluation. The role brings sufficient technical experience to understand software delivery, system dependencies, integration considerations, and implementation tradeoffs while maintaining a strong focus on user needs and desired experience outcomes.

Accessibility and inclusive design are embedded throughout this role. The Technical Product Experience Manager ensures Section 508, WCAG, usability, responsive design, and other experience-quality requirements are incorporated early into product definition and acceptance criteria rather than treated solely as downstream compliance activities.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Serve as a product management and technical integration resource within the Service Design & Experience team, supporting the SDEL in translating experience strategy and design intent into executable digital product requirements.
  • Bridge Task 2 experience, research, content, and engagement activities with Task 3 product, application development, architecture, data, CMS, API, DevSecOps, QA/testing, and other technical capabilities.
  • Translate user research, journey maps, service-design findings, analytics, stakeholder requirements, and strategic objectives into clear product requirements, capabilities, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable experience outcomes.
  • Support product visioning and develop and maintain experience-oriented product roadmaps aligned with MC&FP strategic goals, user needs, technical dependencies, and delivery priorities.
  • Partner with Task 3 product management and development teams to refine and prioritize feature and enhancement backlogs while maintaining traceability to user needs and intended experience outcomes.
  • Participate in Agile planning, backlog refinement, sprint planning, design reviews, demonstrations, release planning, and retrospectives to maintain alignment between design intent and technical implementation.
  • Establish and document experience acceptance criteria addressing usability, accessibility, responsive behavior, interaction design, content experience, and other applicable design and experience standards.
  • Partner with UX researchers, designers, experience strategists, and technical teams to translate prototypes, user flows, information architecture, interaction models, and other design artifacts into implementation-ready requirements.
  • Evaluate technical feasibility, system dependencies, integration considerations, and implementation constraints in partnership with architects, engineers, developers, cybersecurity, and other technical SMEs.
  • Identify and communicate tradeoffs among user needs, business and mission requirements, accessibility, technical feasibility, security and privacy considerations, delivery constraints, and desired experience outcomes.
  • Support design-to-engineering handoffs and maintain traceability between approved experience designs, product requirements, implementation decisions, and delivered functionality.
  • Participate in product demonstrations and design acceptance reviews to evaluate whether implemented functionality reflects approved experience intent and documented acceptance criteria.
  • Ensure Section 508 and WCAG requirements are incorporated throughout product planning, design, development, testing, and release activities, coordinating with designers and QA/508/test personnel as appropriate.
  • Collaborate with usability and QA/test teams to validate product functionality, experience quality, accessibility, and conformance with documented requirements before release.
  • Use user feedback, usability findings, product analytics, digital performance measures, customer-support insights, and other available data to identify opportunities for product optimization and continuous improvement.
  • Maintain product and experience documentation needed to support decision-making, requirements traceability, knowledge transfer, and continuity across Task 2 and Task 3 teams.
  • Provide the SDEL with clear assessments of product status, experience risks, unresolved design or implementation decisions, and issues requiring design-authority direction.

Qualifications

Clearance Requirement

Candidate must possess an active Secret clearance or higher.

Education (Required)

Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Digital Arts, or a related field.

Experience (Required)

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience supporting digital product management, product design, UX, service design, or digital experience initiatives, including experience translating user and business needs into requirements for technical delivery.
  • Experience applying Section 508 and WCAG standards to digital experiences.
  • Experience integrating accessibility early in design and development workflows.
  • Experience supporting federal or public-sector digital platforms preferred.

Technical Knowledge

Required:

  • Expertise in Section 508 and WCAG accessibility standards.
  • Knowledge of inclusive and accessible design methodologies.
  • Ability to evaluate designs, interfaces, and content for accessibility.
  • Strong documentation and guidance development skills.
  • Experience working directly with software development, engineering, architecture, QA/testing, or DevSecOps teams in Agile or iterative digital delivery environments.

Preferred:

  • Experience with accessibility testing tools.
  • Familiarity with UX, design systems, and digital platforms.
  • Experience working in Agile or iterative delivery environments.
  • Experience working with analytics and product-performance measures.
  • Understanding of DevSecOps/software delivery to participate credibly in technical planning and tradeoff discussions.

Certifications

Required:

  • Section 508 or WCAG certification

Preferred:

  • Additional certifications in accessibility or inclusive design
  • SAFe POPM or related agile-based certification

Skills

  • Strong advocacy for inclusive and accessible design.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
  • Attention to detail and compliance accuracy.
  • Ability to collaborate across design and development teams.
  • Ability to identify accessibility risks early and proactively.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.

jobs.description:
Product Researcher

Pathstream | Product & Design | Remote

ROLE / DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW

Pathstream is seeking a Product Researcher to uncover insights that help us improve our product, expand our business, and progress towards our mission. This role will sit within our Product & Design department and will work closely with product managers, designers, and teams across the company.

We believe that building a successful product and business today requires being highly intentional about understanding our clients and users and how we can best serve them. This role will drive that forward and thus empower all of the teams building the product at Pathstream.

WHAT WE DO

Pathstream was founded on the premise that substantial unrealized economic and human potential exists within each organization's frontline workforce. We are reshaping the way employees and managers on the frontlines excel in their careers. In this age of rapid tech evolution, our enterprise partnerships transform frontline teams from transactional to relational, and from task-oriented to strategic.

We impact companies' bottom lines with improved productivity, increased retention, and differentiated quality of customer experience — while employees experience greater success in their current roles and unlock future professional growth.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

The Product Researcher role will work cross-functionally to build our knowledge about our market, users, and more.

As Product Researcher, you'll be accountable for building and maintaining our pipeline of subject matter expert advisors, running a variety of research studies that inform product and curriculum decisions (ranging from landscape scans to usability tests), and keeping our research operations organized so that findings are accessible to the team.

You'll work with our Product and Design teams to ground feature decisions in real user behavior, running studies that inform what gets built and validating it once it ships. You’ll also work with our Learning Experience Design team to help ensure courses teach the skills that matter to our clients, translating research findings into curriculum priorities. You’ll also support our GTM teams to surface intel that will help diagnose client needs and address pain points.

RESEARCH AND ANALYSIS

  • Plan, conduct, and synthesize research, including:
    • Support early stage exploration of new product areas to understand the key pain points/opportunity areas among our users.
    • Run usability testing on product features before release, identifying areas for improvement to the user experience.
    • Support early stage exploration of new industries

DATA ANALYST/PROGRAMMER

Department: Implementation Services

Reports to: Manager of Data Operations

Division: Remote

JOB SUMMARY

The Data Analyst/Programmer will work closely with Project Managers, Implementation Specialists, and, when needed, clients to ensure the effective extraction, transformation, and loading of complex datasets from legacy systems into Milsoft software solutions, maintaining data integrity and seamless migrations with minimal downtime.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  1. Designs, develops, tests, and executes scripts to extract data from various source systems, transform it according to business logic, and load it into target databases within project timelines.
  2. Analyzes source data structures, field mappings, and legacy databases to identify data quality issues, missing fields, or potential conversion bottlenecks.
  3. Collaborates with business analysts and clients to define data mapping rules and runs validation scripts to verify completeness and accuracy pre- and post-migration.
  4. Writes scalable scripts and automated tools to streamline repeatable migration processes and reduce manual intervention.
  5. Maintains documentation of data conversion routines, mapping logic, and exception-handling procedures, and produces post-conversion reconciliation reports.
  6. Efficiently diagnoses and resolves complex data discrepancies, transformation errors, and performance issues during testing and production cutovers.
  7. Upholds, safeguards, and promotes Milsoft’s values and philosophy regarding ethics, integrity, and corporate responsibility.
  8. Maintains regular, consistent, and professional attendance, punctuality, personal appearance, and adherence to relevant health and safety procedures.
  9. Any other duties that may be necessary or assigned occasionally.

QUALIFICATIONS

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or equivalent hands-on experience.
  2. Advanced scripting abilities in languages such as Python for data parsing and file manipulation.
  3. Proficiency in writing complex SQL queries, stored procedures, joins, and indexing (e.g., PostgreSQL, SQL Server).
  4. Experience working with diverse file formats, including JSON, XML, CSV, fixed-width files, and relational database dumps.
  5. Experience building, running, and/or maintaining ETL pipelines is desirable.
  6. Excellent interpersonal, problem-solving, and communication skills to translate complex data mapping challenges into simple terms for non-technical stakeholders.

jobs.description:
The Senior People Operations Analyst will join Dorado Software Group as the operational lead for HR systems, data integrity, and global payroll coordination. This is a 12-month fixed-term contract to support our People function across NedGraphics and Optitex (18 countries: North America, South America, EMEA, Middle East, India, APAC). You'll report to the Director of People Operations.
This role requires someone who proactively identifies and flags data issues, process gaps, and compliance risks before they escalate. You will be the single point of accountability for BambooHR data accuracy, multi-jurisdiction payroll coordination, and onboarding/offboarding execution. The previous analyst in this role was let go after not proactively flagging data integrity issues; this role succeeds by catching problems early and escalating thoughtfully.

Why This Contract Is 12 Months
This role is backfilling for a strategic People Operations rebuild. We need an experienced analyst to stabilize our HRIS and payroll operations, document all processes, and set up the infrastructure for scaling. After 12 months, we'll evaluate next steps based on business needs and your interest.

This is a real operational role, not a stepping stone. We're looking for someone committed to leaving the function stronger and more documented than they found it.

Key Responsibilities

HRIS Administration and Data Integrity
  • Maintain all employee data in BambooHR with accuracy, including new hires, terminations, status changes, compensation updates, and reporting structure changes.
  • Conduct regular data audits to identify and correct inconsistencies, duplicates, and gaps; consolidate employee information from scattered sources into BambooHR as the single source of truth.
  • Ensure accurate data flows between BambooHR, Pinpoint (ATS), and Lattice (performance); maintain employee files in compliance with applicable regulations.
  • Handle all employee data in accordance with applicable privacy legislation across jurisdictions, including applicable Canadian and US state privacy laws, and international equivalents; ensure personal data is collected, stored, and processed lawfully and with appropriate access controls.
  • Identify process inefficiencies that create data risk (e.g., manual data entry steps, system gaps, spreadsheet workarounds) and propose fixes.
Payroll and Benefits Coordination
  • Execute payroll coordination across all jurisdictions by following established processes - preparing and submitting people data to Finance, third-party payroll providers, and employer of record (EOR) partners across North America, South America, EMEA, the Middle East, India, and APAC (new hires, terminations, compensation changes, bonuses, and stipends)
  • Reconcile against BambooHR records and flag discrepancies to the Director for resolution
  • Serve as the first point of contact for routine employee payroll and benefits questions, escalating anything outside standard parameters
Onboarding and Offboarding
  • Execute end-to-end onboarding for all new hires, including system setup, background checks, benefits enrollment, orientation scheduling, and equipment coordination with IT
  • Process employee terminations, including system updates, final pay calculations, applicable federal and provincial/state separation requirements, and exit logistics
  • Maintain and track onboarding plans with hiring managers; continuously improve onboarding and offboarding checklists based on feedback
Recruitment Administration
  • Administer Pinpoint ATS, including job postings, candidate pipeline management, interview scheduling, and coordination with hiring managers and external recruiters
  • Send offer letters and process pre-hire documentation; maintain recruitment dashboards and report on pipeline metrics including time-to-fill, source effectiveness, and candidate volume
Compensation Data Support
  • Maintain compensation data in auditable spreadsheets and systems; support the Director during annual compensation and performance review cycles with data, reporting, and administrative execution
AI Tools and Process Automation
  • Use AI-powered tools and agents to streamline repetitive HR tasks such as data validation, document drafting, employee query triage, and report generation
  • Identify process inefficiencies and propose improvements, leveraging AI automation, system features, formulas, and workflow tools to reduce manual effort
  • Support the Director in evaluating and rolling out new AI tools within the People technology stack
Process Documentation and Improvement
  • Document all repeatable HR processes as clear, step-by-step SOPs; maintain the internal HR knowledge base so that processes are not dependent on any single person
Reporting and Dashboards
  • Build and maintain reporting dashboards in Excel, BambooHR, and other tools covering headcount, turnover, time-to-fill, and compensation distribution; prepare ad hoc reports for leadership as requested
  • Use AI-assisted analytics and visualization tools to improve the speed and quality of people reporting
Travel
  • Travel to offices in other international locations to provide HR support as necessary or to attend events

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

REQUIRED:
  • 6+ years of hands-on HRIS administration and payroll coordination experience.
  • Direct, recent experience with BambooHR.
  • Proven experience coordinating payroll across multiple jurisdictions and EOR providers.
  • Track record of proactively identifying and escalating data integrity issues; ability to provide specific examples from past roles.
  • Advanced Excel proficiency (formulas, pivot tables, dashboards); ability to audit data and spot anomalies.
  • Confirmed availability for a 12-month fixed-term contract.
STRONGLY PREFERRED:
  • Experience with Deel, Remote, or other EOR platforms
  • Experience with Pinpoint ATS and Lattice
  • SHRM-CP or CHRP certification
  • Software/tech company background
  • Comfort with AI-assisted tools for data validation, reporting, and task automation

Benefits

  • Full Medical, Dental and Vision benefits
  • 401k
  • Paid Time Off
  • Remote working environment

jobs.description:
We're looking for a confident communicator to join our sales team. In this role, you'll introduce our services to marketing executives across the United States, identify potential opportunities, and schedule qualified meetings for our sales team.

jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

BASE SALARY: $120,000 to $150,000 per year, paid semi-monthly

MUST HAVE:

  • Expert SQL & Comfortable with Unstructured Complex Data: Extracts accurate insights from raw, unstructured data without relying on clean models
  • Reporting Ownership & Data Literacy: Builds, standardizes, drives adoption, and leaves teams more data-literate
  • Performance Marketing Optimization: Connects data directly to levers that move the business, i.e. campaign performance, conversion rates, or revenue per session
  • Advanced LookML Development (or equivalent in Power BI / Tableau): Architects complex models with full understanding of downstream impacts
  • Curiosity & Business Depth: Asks questions first; driven to grow business knowledge to become a trusted analytical partner, not just a builder

EXPERIENCE: Minimum 7 years in business intelligence or analytics with direct exposure to performance or affiliate marketing. The strongest candidates have owned reporting end-to-end, from pipeline to dashboard, worked with messy, complex, third-party data, and partnered closely with business teams to uncover meaningful trends, conduct retrospective analyses, and connect data work to decisions that actually moved the business.

YOUR ROLE

Launch Potato is looking for a Lead BI Developer to own the reporting infrastructure that powers decision-making across our Credit Cards, Make Money/Manage Money, Banking, and Marketplace verticals with a clear growth path into becoming a proactive analytical partner who helps the team see around corners.

You'll be embedded with the business from day one, partnering closely with our Yield, Paid Media, and Account Management teams to uncover meaningful trends, conduct retrospective analyses across experiments, creatives, offers, seasonality, and CAC performance, and challenge the team with insights they aren't currently seeing. This is NOT a role for someone who wants to build dashboards and hand them off, it's for someone who cares deeply about whether the work they build gets used, understood, and acted on.

Outcomes (Performance Expectations)

  • 30 Days in: Actively engaged with stakeholders to audit what reporting the team is consuming and why, i.e. identifying discrepancies, redundancies, and inconsistencies across existing dashboards and beginning to develop a roadmap to standardize reporting across your verticals.
  • 60 Days in: Bridging business context and data understanding by being able to articulate how assigned verticals make money and what the key performance levers are. Actively improving dashboard standardization while executing on ad hoc requests with accuracy and business context.
  • 90 Days in: Dashboard standardization is in execution and a clear roadmap exists for how trusted data sources will be developed to improve the efficiency of data consumption. LookML structure is understood well enough to begin making changes with full awareness of downstream impacts. Working relationships with Yield, Paid Media, and Account Management are established.
  • 6 Months in: Trust is built with the business team through education, best practices, and a standardized reporting suite that enables confident self-service analytics. Proactive retrospective analyses are being delivered across experiments, creatives, offers, seasonality, and CAC performance. Strong understanding of the full funnel metrics that support each team.
  • Year 1: Trusted technical owner for assigned verticals end-to-end, from raw data ingestion through final dashboard. Reporting standardization is complete, retrospective analysis is a consistent output, and the business team views you as a go-to analytical partner who recommends action, not just reports findings.

Competencies

  • Analytical Rigor: Asks the hard questions and traces discrepancies to the source before drawing conclusions.
  • Reporting Ownership: Engages stakeholders to understand how reporting is used before building, i.e. creates dashboards that are adopted, not just delivered.
  • Business Acumen: Invests in understanding the business by asking the right questions before pulling the data.
  • Communication: Asks enough upfront to make sure the answer lands with the right context for the right audience.
  • Proactive Ownership: Surfaces problems early, engages before being asked, and drives work forward with a clear point of view.
  • Collaboration: Builds trust by asking genuine questions and showing they care about what stakeholders need, not just what they asked for.
  • Curiosity & Growth: Asks more than most and is driven to grow from technical executor into analytical partner over time.

TOTAL COMPENSATION

Base salary is set according to market rates for the nearest major metro and varies based on Launch Potato’s Levels Framework. Your compensation package includes a base salary, profit-sharing bonus, and competitive benefits. Launch Potato is a performance-driven company, which means once you are hired, future increases will be based on company and personal performance, not annual cost of living adjustments.

WHO WE ARE

Own influencer marketing programs and special events with exceptional organization, proactive research, strong client communication and disciplined follow-through. Support select integrated marketing projects when needed.

Influencer marketing is the primary focus of this role. Event management is the second priority. Integrated marketing project management is a third, as-needed responsibility. This role is designed for someone who loves process, keeps many moving pieces organized and can take a project from kickoff through completion without losing the details that shape the client experience.

THE PRIORITIES

  • Influencer Marketing: This is the core of the role. You will manage influencer programs from start to finish, including research, vetting, outreach, coordination, approvals, deliverables, timelines and reporting. Hands-on influencer marketing experience is required.
  • Event Management: You will help manage special events and activations end to end, with particular ownership of research, venue and location selection, vendor selection, logistics, timelines and on-site execution. Prior event planning experience is a bonus.
  • Integrated Marketing Project Management: On an as-needed basis, you will provide project management support for initiatives such as brand strategy development and website strategy and development. You will coordinate the work and keep it moving, while subject-matter specialists lead the actual strategy, creative and technical execution.

WHAT MAKES SOMEONE GREAT IN THIS ROLE

  • You are a process powerhouse. You naturally build structure around complex work, keep trackers clean, document decisions, follow up relentlessly and create systems that make the team more efficient.
  • You are highly organized and coordinated. You can manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, approvals, people and details without letting things fall through the cracks.
  • You take projects through to fruition. You understand the end goal, map the steps required to get there, anticipate what comes next and keep momentum through completion.
  • You actively research. You do not wait for options to appear. You find creators, venues, vendors, partners, tools and information, evaluate them thoughtfully and bring forward well-developed recommendations.
  • You are an AI-native power user. You use AI as part of your daily workflow to improve research, organization, documentation, process efficiency, information synthesis and project management while applying strong human judgment to the output.
  • You think about the client experience at every step. Your communication is clear, responsive and polished. Clients know where things stand, what is needed from them and what happens next.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Influencer Marketing

  • Manage influencer programs from kickoff through completion, turning the client brief and campaign goals into a clear workback plan, timeline and process.
  • Conduct proactive creator research and build thoughtful influencer lists based on audience fit, brand alignment, content quality, campaign objectives and budget.
  • Lead creator outreach and day-to-day coordination, including vetting, availability, rates, contracting inputs, product shipments, briefing, content timelines, approvals, deliverables and follow-up.
  • Maintain accurate influencer trackers, contact information, campaign status, budgets, deadlines, usage details, approvals and outstanding actions.
  • Coordinate closely with clients and internal teams so everyone understands campaign status, decisions, dependencies and next steps.
  • Review influencer content and program details for completeness and alignment with the approved brief before materials move forward.
  • Support campaign reporting by organizing results, identifying useful takeaways and helping translate performance into a clear client story.
  • Continuously research creators, platforms, audience behaviors, cultural trends and emerging opportunities that could strengthen current or future programs.

2. Event Management

  • Manage special events and activations from early planning through on-site execution and post-event follow-up.
  • Research and evaluate potential locations and venues based on the client brief, audience, experience, geography, logistics and budget.
  • Research, source and coordinate vendors, partners and other event resources, gathering the information needed to compare options and make strong recommendations.
  • Build and manage event workback plans, budgets, vendor timelines, approvals, guest lists, invitations, run-of-show documents and other key logistics.
  • Communicate professionally and proactively with venues, vendors, partners, clients and internal stakeholders, keeping decisions and next steps clear.
  • Provide on-site event support as needed and remain calm, organized and solutions-focused when plans change.
  • Keep the client experience front and center, ensuring the planning process feels thoughtful, well managed and buttoned up from beginning to end.

3. Integrated Marketing Project Management

  • Provide project management support on select integrated marketing assignments as client needs require, including brand strategy development and website strategy and development.
  • Build and maintain project plans, timelines, scopes, approvals, deliverables, dependencies and decision logs.
  • Coordinate the people responsible for strategy, creative, content, design, development or other specialized execution so work moves forward on time and in the right sequence.
  • Translate client feedback and internal decisions into clear next steps, owners and deadlines.
  • Flag risks, missing inputs or potential roadblocks early and help develop practical solutions that keep the work moving.
  • This is a project management responsibility. You are not expected to personally execute brand strategy, design or website development.

CLIENT EXPERIENCE & COMMUNICATION

Autodesk's Technical Advisory organization helps the world's leading architecture, engineering, construction, manufacturing, and media companies get the most from their Autodesk investments. We are transforming this expertise from traditional consulting into a digital-first platform strategy — and the Senior Manager, Product Management will define what that platform becomes.


Reporting to the Director of Platform & Productization within Global Delivery & Solutions, you will lead a product management team responsible for Autodesk's digital consulting platform. Your portfolio spans platform capabilities, industry-specific solutions, consulting tools, and packaged services.


In the first year, you will launch and land our first digital consulting offering, validating our new consulting model with paying customers. You will establish product management discipline for a maturing capability — discovery practices, prioritization frameworks, go-to-market coordination — while simultaneously delivering product that proves the model works. You own the product strategy and roadmap. You will partner with Content & Knowledge on knowledge readiness and publication decisions, with Architecture and Engineering on technical feasibility and delivery sequencing, and with GTM on market positioning and launch execution. The role sits at the center of the organization, and your ability to hold a coherent product vision while navigating these dependencies will define the platform's success.


Responsibilities

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for the digital consulting platform, prioritizing capabilities that deliver measurable customer value while supporting the broader transformation from traditional consulting to scalable digital offerings
  • Translate customer needs, market signals, and field consultant feedback into a coherent product backlog with clear prioritization rationale
  • Partner with the Content & Knowledge team to evaluate which captured implementation knowledge is ready for productization, assessing market value, accuracy, and completeness
  • Define the service catalog product model — how fixed-scope consulting services are packaged, priced, discovered, and delivered through the platform
  • Coordinate with Autodesk product management teams to align platform strategy with product roadmaps, ensuring consulting offerings evolve alongside the products customers are implementing
  • Establish and maintain direct relationships with customers and design partners to validate product direction and gather continuous feedback
  • Partner with GTM and consulting delivery leadership to build systematic feedback loops between field teams and the product team
  • Monitor competitive landscape and industry trends in professional services, consulting technology, and AI-enabled implementation support to inform product differentiation
  • Define success metrics for platform adoption, usage, and customer outcomes, and use data to drive iterative product improvement
  • Lead and grow a team of product managers who own different areas of the portfolio: platform capabilities, industry solutions, tools, and services
  • Establish product management discipline including discovery practices, prioritization frameworks, stakeholder communication, and go-to-market coordination
  • Partner with Architecture and Engineering to ensure product requirements are technically feasible and well-scoped for iterative delivery
  • Provide executive reporting on product performance, adoption trends, and strategic recommendations

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in product management with progressive responsibility, including managing product managers
  • 4+ years leading product teams, with demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain strong product talent
  • Experience building digital and AI enabled products or platforms from early stage — defining strategy, launching to market, and iterating based on customer feedback
  • Experience defining product models where the offering combines digital tools and human-delivered services (service catalog, marketplace, or hybrid models)
  • Strong business acumen with ability to connect product decisions to revenue models, customer value, and organizational strategy
  • Experience working with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams in an integrated product development process
  • Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

The Ideal Candidate

  • Has product management experience in professional services, consulting technology, knowledge platforms, or services-to-product transformations
  • Startup and new value creation experience in both 0 to 1 and 1 to 100 scaling
  • Understands how to productize expert knowledge — turning unstructured human expertise into structured, repeatable, scalable offerings, with attention to quality governance and knowledge lifecycle
  • Is skilled at managing a diverse product portfolio with different maturity levels, from new capabilities to scaling existing features
  • Has familiarity with architecture, engineering, construction, operations (AECO), manufacturing, or media and entertainment industries
  • Has an informed perspective on how AI is changing professional services delivery and what that means for product strategy
  • Is energized by building something new and comfortable making product decisions with incomplete information, then adjusting as the team learns

26WD101260, Responsable senior, Produit


Aperçu du poste

L'organisation de conseil technique d'Autodesk aide les plus grandes entreprises mondiales des secteurs de l'architecture, de l'ingénierie, de la construction, de l'industrie et des médias à tirer le meilleur parti de leurs investissements dans les solutions Autodesk. Nous transformons actuellement cette expertise, qui reposait jusqu'à présent sur un modèle de conseil traditionnel, en une stratégie de plateforme axée sur le numérique — et c'est au responsable senior de la gestion de produits qu'il reviendra de définir la forme que prendra cette plateforme.


Rattaché(e) au directeur de la plateforme et de la productisation au sein de la division Global Delivery & Solutions, vous assumerez la responsabilité d’une équipe de gestion de produits chargée de la plateforme de conseil numérique d’Autodesk. Votre portefeuille couvre les fonctionnalités de la plateforme, les solutions sectorielles, les outils de conseil et les offres de services packagées.


Au cours de la première année, vous lancerez et mettrez en œuvre notre première offre de conseil numérique, validant ainsi notre nouveau modèle de conseil auprès de clients payants. Vous mettrez en place une discipline de gestion de produit pour une capacité en pleine maturation — pratiques de découverte, cadres de hiérarchisation des priorités, coordination de la mise sur le marché — tout en livrant simultanément un produit qui prouve l’efficacité du modèle. Vous êtes responsable de la stratégie produit et de la feuille de route. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec l’équipe Contenu et Connaissances sur la préparation des connaissances et les décisions de publication, avec les équipes Architecture et Ingénierie sur la faisabilité technique et l’enchaînement des livraisons, et avec l’équipe GTM sur le positionnement sur le marché et l’exécution du lancement. Ce poste occupe une place centrale au sein de l’organisation, et votre capacité à maintenir une vision cohérente du produit tout en gérant ces interdépendances déterminera le succès de la plateforme.


Responsabilités

  • Maîtriser la stratégie produit et la feuille de route de la plateforme de conseil numérique, en donnant la priorité aux capacités qui apportent une valeur client mesurable tout en soutenant la transformation globale du conseil traditionnel vers des offres numériques évolutives
  • Traduire les besoins des clients, les signaux du marché et les retours des consultants de terrain en un backlog produit cohérent, avec une justification claire des priorités
  • Collaborer avec l’équipe Contenu et Connaissances pour déterminer quelles connaissances de mise en œuvre capturées sont prêtes à être transformées en produits, en évaluant leur valeur marchande, leur exactitude et leur exhaustivité
  • Définir le modèle de produit du catalogue de services : comment les services de conseil à périmètre fixe sont regroupés, tarifés, présentés et fournis via la plateforme
  • Assurer la coordination avec les équipes de gestion de produits d’Autodesk afin d’aligner la stratégie de la plateforme sur les feuilles de route des produits, en veillant à ce que les offres de conseil évoluent parallèlement aux produits que les clients mettent en œuvre
  • Établir et entretenir des relations directes avec les clients et les partenaires de conception afin de valider l’orientation des produits et de recueillir en continu des retours d’expérience
  • Collaborer avec les responsables de la stratégie de commercialisation (GTM) et de la prestation de services de conseil pour mettre en place des boucles de rétroaction systématiques entre les équipes de terrain et l’équipe produit
  • Surveiller le paysage concurrentiel et les tendances du secteur dans les domaines des services professionnels, des technologies de conseil et de l’assistance à la mise en œuvre basée sur l’IA afin d’orienter la différenciation des produits
  • Définir des indicateurs de réussite pour l’adoption de la plateforme, son utilisation et les résultats clients, et utiliser les données pour piloter l’amélioration itérative des produits
  • Diriger et développer une équipe de chefs de produit responsables de différents domaines du portefeuille : fonctionnalités de la plateforme, solutions sectorielles, outils et services
  • Mettre en place une discipline de gestion de produit comprenant des pratiques de découverte, des cadres de hiérarchisation des priorités, la communication avec les parties prenantes et la coordination de la mise sur le marché
  • Collaborer avec les équipes d’architecture et d’ingénierie pour s’assurer que les exigences produit sont techniquement réalisables et correctement définies pour une livraison itérative
  • Fournir des rapports à la direction sur les performances des produits, les tendances d’adoption et les recommandations stratégiques

Qualifications minimales

  • Plus de 10 ans d’expérience en gestion de produits avec des responsabilités croissantes, y compris la gestion de chefs de produit
  • Plus de 4 ans à la tête d’équipes produit, avec une capacité avérée à recruter, développer et fidéliser des talents de haut niveau dans le domaine des produits
  • Expérience dans la création de produits ou de plateformes numériques et basés sur l’IA dès les premières étapes — définition de la stratégie, lancement sur le marché et itération en fonction des retours clients
  • Expérience dans la définition de modèles de produits où l’offre combine des outils numériques et des services fournis par des personnes (catalogue de services, marketplace ou modèles hybrides)
  • Solide sens des affaires, avec une capacité à relier les décisions produit aux modèles de revenus, à la valeur client et à la stratégie organisationnelle
  • Expérience de collaboration avec des équipes d’ingénierie, de conception et de commercialisation dans le cadre d’un processus intégré de développement de produit
  • Licence en commerce, ingénierie, informatique ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience professionnelle équivalente

Le candidat idéal

  • Possède une expérience en gestion de produit dans les services professionnels, les technologies de conseil, les plateformes de connaissances ou les transformations « de services en produits »
  • Expérience dans les start-ups et la création de nouvelle valeur, tant dans les phases de développement « 0 à 1 » que de croissance « 1 à 100 »
  • Sait comment transformer le savoir-faire d’experts en produit — en convertissant l’expertise humaine non structurée en offres structurées, reproductibles et évolutives, tout en veillant à la gouvernance de la qualité et au cycle de vie des connaissances
  • Maîtrise la gestion d’un portefeuille de produits diversifié présentant différents niveaux de maturité, allant de la création de nouvelles fonctionnalités à l’évolution des fonctionnalités existantes
  • Possède une bonne connaissance des secteurs de l’architecture, de l’ingénierie, de la construction et de l’exploitation (AECO), de l’industrie manufacturière, ou des médias et du divertissement
  • A une vision éclairée de la manière dont l’IA transforme la prestation des services professionnels et de ce que cela implique pour la stratégie produit
  • Trouve sa motivation dans la création de quelque chose de nouveau et est à l’aise pour prendre des décisions relatives au produit avec des informations incomplètes, puis pour les ajuster au fur et à mesure que l’équipe acquiert de nouvelles connaissances

jobs.description:
About Us

Machines will make decisions, move value, and coordinate on behalf of organizations, instantly, autonomously, and at unprecedented scale. But the systems that govern today’s economy weren’t designed for that world. Turnkey is building the infrastructure for this future: programmable guardrails that enable autonomy without sacrificing control.

Founded by the team that scaled Coinbase Custody to $100M+ in ARR and secured more than $100B in crypto assets, we know how to move at pace without ever compromising on security.

Our mission is to help the world operate an economy on autopilot, safely.We're low-ego, high-agency, and deeply technical. Our team consists of experts in cryptography, security, and systems who believe great infrastructure is invisible. We're building the trustless, programmable foundation for the autonomous economy, and we're hiring people who understand what that requires.

We are seeking a Director of Engineering to lead our Platform Engineering organization, the team responsible for the infrastructure that powers and scales Turnkey's core product.This is a senior leadership role reporting to CTO/Co-Founder Jack Kearney, owning both the technical direction and the people leadership of the org. If you're excited about the potential that web3 has to radically change the world for the better and have a sincere desire to help facilitate that change, join us as we redefine decentralized development.

What You’ll Do:

Strategic Vision and Leadership

  • Own the engineering strategy and technical vision for Turnkey's Platform Engineering organization, spanning infrastructure, reliability and performance, releases and internal tooling.
  • Build, manage, and grow a high-performing engineering org, including hiring and developing engineering managers and senior ICs
  • Partner closely with Product Engineering and company leadership to ensure platform investments align with customer and business needs
  • Identify and evaluate emerging technologies and trends in distributed systems and cloud infrastructure, and guide their integration into our platform
  • Contribute to company-wide strategic planning and technical decision-making as a member of the engineering leadership team

Organizational & People Leadership

  • Define and evolve the org structure, leveling, and career paths for the Platform Engineering team as it scales
  • Drive recruitment, onboarding, and retention of top infrastructure and security-minded engineering talent
  • Set and uphold engineering rituals (on-call, incident review, capacity planning, etc.) that keep the org resilient and accountable
  • Coach and develop managers and senior engineers, building a durable leadership bench

Architectural Oversight & Technical Direction

  • Provide strategic technical guidance across foundational systems, ensuring intelligent architectural decisions that support long-term scalability, security, and reliability
  • Oversee the design and implementation of our cloud and network infrastructure, company-wide security architecture and controls, and the operational tooling and practices that keep production systems healthy.
  • Ensure the scalability, security, and reliability of infrastructure, addressing the complexities of distributed systems and adversarial threat models
  • Define and drive processes; security reviews, capacity planning, testing, incident response, that ensure quality and consistency across infrastructure development

What We’re Looking For:

  • Proven experience managing engineering managers and/or leading a multi-team engineering org (not just individual teams)
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and security architecture, with the ability to lead in-depth technical discussions and make final calls on tradeoffs
  • A track record of operating and scaling infrastructure that demands high availability, performance, and a strong security posture
  • Excellence at holding a high bar on software quality and engineering process, even while moving fast
  • A healthy amount of paranoia :-)

Style Points

  • Prior experience working in fast-paced crypto/web3 and/or FinTech companies, especially with exposure to security-critical infrastructure
  • Experience scaling an infrastructure org through a significant growth stage (e.g., Series B → C, or comparable)
  • Actively tracking developments in the crypto ecosystem and opinionated on where it's going

What We Offer

  • Full benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, HSA/FSA, 401(k) - detailed benefits overview available as we get further in the process
  • Paid parental leave
  • Unlimited PTO
  • $3,000/yr learning and development budget to attend industry conferences
  • Multiple team offsites per year
  • Lunch stipend

Turnkey is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

This role leads the advisory, architecture, and delivery of enterprise Data Foundation engagements for Salesforce Professional Services customers. Drawing on deep data experience (10+ years for the Senior Technical Architect level; 15+ years for the Director level), you run discovery, set the technical vision, design/approve the target architecture, and drive delivery across a progressive, customer-calibrated maturity journey — advising customer stakeholders (up to CxO level at the Director tier) along the way.

You bring the Data Foundation Delivery to life, including core data capabilities, associated frameworks, and the ability to operate across one or more of the platform stack (Salesforce Data 360, Informatica IDMC, MuleSoft). As a Salesforce practitioner/leader, you help customers bring the Salesforce ecosystem into the broader landscape of technology investments they've already made — balancing platform-agnostic execution (interoperable, open-standards, multi-vendor) and platform-centric execution (Salesforce-native), so the data foundation fits the customer's reality rather than forcing a single stack. Every foundation is built with governance, quality, security, and privacy embedded from day one, and serves both traditional analytics for people and agentic AI for machines.

You are a hands-on practitioner of AI-augmented professional services delivery and an emerging-to-established thought leader on the agentic future of the SaaS industry — applying a forward-looking perspective on enterprise data, AI agents, and the SaaS ecosystem to how you advise and deliver, and contributing that experience back to the practice's point of view. This is a customer-billable delivery role — a hands-on/senior individual contributor accountable for engagement outcomes and technical leadership, not an internal people-management position.

What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities)

Advisory & Strategy

  • Lead discovery: stakeholder interviews, current-state assessment, use-case and KPI definition; at senior levels, serve as trusted advisor to customer CxOs and shape the business case
  • Assess data maturity and build a phased, customer-calibrated roadmap
  • Align customer stakeholders and sponsors; contribute to/own the business case and expected outcomes
  • Frame guidance as adaptable options, meeting customers at their entry point (customer-360, regulatory governance, analytics modernization, unstructured/RAG)
  • Represent the practice in complex, high-stakes engagements

Architecture & Delivery

  • Design/set/approve target-state architecture across one or more of the platform stack (Salesforce Data 360 / Informatica IDMC / MuleSoft)
  • Deliver both platform-agnostic and platform-centric execution — integrate Salesforce cleanly with (or position it as the center of gravity within) the customer's existing multi-vendor technology investments (data platforms, warehouses, lakes, and tools)
  • Validate architecture decisions through scoped POCs before production build
  • Deliver working software/value every phase — no big-bang, governance-first discipline
  • Embed governance, quality, security, and privacy from the start
  • Build for dual consumption: analytics for people and agentic AI for machines


Delivery Oversight & Risk (Director-level emphasis)

  • Provide architectural governance and quality assurance across concurrent engagements
  • Own delivery risk: exec buy-in, business engagement, scope, and dependency management

AI-Augmented Delivery

  • Apply/set the standard for AI-augmented professional services delivery — use AI tools (Claude Code, Gemini, Lucid AI, NotebookLM) across the engagement lifecycle to compress effort and raise quality
  • Build (or define the approach for) reusable, capability-driven (not tool-centric) assets: prompt templates, skills, and agents that deliver a capability regardless of underlying tool
  • Work with human-at-the-helm rigor so AI-accelerated output stays trusted, auditable, and grounded; at senior levels, set measurable AI-acceleration targets and quality guardrails
  • Contribute proven patterns and assets back to the practice's playbook, accelerators, and reference IP


Industry Thought Leadership (Agentic SaaS Future)

  • Bring (or own) a forward-looking perspective on the agentic future of the SaaS industry into engagements — helping customers build AI-ready, agent-native data foundations
  • Contribute to (or shape) the practice's point of view — POVs, reference patterns, and enablement on where enterprise data and AI agents are heading
  • Grow as, or represent the practice as, an internal and customer-facing voice on agentic delivery

Governance & Enablement

  • Establish stewardship, RACI, and sustainable operating models with the customer
  • Produce clear, concise, executive-ready summaries alongside deep technical detail
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance/leadership to Consultants, Architects, and (at Director level) Senior Advisors on the engagement; hand off with runbooks and a sustainable operating model
  • Author and evolve the Data Foundation Delivery Playbook, accelerators, and reference IP (Director level)

What You Bring (Preferred Experience)

  • Unified Identity & Harmonization — identity resolution, match/merge, golden records
  • Master Data Management — domains, survivorship, hierarchies, 360 views
  • Unstructured Data Management — document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, RAG grounding
  • Data Architecture & Semantic Modeling — conceptual/logical/physical models, semantic layer, glossary
  • Data Integration, Orchestration & Activation — API-led connectivity, CDC, real-time events, activation
  • Data Trust, Security & Privacy — classification, access control, masking, Einstein Trust Layer
  • Data Governance & Stewardship — catalog, lineage, data quality, stewardship & policy
  • Industry Data Models & Accelerators — FSC, Health Cloud, Manufacturing Cloud blueprints
  • Data Platform & Infrastructure — lakehouse, compute, catalog, cloud foundation
  • Analytics, BI & Data Observability — dashboards, self-service BI, freshness/quality monitoring

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years (Senior Technical Architect) / 15+ years (Director) of hands-on data experience across data & analytics consulting, engineering, architecture, MDM, integration, and governance
  • Demonstrated delivery/leadership of enterprise data platform, MDM, integration, governance, or AI-readiness programs
  • Hands-on/deep expertise with one or more of Salesforce Data 360, Informatica IDMC, MuleSoft
  • Strong-to-authority-level data modeling (conceptual/logical/physical) and semantic/metadata modeling
  • Working-to-strong command of data governance, quality, security, and privacy (e.g., GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA)
  • Executive-grade communication, up to proven CxO-level advisory at senior levels; ability to guide delivery teams and lead multi-workstream delivery
  • Experience integrating a vendor platform into heterogeneous/complex enterprise landscapes — balancing platform-agnostic and platform-centric approaches
  • Hands-on-to-deep fluency with AI-augmented delivery — using AI tools as a core part of the workflow and building reusable prompt/skill/agent assets
  • A forward-looking, and at senior levels recognized/published, perspective on enterprise data, AI, and the agentic future of SaaS

Certifications

Certifications are preferred, not required — a proven delivery and thought-leadership track record carries the most weight.

Preferred Certifications

  • Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
  • Salesforce Certified Data Architect
  • Salesforce Certified Integration Architect
  • Salesforce Agentforce Specialist (Director)
  • MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect (Sr. Architect level)
  • TOGAF (Director)

Additional Pluses

  • Informatica IDMC / MDM certification
  • Salesforce Agentforce Specialist (Sr. Architect level)
  • MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect (Director level)
  • DAMA CDMP or CDMC

Preferred / Differentiating Strengths

  • Experience/track record delivering agentic AI / RAG on a governed data foundation
  • Industry depth/expertise in Financial Services, Healthcare, or Manufacturing (industry data models)
  • Track record/history building reusable accelerators and prompt/skill/agent libraries
  • Prior Professional Services / customer-facing advisory or leadership experience at enterprise scale


How Success Is Measured (First 12 Months)

  • Certification Attainment: complete required certifications to be compliant and ready for customer engagements
  • Discovery-to-roadmap / Customer impact: consistently produce customer-calibrated maturity assessments and roadmaps that secure signed charters; ramp quickly to be billable on one or more engagements
  • Delivery / Architecture standard: ship working, governed capability increments each phase, with consistent, governed, dual-purpose foundations across the portfolio
  • Advisory impact / Business outcomes: measurable stakeholder alignment and adoption; clear business (not just technical) outcomes realized
  • AI-augmented delivery: apply AI tooling to reduce delivery effort while improving consistency; contribute reusable prompt/skill/agent assets to the practice, adopted team-wide at senior levels
  • Thought leadership: bring a credible agentic-SaaS-future perspective into engagements; at Director level, own a defined, published practice POV shaping customer engagements and market positioning
  • Governance / Enablement: leave every engagement with a sustainable stewardship and operating model; delivery teams ramped and productive through technical leadership

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Position Type: Full-Time | Remote
Working Hours: 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday–Friday

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Senior Bookkeeper / Accounting Operations Specialist to manage financial records and support accounting operations. You will be responsible for keeping the books accurate, reconciling 10+ accounts, managing vendor and customer payments, tracking trip profitability, and maintaining accurate financial and booking records. You will also help improve systems, reporting, and automation to reduce manual work. The role requires strong Xero, Excel and Google Sheets experience, along with the ability to work independently and handle confidential financial information.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting & Reconciliation

  • Perform monthly and quarterly reconciliations across 10+ bank, credit card, HubSpot and accounting accounts.
  • Review and categorize expenses in Xero.
  • Identify duplicate payments, missing transactions, unusual charges, and discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation.

Payments & Vendor Management

  • Track vendor and customer payments, outstanding balances, and payment status.
  • Coordinate domestic and international payments, including foreign currency transactions.
  • Manage payments through platforms such as Convera (GlobalPay).
  • Work with vendors, operators, and internal teams to resolve payment issues.

Trip Profitability & Reporting

  • Track gross and net margins by trip or flight.
  • Monitor trip-related costs including aircraft, catering, transportation, and other operational expenses.
  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual expense and financial reports.
  • Maintain vendor variance and fixed-cost reports.
  • Provide management with clear reporting on expenses, margins, and payments.

CRM & Systems Management

  • Keep HubSpot deal stages and booking information up to date.
  • Maintain accurate trip details, pricing, invoicing, and payment status.
  • Reconcile HubSpot data with Xero and other financial records.
  • Organize financial documents and shared accounting folders.

Process Improvement

  • Build and maintain Excel and Google Sheets templates, dashboards, and reporting tools.
  • Use formulas, pivot tables, and data validation to improve reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive accounting and reporting tasks.
  • Improve processes to reduce manual work and prevent errors.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in bookkeeping, accounting operations, or financial analysis.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Xero, including reconciliation, expense coding, and reporting.
  • Experience reconciling 10+ accounts on a monthly and quarterly basis.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets skills, including XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, pivot tables, and data validation.
  • Experience handling international payments and foreign currency transactions.
  • Strong understanding of financial reporting and account reconciliation.
  • Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to handle confidential financial information.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Convera GlobalPay and international payment workflows.
  • Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM.
  • Experience in private aviation, charter, luxury travel, or hospitality.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based companies and USD accounting.
  • Experience building automated reports or workflows.
  • Xero Advisor Certification.
  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

Remote & Availability Requirements

  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated, secure workspace.
  • Must be available during 9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET, Monday–Friday.
  • Occasional after-hours, weekend, or holiday availability is required for urgent matters such as operator payments, declined cards, or vendor issues affecting active flights.
  • Must be reachable by phone and able to respond promptly during urgent situations.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, you will be expected to learn the company's systems and vendor network, reconcile all 10+ accounts, align HubSpot records with the books, complete a monthly close, and deliver trip-level margin reporting.

Over time, you will help make the accounting and reporting process faster, more accurate, and more automated while providing leadership with reliable financial information for business decisions.

jobs.description:
United States – Remote
Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust

LTS is seeking a Senior Front-End Agentic AI Engineer to own the experience layer of an AI platform built for one of the most consequential legacy systems still running in production today.

Our platform enables engineers to ask questions in plain English and receive explainable, verifiable answers traced directly back to the exact lines of source code. Rather than replacing engineers, we're building AI that helps them understand decades of complex software faster, with complete transparency and confidence.

We're building an AI-native engineering platform supporting the modernization of mission-critical healthcare systems serving millions of Veterans nationwide. Every response generated by the platform must be explainable, traceable, and trustworthy. The front end is where that trust is earned.

The platform is designed for deployment across federal enterprise environments and is being engineered to align with FedRAMP security controls, Zero Trust principles, and federal compliance requirements.

When an engineer asks a question about a decades-old codebase, your interface determines whether they trust the answer or close the tab. You'll own that experience from end to end.

The product has executive sponsorship, committed users, a clearly defined mission, and a customer who knows exactly what success looks like.

Our engineering team is intentionally small. Every engineer has significant ownership, meaningful influence over product direction, and the opportunity to help define how engineers interact with AI.

We don't simply build AI-powered software—we build software with AI. This is not another chatbot.

Using AI agents, LLMs, parallel workflows, and model-assisted development is simply how we engineer.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the end-to-end front-end experience for an enterprise-scale Agentic AI platform.
  • Design intuitive interfaces that transform complex AI reasoning into experiences engineers’ trust.
  • Build and maintain conversational interfaces, embedded AI assistants, review workflows, and authoring experiences using React, TypeScript, and modern front-end technologies.
  • Develop the rendering pipeline for streaming AI responses, markdown, source citations, code blocks, dependency graphs, workflow visualizations, and technical documentation.
  • Build evidence and traceability experiences that allow users to validate AI-generated answers by navigating directly to source code, documentation, and supporting artifacts.
  • Design interaction patterns for agentic workflows, including multi-step reasoning, tool execution, progress visualization, human-in-the-loop review, and long-running AI tasks.
  • Build responsive real-time user experiences using WebSockets, streaming APIs, and modern state management patterns.
  • Partner closely with AI engineers to define how agent output is translated into intuitive user experiences.
  • Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, architects, and platform engineers to rapidly prototype, validate, and deliver new capabilities.
  • Build scalable component libraries and reusable design systems supporting future platform growth.
  • Optimize performance, accessibility, responsiveness, and usability across enterprise environments, including Section 508 compliance.
  • Instrument the application with analytics, observability, and client-side monitoring to continuously improve user experience.
  • Use AI-native engineering workflows to accelerate development, improve software quality, and increase engineering velocity.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent professional experience).
  • 7+ years of professional front-end software engineering experience building production web applications.
  • Expert-level proficiency with React, TypeScript, modern JavaScript, and contemporary front-end architecture.
  • Experience building highly interactive, data-rich user interfaces.
  • Strong understanding of component architecture, state management, and scalable front-end engineering.
  • Experience building real-time user experiences using streaming APIs, WebSockets, or Server-Sent Events.
  • Experience consuming complex REST, GraphQL, tRPC, or comparable typed APIs.
  • Experience collaborating closely with backend engineers, designers, and product teams in Agile environments.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly across engineering and business stakeholders.
  • Mindset of a product engineer rather than a feature developer.
  • Engineers capable of building software from first principles.
  • Passion for usability, interaction design, and developer experience.
  • Strong ability to carefully analyze requirements before writing code.
  • Preference for ownership over narrowly defined responsibilities.
  • Experience operating across the client/server boundary when necessary.
  • Expertise using AI coding assistants, parallel agents, and model-driven development workflows.
  • Efficiency while maintaining high engineering standards.
  • Innate ability to solve difficult engineering problems that don't have obvious solutions.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in healthcare, regulated industries, or large-scale enterprise modernization programs is a plus.
  • Experience building AI-native products, LLM-powered applications, or agentic AI systems.
  • Experience designing interfaces for AI assistants, copilots, developer tools, or knowledge platforms.
  • Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, or agent orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience rendering complex technical content including markdown, syntax highlighting, dependency graphs, diagrams, or code relationships.
  • Experience developing products for software engineers or other highly technical users.
  • Experience with cloud-native platforms including AWS or Azure.
  • Experience building design systems or reusable component libraries.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards including Section 508 and WCAG.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants and parallel AI workflows as part of daily software development.

Why Join LTS?

At LTS, we support impactful programs that directly improve healthcare services for Veterans nationwide. Our teams work on innovative modernization initiatives that help transform legacy systems into secure, scalable, and mission-focused digital solutions. We value collaboration, integrity, and professional growth while empowering employees to contribute to meaningful federal healthcare missions.

LTS shares salary ranges to promote transparency. Compensation ranges are provided for informational purposes, and final compensation may vary based on experience, skills, location, and role requirements.

LTS is committed to offering eligible employees comprehensive benefits that will provide them with options intended to meet their needs and the needs of their family.
