We are now defining a new category for how that work gets done: the Anatta Agentic Operating System, software that orchestrates AI agents and human judgment to take delivery work from scope to shipped in weeks, not quarters.

We run delivery as a system. We intend to run marketing the same way. That is this job.

The role

You own the execution of every marketing initiative at Anatta — content, search, advertising, website, automation, campaigns, events — and you run them as one connected system rather than a set of disconnected tools and one-off projects.

Most marketing teams sit somewhere between experimenting with AI and actually operating on it: a few generative tools used in isolation, no shared data layer, no closed loop between what gets published, what gets measured and what gets done next. Your mandate is to close that gap. You will design and run an intelligent marketing operating system for Anatta — where intelligence, decisioning, execution and governance are connected, where AI does the volume work, where humans own judgment and quality, and where every initiative reports back into a measurement framework tied to a pipeline.

This is a hands-on, cross-functional operating role. You will build workflows, administer the stack, launch campaigns, read the dashboards and fix what the dashboards reveal. Because our marketing team is intentionally small, leverage matters enormously. Your job is not simply to execute more work. It is to continuously redesign how the work gets done so automation and AI absorb repetitive execution while human time moves toward judgment, creativity and growth. You will also set the standard for how AI is used across the marketing function and train the people around you to use it well. You manage a Content Strategist and Creative directly and work daily with Sales, Business Development, Strategy and Engineering.

What you'll own

1. The AI content engine

  • Run the content production system with your Content Strategist: AI-assisted drafting from practitioner interviews and project material, human editing, practitioner review and sign-off, publication and refresh.
  • Own the editorial calendar, the master keyword sheet, the duplicate-keyword gate and the weekly cadence. Nothing ships without a practitioner having read it; you enforce that gate, not work around it.
  • Maintain the prompt library, templates and quality standards so output is consistent, on-voice and institution-grade — not generic AI prose.
  • Measure throughput weekly (published vs. planned, practitioner-review hours consumed) and scale the calendar off the measured rate.

2. SEO, AEO and GEO

  • Execute Anatta's SEO / answer-engine / generative-engine program: hub-and-spoke architecture, programmatic pages, schema, llms.txt, entity consistency and off-site citation work.
  • Own the entity layer: keep Anatta's facts identical across Google Business Profile, partner directories, review platforms and data aggregators so search engines and AI models resolve one consistent entity.
  • Run the monthly AI-citation checks across the major assistants and Google AI Overviews; log whether Anatta is cited, which URL, and whether the model's answer matches our positioning.
  • Track rankings, impressions and clicks by cluster, and the qualification split of organic leads by landing page.

3. Advertising and paid media

  • Plan, build, QA, launch and optimize paid search and paid social campaigns against the qualified-opportunity definition, not raw lead volume.
  • Manage budgets, pacing and landing-page performance; align paid keywords with the organic plan so both feed the same landing pages and the same reporting.

4. Website performance and improvement

  • Own the website as a product: conversion paths, forms and lead routing, page speed and Core Web Vitals, crawlability for search and AI crawlers, analytics and consent.
  • Prioritise and ship a continuous improvement backlog with Engineering and Creative; measure every change.

5. Marketing automation, data and lead management

  • Build, optimise and maintain automation workflows for lead generation, nurture, lifecycle progression, segmentation, scoring, routing and campaign execution.
  • Ensure data integrity across the contact database, using AI for enrichment, normalisation, deduplication and segmentation.
  • Maintain attribution models and the marketing ROI dashboard; deliver the weekly web and pipeline report.
  • Support revenue goals with lead scoring, sales alerts and signal exports to the sales team; define, with Sales, how AI-assisted and human outbound work together, and monitor the performance and data integrity of AI-assisted prospecting motions.

6. Integrated campaigns and events

  • Own operational execution of integrated campaigns end to end — planning, build, QA, launch, optimisation, reporting — across email, webinars, paid media, ABM programs, nurture, outbound initiatives and events.
  • Plan and coordinate Anatta's event presence: partner events, industry conferences, hosted sessions and webinars — logistics, budget, pre/post campaigns and pipeline follow-through.
  • Set goals and benchmarks for every program before launch; report against them after.

7. Martech and AI stack administration

  • Administer the marketing technology stack — CRM, marketing automation, analytics, SEO and AI tooling — and its integration with sales and business systems.
  • Evaluate, pilot and deploy generative AI tools for content creation, data analysis, campaign personalisation and reporting, including prompt development and use-case experimentation.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Business Development and Engineering leaders on the marketing technology roadmap; project-manage AI initiatives from stakeholder alignment through delivery.

8. Budget, timelines and governance

  • Manage the marketing budget and timelines with Finance; keep programs on budget and on deadline.
  • Establish AI governance for the marketing function: what AI may and may not produce unreviewed, data-handling rules, brand and voice standards, and compliance with data-protection law.
  • Train marketing and adjacent teams on prompting, AI best practices and governance; champion adoption and build technical fluency across the company.

What success looks like in the first 90 days

  • The content system is running at a measured weekly cadence with the practitioner gate intact, and the first wave of the SEO/AEO/GEO plan is published.
  • Anatta's entity data is corrected and consistent across every third-party source that search engines and AI models pull from.
  • The marketing ROI dashboard and weekly report are live, with attribution from first touch through qualified opportunity.
  • Paid and organic feed the same landing pages, with lead routing that qualifies cleanly against the revenue floor.
  • The martech and AI stack is documented, administered and integrated with the CRM; the team is trained on it.
  • Event calendar for the next two quarters is planned, budgeted and instrumented.

Required qualifications

  • 5–7 years in marketing operations, technical program management, demand generation or digital marketing, with at least five in a marketing-operations or equivalent role.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing generative AI tools and automation workflows end to end — not experimentation, deployment.
  • Hands-on experience with prompt engineering and with AI-assisted content production at volume.
  • Proven experience administering large marketing automation platforms and CRM systems and integrating them with other business systems.
  • Working knowledge of SEO, and of how answer engines and AI assistants source and cite content.
  • Experience managing paid media budgets and campaigns.
  • Strong analytical skills: database structures, data hygiene, analytics and attribution; ability to draw insight from marketing data and act on it.
  • Understanding of lead scoring, nurturing, segmentation, personalisation and lifecycle management.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional projects with technical and strategic components to tight deadlines.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication; able to translate technical concepts for non-technical colleagues.
  • Familiarity with GDPR and other relevant data-protection regulation.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in a B2B services, consultancy or agency environment selling to enterprise buyers.
  • Familiarity with the Shopify ecosystem or enterprise ecommerce.
  • Experience managing a direct report or a small content team.
  • Formal training in AI-first marketing systems (e.g. executive education in intelligent marketing operating systems) is a plus.
  • Experience running events end to end.

Skills and competencies

  • Systems thinking: sees marketing as connected workflows, not a list of tasks.
  • Exceptional judgment; comfortable deciding what AI may produce unreviewed and what it may not.
  • Innovative thinker with a real interest in generative AI and digital transformation — and the discipline to ship rather than only explore.
  • Manages multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environment with shifting priorities, without losing attention to detail.
  • Builds and maintains collaborative working relationships across functions; effective leadership while remaining a team player.
  • Strong presentation skills and initiative; defines goals and follows through to results.
  • Professional presence and a high degree of trustworthiness with confidential, financial and client information.
  • Prioritises and manages time effectively; handles competing priorities with composure.

How we work

Anatta is direct, informal and decisive. We favour synthesis over process for its own sake. We say what we think, we push back when we disagree, and we expect the same from you. We publish real numbers from real work and hold ourselves to them. If you want to run marketing as a system — and be measured on whether the system works — this is the role.

This is a small, highly leveraged marketing team. There is no separate marketing operations department, paid media team, SEO team or campaign operations function to hand work to. You will own the system and, when necessary, operate it yourself. The expectation is not that you manually do everything forever. The expectation is that you can do the work, automate what should be automated, build repeatable systems and progressively increase the leverage of the people around you.

What are the perks?

We do our best to make sure employees are supported in everything they do. We offer a range of benefits and perks:

  • Remote first organization
  • Full medical, dental, vision, disability, and company paid life insurance
  • Employer 401(k) contributions
  • Employee assistance program
  • Start accrual with 20 days of PTO annually + holidays
  • Annual winter break: We close the week between Christmas and New Year's so everyone can truly disconnect and recharge
  • Paid parental leave
  • Company events, happy hours, and retreats
  • Budget for continuing education
  • Other perks vary by location

Physical demands requirements

Common office/desk environment that involves long periods of time at a stationary desk with extensive computer work that requires repetitive motion of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.

If this role is filled in the US, the annual salary range is $110,000 USD - $130,000 USD and is commensurate to several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to years of experience, skill set / qualifications, and geographical work location considering differences in cost of living, therefore, actual base pay offered may vary.

jobs.title: Junior Incident Responder, Philippines
jobs.excerpt: About BlackpandaBlackpanda is Asia's leading cyber incident response company, delivering digital emergency response across three integrated channels: IR consulting, IR-1 assurance subscriptions, and Lloyd's of London-underwritten cyber insurance.
jobs.description:
About Blackpanda

Blackpanda is Asia's leading cyber incident response company, delivering digital emergency response across three integrated channels: IR consulting, IR-1 assurance subscriptions, and Lloyd's of London-underwritten cyber insurance. Each is purpose-built for a different buyer, whether enterprise, mass market, or sophisticated risk-transfer clients, and each stands alone as full incident response. Together, these channels reach the entire commercial market, because our mission is to provide digital emergency response for everyone. Buy all three and they combine into the complete post-attack recovery solution: preparation in advance, response the moment you're hit, and financial recovery paid for by insurance. One local team to help you get ready, respond, and recover.

How We Work

Blackpanda is a tech-enabled services team. We invest heavily in AI and are constantly pushing to do better, faster, and at scale. You are given freedom to use the approved tools in the team, but you are to take ownership of outcomes. We prefer smart work over hard work, welcome good ideas regardless of where they come from, and have deliberately kept red tape out of the way of innovation. If you want to join a team building the best response practice in Asia — and shaping the tools and methods that get us there — you'll be in good company.

A note on levelling

This posting reflects a single role title; however, we hire across a range of seniority levels from this brief. The final title, whether DFIR Analyst, DFIR Specialist, or an adjacent level, will be determined by the depth and breadth of cybersecurity and incident response capabilities demonstrated throughout the interview process. If your experience sits near the edge of these levels, we encourage you to apply regardless.

Your Mission: Junior Incident Responder

As a Junior Incident Responder, you will work alongside senior responders on live engagements — helping clients contain, investigate, and recover from real cyber attacks. This is a delivery-focused role: your job is to do the work, learn the craft, and grow into a fully fledged responder under direct mentorship.

We hire for attitude and aptitude. We don't expect you to have seen everything yet — we expect you to be curious, coachable, and serious about building a career in incident response. The right candidate can demonstrate a genuine interest in IR through their experience, side projects, study, or community involvement, and shows up ready to learn fast in a real-world environment.

Core Responsibilities

Delivery Alongside Senior Responders

  • Support senior consultants on active incidents — assisting with containment, evidence collection, forensic analysis, and reporting.
  • Acquire and triage forensic artifacts across Windows, Linux, macOS, and cloud environments under the guidance of more experienced team members.
  • Analyse logs, endpoint telemetry, network data, and malware artifacts, and contribute findings to investigation timelines.
  • Use scripting (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) to assist with collection, parsing, and automation tasks where useful.

Client-Ready Professionalism

  • Document findings clearly and accurately, contributing sections to client deliverables under senior review.
  • Maintain a calm, professional posture in client-facing settings — even when the situation around you is anything but calm.
  • Follow operational procedures, chain-of-custody requirements, and quality standards as taught and reinforced through mentorship.

Learning and Growth

  • Take ownership of your own development — ask questions, study actively, and apply feedback quickly.
  • Participate in instructor-led training, internal exercises, and on-the-job mentoring designed to accelerate your tradecraft.
  • Contribute observations, ideas, and improvements back to the team — innovation is welcomed regardless of seniority.

Minimum Requirements

  • 1+ year of experience in cybersecurity, IT, or an adjacent technical field (e.g. SOC analysis, sysadmin, helpdesk, network engineering, software engineering).
  • Demonstrable, genuine interest in incident response — through study, side projects, CTFs, home labs, community involvement, or prior work.
  • Working comfort with at least one of Windows, Linux, or macOS, and a willingness to become competent across all three.
  • Basic scripting ability in Python, Bash, or PowerShell — enough to read and adapt scripts, with the appetite to grow further.
  • Clear written and verbal English; able to take notes, write up findings, and communicate professionally with teammates and clients.
  • Coachable, curious, and resilient — willing to be wrong, learn fast, and try again.
  • Calm under pressure, with a professional posture in client-facing settings.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Started or completed a relevant certification (e.g. Security+, Network+, GCIH, GCFA, GFACT, CEH, BTL1) — in progress is just as welcome as completed.
  • Hands-on exposure to EDR, SIEM, or forensic tooling, even in a learning context.
  • Participation in CTFs, security communities, open-source projects, or personal labs.
  • Background in an adjacent field — IT operations, SOC, sysadmin, network engineering, software engineering, intelligence analysis — and a clear desire to move into IR.
  • Additional languages relevant to the regions Blackpanda serves.

How You'll Grow

You will be paired with senior responders on real engagements from day one. Your development will be supported through direct, hands-on mentorship and a structured instructor-led training program — not a sink-or-swim environment.

You'll join a diverse team of teammates from around the world, where who you are, the quality of your work, and your character are what matter. Trying and failing is ok. Failing to try is not.

Why This Role

If you're early in your career, hungry to learn, and want to spend the next phase of it doing real incident response under people who will invest in your growth — this is the seat for you. We're not looking for a finished product. We're looking for the right attitude, the right aptitude, and the willingness to put in the work.

Based in San Francisco, Arine is a rapidly growing healthcare technology and clinical services company with a mission to ensure individuals receive the safest and most effective treatments for their unique and evolving healthcare needs.

Frequently, medications cause more harm than good. Incorrect drugs and doses costs the US healthcare system over $528 billion in waste, avoidable harm, and hospitalizations each year. Arine is redefining what excellent healthcare looks like by solving these issues through our software platform (SaaS). We combine cutting edge data science, machine learning, AI, and deep clinical expertise to introduce a patient-centric view to medication management, and develop and deliver personalized care plans on a massive scale for patients and their care teams.

Arine is committed to improving the lives and health of complex patients that have an outsized impact on healthcare costs and have traditionally been difficult to identify and address. These patients face numerous challenges including complicated prescribing issues across multiple medications and providers, medication challenges with many chronic diseases, and patient issues with access to care. Backed by leading healthcare investors and collaborating with top healthcare organizations and providers, we deliver recommendations and facilitate clinical interventions that lead to significant, measurable health improvements for patients and cost savings for customers.

Why is Arine a Great Place to Work?:

Outstanding Team and Culture - Our shared mission unites and motivates us to do our best work. We have a relentless passion and commitment to the innovation required to be the market leader in medication intelligence.

Making a Proven Difference in Healthcare - We are saving patient lives, and enabling individuals to experience improved health outcomes, including significant reductions in hospitalizations and cost of care.

Market Opportunity - Arine is backed by leading healthcare investors and was founded to tackle one of the largest healthcare problems today. Non-optimized medications therapies which cost the US 275,000 lives and $528 billion annually.

Momentum That Matters - In just over eight years, Arine has grown into one of the fastest-growing healthcare AI companies, serving more than 45 million members through partnerships with leading health plans nationwide. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list for two consecutive years, we're combining rapid growth with meaningful impact on the quality, cost, and outcomes of care.

The Role:

Are you passionate about improving patients' lives? Join our Clinical Care team at Arine! As a valued team member, you will utilize Arine's software platform to optimize patient outcomes, enhance patient care, and efficiently deliver our clinical services.

Under the supervision of a Clinical Support Lead, you will make outbound calls to patients, providers, and pharmacies to intervene in patient cases identified by Arine's platform. These calls may involve obtaining and accurately documenting health and contact information, scheduling appointments, resolving medication-related issues, and performing patient engagement activities. In addition, you will answer inbound customer support requests and handle other assigned duties.

This is a patient-facing, phone-based role in a call center–style environment where you will spend the majority of your day engaging with patients, providers, and pharmacies by phone. We are seeking a patient-centric, compassionate problem solver who is self-motivated, receptive to coaching and feedback, and thrives on helping others navigate healthcare challenges.

Success in this role requires strong communication skills, attention to detail in documentation, comfort working with technology, and the ability to adapt in a fast-paced environment. You will be expected to manage your workload independently while demonstrating accountability and reliability in your work. Arine fosters a metrics and feedback-driven environment where ongoing coaching is used to support individual growth, performance improvement, and development.

  • Managing a consistent volume of outbound and inbound calls while maintaining productivity and service quality
  • Meeting individual and team performance metrics related to outreach, engagement, documentation quality, and service outcomes

  • Obtaining provider contact information to facilitate the delivery of clinical interventions
  • Obtaining patient information required for clinical interventions

  • Assisting with obtaining referrals and authorizations
  • Following established workflows while remaining flexible as processes evolve
  • Taking ownership of assigned work and seeing it through to completion

Healthcare certification preferred (e.g., Certified Pharmacy Technician, Certified Medical Assistant, Behavioral Health Technician). Candidates with equivalent medical, healthcare, call center, customer service, or patient-facing experience are encouraged to apply
  • Ability to prioritize effectively and work in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of basic medical terminology and medication names (brand and generic)
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal and customer service skills, with the ability to build rapport, demonstrate empathy, and remain patient-focused during high-volume phone interactions
  • Demonstrated reliability, accountability, and follow-through
  • High attention to detail with a strong commitment to documentation accuracy
  • Comfort working in a metrics-driven environment where outcomes and quality are tracked
  • Strong computer skills, including proficiency in Google Workspace and Mac (Apple) environment, with comfort using collaboration and contact-center tools such as Slack and Five9, navigating multiple browser-based systems simultaneously, utilizing keyboard shortcuts, maintaining a high typing speed (WPM), and performing basic technical troubleshooting to stay productive in a phone-based environment
  • Comfort learning and using new technologies, including clinical software platforms
  • A team player mindset with the ability to work independently
  • Openness to coaching, feedback, and continuous learning
  • Ability to work 40 hours/week (within company operating hours of Monday-Friday, 6AM-6PM Pacific Time, with up to two rotating Saturday shifts/month)

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience with other electronic medical records
  • Experience in an ambulatory care setting, including taking medication histories
  • Experience working in a high-volume, metrics-based healthcare call center or similar patient-facing environment

Remote Work Requirements:

  • An established private work area that ensures information privacy
  • Reliable internet capable of low latency with the ability to carry video and voice calls without breaking up
  • This role is remote, but you will be required to come to on-site meetings multiple times per year. This may be during the interview process, onboarding, and for team meetings

Perks:

Joining Arine offers you a dynamic role and the opportunity to contribute to the company's growth and shape its future. You'll have unparalleled learning and growth prospects, collaborating closely with experienced Clinicians, Engineers, Software Architects, and Digital Health Entrepreneurs.

Millions of people rely on our products every month through OMRON Connect, and behind every reliable healthcare experience is an engineering platform that simply works. As our Senior Cloud Engineer, you will play a vital role in modernising the cloud platform that powers OMRON Connect, helping us build a more reliable, scalable and future-proof foundation for millions of users worldwide.

OMRON Connect connects OMRON health devices with users in nearly every country worldwide, with an AWS backend serving several million monthly active users. Much of the platform was built by external agencies and still carries legacy: manual infrastructure, scattered knowledge, inconsistent observability and release processes that make adjustments slower and chancier.

The direction is clear: Infrastructure as Code, cloud-native and event-driven architecture where it adds value, safe continuous deployment, observability by default and teams that can ship independently. We are now bringing more senior engineering capability in-house and need someone to turn that ambition into concrete technical decisions, shared standards and a roadmap that teams can own. This is where you come in ;)

Your role

You will work across the Connect engineering teams, helping them make the right technical choices while modernising a live healthcare platform. This isn’t a greenfield architecture exercise. You will need to improve the foundations without disrupting a platform used by millions, and balance technical improvements with product delivery, regulatory requirements and the realities of working across the Netherlands and Japan.

You are going to lead through influence rather than hierarchy. That means creating clarity, facilitating difficult discussions, making decisions when consensus doesn’t come, and helping engineers grow into greater ownership of their systems. You may have a home base in one team, but your scope reaches across all of them. That’s why stakeholdermanagement and -alignment are key elements in this position.

What you will be doing, among others:

Why Luscii?

Most important benefits

  • Salary: A range of €87.900,- / €93.600,- gross per year is stated for this position (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii).

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii.

  • Flexible setup: Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here. We do work from Mondays to Thursdays, as 32 hours per week is fulltime.

The ideal candidate…

… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex technical challenges, makes pragmatic engineering decisions, and is excited about helping others succeed along the way.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.

  • You have at least 6+ years of experience in cloud/backend engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical leadership role (tech lead, staff or principal engineer) where you aligned multiple people or teams around technical direction and decisions.

  • You have hands-on experience with AWS and Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) and are comfortable reviewing designs and pull requests. Experience with serverless and event-driven architectures is very valuable. All combined with experience in serverless AWS, Node.js/TypeScript tech stacks.

  • You actively coach, pair, review and share knowledge, with a focus on building ownership and seniority across the teams around you.

  • You understand what matters: the importance of making pragmatic technical choices within clear security, compliance and regulatory boundaries.

  • You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

  • English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language.

Interested? Apply now!

Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via

We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. Lead the cloud direction behind OMRON Connect, shape technical decisions across teams, and help modernise healthcare at global scale.

Third Plateau is built on a simple premise: creating lasting social good requires more than good intentions. Society’s most complex challenges are deeply rooted, interconnected, and resistant to quick fixes.

Philanthropists, foundations, and nonprofit leaders know this and are up for the challenge, bringing their passions and ambitions day in and day out. The Vice President will lead and develop Third Plateau’s high-performing Philanthropic Advising department, contribute to the growth and evolution of the team, cultivate new business, and oversee a select portfolio of client relationships and engagements. jobs.excerpt: The OpportunitySitetracker is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to help scale the go-to-market motion for Scout, our Agentic AI solution.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Sitetracker is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to help scale the go-to-market motion for Scout, our Agentic AI solution. Scout is gaining momentum in the market, and this role will sit at the intersection of Product, Sales, and Marketing to ensure we are positioning the platform effectively, supporting sales opportunities, and driving adoption across our customer base.

This is a highly technical and commercially focused Product Marketing role. You’ll need to understand the AI technology stack and translate complex capabilities into clear customer value—whether you’re helping position Scout in an active sales opportunity, developing messaging for a new capability, enabling the sales organization, or responding to a rapidly changing competitive landscape.

What You’ll Do

You’ll work directly with Sales to support active Scout opportunities, helping teams position the platform, communicate its value proposition, navigate objections, and engage executive stakeholders. At any given time, you may be partnering on 5–10 opportunities, giving you a direct connection to what customers are asking for and where our messaging is resonating.

You’ll own and evolve Scout’s messaging pillars as the product and AI market continue to move quickly. Working closely with Product, you’ll lead product marketing for new capabilities and translate technical functionality into differentiated messaging, sales enablement, and customer-facing value propositions.

You’ll partner across Marketing to develop campaigns that create demand and expand Scout adoption within our existing customer base. You’ll monitor execution and outcomes, identify where we can improve, and make recommendations based on what you’re seeing in the market and from customers.

You’ll stay close to the AI landscape, emerging competitors, and changing market sentiment to ensure our positioning remains differentiated. You’ll develop competitive and counter-positioning that equips Sales and provides actionable market insights back to the broader Product Marketing organization. You’ll also represent Scout at relevant customer and industry events, including speaking opportunities.

The Skills You’ll Have

Sales Opportunity Support & Enablement

  • You have experience directly supporting Sales teams on active opportunities for AI, technical SaaS, or similarly complex technology.
  • You can translate technical capabilities into clear business value and confidently support objection handling.
  • You’re comfortable communicating with executive-level stakeholders and helping sellers navigate complex customer conversations.
  • You’ve helped create a repeatable sales motion around an emerging or rapidly evolving product.
  • You use insights from active deals to improve messaging, enablement, and the broader GTM strategy.

AI Messaging, Positioning & NPI

  • You understand the AI technology stack and can communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and business audiences.
  • You have experience developing messaging, positioning, and value propositions for technical products.
  • You have partnered closely with Product to bring new products or capabilities to market and enable Sales around those launches.
  • You have helped shape the market narrative for a new or emerging technology category.
  • You can rapidly evolve positioning as the product, customer needs, and broader AI market change.

GTM Campaigns & Adoption

  • You have a track record of developing GTM campaigns designed to create demand or increase product adoption.
  • You understand how different GTM channels work together and can recommend the right approach based on the audience and objective.
  • You can monitor campaign execution and outcomes and use those insights to make recommendations.
  • You have built programs specifically designed to expand adoption of new products or capabilities within an existing customer base.
  • You connect campaign performance back to pipeline, adoption, and broader commercial outcomes rather than focusing solely on marketing activity.

Competitive & Market Intelligence

  • You understand the AI landscape and stay current on emerging technologies, competitors, and changing market dynamics.
  • You have experience developing competitive messaging and counter-positioning that clearly differentiates a product’s value proposition.
  • You can turn market and competitive insights into actionable information for Sales and Product Marketing.
  • You’ve operated in a fast-moving technology category where competitors and customer expectations evolve quickly.
  • You proactively identify shifts in the market and use those insights to influence positioning and GTM strategy.

Within 90 Days, You’ll

  • Build a strong understanding of Scout, its underlying technology, target customers, use cases, value proposition, and competitive landscape.
  • Establish strong working relationships across Product, Sales, and Marketing and begin directly supporting active Scout opportunities.
  • Assess existing Scout messaging, sales enablement, competitive positioning, and GTM programs to identify immediate opportunities to strengthen the motion.

Within 180 Days, You’ll

  • Become a trusted partner to Sales on active Scout opportunities, helping teams confidently position the platform and navigate customer objections.
  • Own and evolve Scout messaging and positioning as new capabilities are released and market dynamics change.
  • Establish a repeatable approach for bringing new Scout capabilities to market and enabling the field.
  • Partner across Marketing on campaigns designed to drive new opportunities and increase Scout adoption within the customer base.

Within 365 Days, You’ll

  • Built a scalable product marketing motion that enables Sitetracker to position and sell Scout effectively as the business grows.
  • Have established clear, differentiated Scout messaging that evolves alongside the product and the broader Agentic AI market.
  • Be a trusted source of customer, competitive, and market intelligence across Product, Sales, and Product Marketing.
  • Have contributed directly to increased Scout adoption and a stronger pipeline of sales opportunities through effective positioning, enablement, and GTM execution

jobs.title: System Modeling (Performance Models)
jobs.excerpt: About UnconventionalSince 2022, AI has entered the mainstream, reshaping entire industries from education and software development to fundamental consumer behaviors.
jobs.description:
About Unconventional

Since 2022, AI has entered the mainstream, reshaping entire industries from education and software development to fundamental consumer behaviors. This revolution has created an unprecedented demand for computation - a demand that is now fundamentally limited by energy, not just in the datacenter, but at a global scale.

At Unconventional, our mission is to solve this. We are rethinking computing from the ground up to build a new foundation for AI that is 1000x more efficient. We're doing this by exploiting the rich physics of semiconductors, mapping neural networks directly to the device physics rather than relying on layers of inefficient abstraction.

The Role

As a Member of Technical Staff, System Modeling (Performance Models), you will be part of a hands-on R&D team building simulation frameworks that enable evaluation and rapid iteration across all layers of unconventional physics-based computing systems for machine learning workloads. “Extreme co-design” is our guiding principle.

System Modeling is a multi-disciplinary effort, and the team we’re building reflects that. The role involves development of physics-based system models, GPU-accelerated ML system simulations, and cross-layer system integration. You don’t need to be an expert in all of these, but you have to be very strong in at least one, and solid in the rest.

Responsibilities

You will be responsible for one or more of the following tasks:

  • Building extensible and composable high-fidelity power, performance and area estimation tools for novel AI acceleration system architectures to enable rapid design space exploration.
  • Define and create comparative analyses across candidate architectures and existing state-of-art implementations.
  • Working with other teams to understand their needs for such modeling and simulation to support high level system design as well as lower level verification of hardware.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Education
    • MS/PhD in a quantitative field (AI/ML, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Applied Math), or BS with substantial, clear evidence of equivalent research/engineering depth.
  • Performance Modeling Knowledge
    • Experience with tools and development for power profiling, modeling and simulation for AI workloads.
    • Deep understanding of spatial architectures and data orchestration mechanisms
    • Deep understanding of different dataflow strategies and their tradeoffs, e.g. Weight-Stationary (WS), Output-Stationary (OS), Input-Stationary (IS) and Row-Stationary (RS).
    • Familiar with (OSS) tools for hardware accelerator design: TimLoop, Accelergy, NeuroSim, CIMLoop, CACTI, etc.
    • Familiar with different existing systolic array accelerator architectures for AI/ML workloads
  • ML and systems fluency
    • Solid understanding of modern AI/ML architectures and training/inference workflows.
    • Strong experience implementing and debugging ML models in PyTorch (preferred) or similar, with practical experience profiling, optimizing, and stabilizing non-trivial large-scale ML systems.

Preferred Qualifications

We are looking for well-rounded candidates. While the minimum qualifications focus on the core modeling and ML expertise, candidates who possess the following qualities will be the most impactful.

  • Dynamic systems knowledge
    • Basic familiarity of analog dynamic systems, including transient responses, nonidealities such as nonlinearity, quantization, random noise, and feedback/stability
  • Software engineering
    • Strong Python engineering skills: modular design, testing, packaging, CI.
    • Experience with PyTorch internals: autograd, custom modules, low-level ops; familiarity with torch.compile or similar graph capture/compile flows.
    • Experience with CUDA, Triton, or other GPU programming approaches (writing custom kernels, understanding memory hierarchy, basic performance tuning).
    • Comfort with at least some of: JAX, NumPy, TensorFlow, Modal, HPC patterns (MPI, NCCL, distributed training), SciPy.
  • Systems thinking
    • Demonstrated ability to reason across multiple layers of the stack: algorithm, software, runtime, hardware.
    • Able to connect model architecture choices to system performance implications: memory bandwidth, communication patterns, latency, energy, and numerical issues.
    • Experience applying at least some efficiency techniques (quantization, sparsity, pruning, distillation, kernel fusion, etc.).
  • Modeling / simulation mindset
    • Prior experience building or extending a serious simulation or modeling framework (could be ML systems, physics, circuits, or other technical domains).
    • Comfort with approximations and tradeoffs: you know when to use a simple model and when you need something closer to the physics.

Why Join Us?

  • The Mission: Redefine computing for the next 50 years by solving the fundamental energy limitation of AI at a global scale.
  • The Impact: Shape the company's future as a foundational team member. Enjoy massive ownership and an outsized opportunity to drive change.
  • The Challenge: Dive into deeply complex, intellectually stimulating, and unsolved problems at the cutting edge of multiple, converging fields.
  • The Perks: A comprehensive package including best-in-class health benefits, 401k matching, truly unlimited PTO, and complimentary meals when working from our Palo Alto office.

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

The Role

Leads the Content Strategy team responsible for translating business priorities, customer needs, creative concepts, and established brand direction into clear, scalable messaging and content solutions. The role directs complex initiatives and advances messaging architecture, editorial practices, audience strategy, content systems, and governance to deliver consistent, audience-centered communication across channels and customer touchpoints.

Working within the broader content and creative strategy established by senior leadership, the Senior Manager sets team priorities, applies advanced functional expertise, and partners across Brand, Product Marketing, Communications, Digital Experience, Demand Generation, Design, Motion, Technology, and Operations to improve messaging effectiveness, content reuse, customer understanding, and team performance.

  • Content and messaging strategy: Translate business, brand, customer, and creative priorities into actionable content plans, messaging frameworks, narrative structures, and audience-specific approaches across programs, products, campaigns, channels, and experiences.

  • Cross-functional partnership and influence: Coordinate the Message component of the broader Idea, Message, and Expression model; build alignment across creative and business functions; and present clear, evidence-based recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Measurement and optimization: Establish measures for messaging clarity, usefulness, quality, consistency, scalability, delivery, and customer or campaign outcomes; create feedback loops and use performance insights to refine content approaches and team practices.

  • Operational excellence: Improve intake, prioritization, planning, governance, review, and resource-management processes; balance planned initiatives with emerging needs; manage capacity risks; and increase efficiency while maintaining quality.
  • Scope and impact: Lead unusually complex work across multiple programs, audiences, products, and customer experiences, directly influencing messaging clarity, brand consistency, campaign effectiveness, customer understanding, stakeholder alignment, and team performance.

  • 7+ years of experience in Content Strategy, Editorial Strategy, Information Architecture, Messaging Strategy, or a related discipline.
  • 2+ years of experience leading content professionals, teams, or major content programs.

  • Experience developing and applying messaging frameworks and content-governance practices.
  • Experience leading complex content initiatives across multiple functions.
  • Experience improving content processes, systems, and reusable models.
  • Experience presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Experience influencing decisions across functions without direct authority.
  • Strong systems-thinking, planning, facilitation, and project-leadership capabilities.
  • Experience operating in complex and fast-changing environments.

Solutions Engineer (Radar) LVL II

OWT Global:

Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Tampa, FL, OWT Global is a small business that offers reliable and operationally proven expertise and support to the U.S. Government, industry partners, and commercial vendors. Named a Top Workplace by the Tampa Bay Times (2022-2025), OWT Global prides itself on offering exceptional, industry-leading services and solutions in a cost-effective manner for Engineering, Engineering Support, RDT&E, Technical Program and Project management, Subject Matter Expertise (SME), operations, logistics, maintenance, and training of Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS), Command, Control, Communications, Computers, Cyber, Intelligence, Surveillance, Reconnaissance, and Targeting (C5ISRT), and Air Domain Awareness and Defense (ADAD) technologies.

OWT is a proud supporting partner in the DOD SkillBridge program to ensure service members gain valuable industry work experience as the service member transitions from military to industry. The OWT Global team consists of 96% veterans, selectively recruited from the Special Operations, Special Mission Units, and Intelligence Communities with an extensive experience tailored towards supporting efforts in preparation of threats against the United States by great power competitors and by continued operational support to the United States Government in combatting the continued counterterrorism threats world-wide.

With this unique foundation of U.S. military special operations and civilian intelligence agency veterans, Engineers, and manned and unmanned aircraft pilots and maintainers, OWT Global brings a blend of skills optimized for today’s dynamic operational needs. The OWT Global model pairs technical acumen with operational applications to help drive the development and deployment of technology in a sustainable and affordable way.

Job Summary:

OWT Global is seeking a dedicated, self-driven, and experienced Solutions Engineer with operational knowledge of radars to join an OWT that partners with and assists a fast-growing company in the pre- and post-sale technical engagements of a unique compact radar. This Solutions Engineer (Radar) will work with patented technologies and powerful software across multiple industries providing technical support to the customer.

In this position, the Solutions Engineer (Radar) will execute tasks and activities in support of the customer portfolio; to include testing, validating, and integrating technology projects with a compact patented radar system and help translate operational requirements for the supported sales team and customers. This position requires a self-driven technical professional to engage in development, training, testing, evaluation, and delivery of state-of-the-art technology solutions to industry. This position is remote and includes travel up to 50% of the time.

Position Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Self-driven to be a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on newly developed radar systems by studying system documentation, documentation of testing, and post-demo analysis
  • Be a key member of the OWT Global team responsible for pre- and post-sales technical engagements supporting customer and partner relationships by presenting value of the radar products
  • Represent the customer as a highly valued technical SME to industry partners, potential customers, and government agencies showcasing the products by performing on-site demonstrations at external events, conferences, and customer sites
  • Troubleshoot radars and integrated hardware/software issues to include basic networking and Linux command line navigation
  • Help the sales and technical teams improve the radar products by translating user operational needs into requirements for system and sub-system technology developments, regularly collecting customer feedback, and interfacing with customer product managers and engineers, and creating detailed reports and After-Action Reports (AARs) to provide feedback to manufacturer
  • Lead installation planning and integration as well as execute deployment configuration, system tuning, technical support, and troubleshooting
  • Engage in the planning and execution of demonstrations and customer engagements to ensure the successful fielding and operations of advanced radar systems
  • Manage relationships with existing and potential customers and partners insuring a positive impression of the product
  • Support the customers growing customer base by developing and maintaining training materials, including application notes, and user manuals
  • Other related tasks required to fulfill the needs of the customer
  • CONUS or OCONUS travel may be required up to 50% on average

Job Requirements:

  • U.S Citizen
  • Ability to travel 50% of the time
  • Ability to lift and handle up to 50 pounds

Basic Qualifications:

  • Personal integrity, trustworthiness, and respect while representing and demonstrating the customer’s products, answering questions, and effectively communicating the value of the products
  • Solid technical foundation and good technical writing skills
  • Ability to multi-task, work independently, prioritize tasks, honor rules of engagements, and follow policies, procedures, and processes
  • Organized and detail oriented with excellent decision-making and follow-up skills
  • Positive attitude, enthusiastic, resilient, possessing analytical, reasoning, and problem-solving skills; outstanding customer communication skills with the ability to share high-level overviews and detailed explanations
  • Ability to learn and become an SME of a technical product and conveying the value of that product to potential customers
  • Ability to troubleshoot hardware and software issues
  • Must be able to regularly lift, carry, and move equipment up to 50 pounds.
  • Able to work remotely or in an office environment
  • Able to travel and work outdoors in a multi-climate environment to support customer requirements

About the role

Muon's Instrument Science team, part of our broader Electro-Optical/Infrared Instruments organization, defines the science, models and calibrates the instrument, and validates its performance, translating physics into orbital capability from concept through end of life. As our Senior Instrument Scientist responsible for Simulation, you will own the simulation and modeling that connect optical, detector, and scanner physics to on-orbit capability, drive instrument performance prediction, and build the virtual instrument and digital twin representations of our on-orbit hardware.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain end-to-end instrument performance simulations, from optical, detector, and scanner physics through predicted on-orbit capability.
  • Build and maintain the virtual instrument and digital twin representations of our on-orbit hardware, keeping them aligned with as-built performance.
  • Define flight software inputs for operating modes, sensor readout, and scanner control based on simulation results.
  • Support on-orbit performance monitoring and anomaly investigation, feeding lessons learned back into the simulation models.
  • Participate in a twenty-four-hour, seven-day on-call rotation to support on-orbit anomaly resolution. The on-call rotation is approximately one week every month and a half.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's, Master's, or doctoral degree in engineering, physics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience coding and simulating performance for imaging systems, remote sensing instruments, or comparable electro-optical hardware.
  • Experience building instrument performance models or simulations, radiometric, geometric, optical, or systems-level.
  • Software proficiency in one or more languages, such as Python, Julia, or C++, including experience writing code that others depend on, tested, reviewed, and maintained in a shared codebase.
  • Strong communication skills, comfortable translating performance predictions into requirements and trade studies across Instrument Systems, Flight Software, and Mission Systems teams.

Nice-to-have Skills

  • Familiarity with flight software concepts, such as operating modes, sensor readout, or scanner and pointing control.
  • Exposure to radiometric or geometric calibration methodology.
  • Experience with virtual instruments or digital twin architectures.
  • Experience supporting on-orbit commissioning, calibration and validation, or fleet performance monitoring and anomaly investigation.
  • Ability to apply first-principles physics to validate simulation outputs.

Salary

The salary range for this role is $158,000 - $207,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

About Muon Space

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. Our mission embraces the entire planet and we believe our team should too. Muon is dedicated to creating a diverse and dynamic company and workforce. jobs.description:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.

We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.

We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

About the Role

Location: Remote

Role Type: Full-Time

Reporting to: Chief Product Officer

Total Compensation:$200,000 - $232,000

Every CodePath learner engages our platform, whether they are a college CS student in a direct course, a student at a partner university, an alum sharpening their skills, or a working engineer retraining for the AI era. The Senior Product Manager, Learner Platform Experience owns this platform.

CodePath's courses work because they are intensive, industry-vetted, and human. The hard problem is scale. As we grow from tens of thousands of learners toward millions, the quality and effectiveness of the learner experience on the platform has to improve, not dilute. That demands an AI-First approach: clearly and thoughtfully identifying where AI can accelerate effectiveness, productivity, and scale, and where human connection and touchpoints are essential to maintain motivation, commitment, and progress. Getting that boundary right is the core judgment call of this job, and you will make it over and over.

The ownership lines are clear. Curriculum owns what we teach. The Learning team owns how it is taught, including the live classroom. You own the platform: everything a learner touches when they log in, from the course portal to asynchronous engagement between sessions to the touchpoints that keep them moving. You will collaborate closely with Learning so the platform powers great live delivery, but the platform experience is yours.

Success looks like measurable acceleration in the rate of learning, retention, and engagement, even as the number of students grows by an order of magnitude.

Two things make this role unlike most PM jobs

Learning rate is the scoreboard. Plenty of platforms can deliver content at scale. Almost none can prove their students learn faster because of them. You will be measured on outcomes, retention, and engagement, not feature velocity.

The ceiling is enormous. Every course CodePath delivers, direct or through partners, rides on the platform experience you build. As we scale to an order of magnitude of more students, your decisions compound across every learner we will ever serve.

What you'll do

  • Own the core learner platform experience across every segment: college CS students, alumni, working engineers, and students at partner institutions

  • Translate learning, retention, and engagement goals into a prioritized roadmap

  • Use AI across your entire workflow to compress weeks into days, raising the quality and the speed of what you ship

  • Own our AI-assisted learning experiences end to end, including taking the AI Tutor and AI Grader from prototype to product. These student-facing AI surfaces are yours, not shared

  • Decide where AI accelerates effectiveness, productivity, and scale, and where human connection is essential to maintain motivation, commitment, and progress

  • Collaborate with Curriculum, Learning, and Engineering: they own what is taught and how the classroom runs, you build the platform that powers live delivery and asynchronous engagement

  • Set a high bar for design quality and engaging interactions across every learner touchpoint

  • Define the metrics that prove learning rate, retention, and engagement are improving at scale, and design experiments, grounded in discovery with users, to test your biggest bets

Who you are

You are a PM who has owned products that learners or users depend on every day, and you know how to walk into something live and make it measurably better. You are deeply AI-Native and you believe great learning products are judged by what learners can do afterward.

Required

  • You have scaled a live product. You have inherited or grown something real users already depended on, raised its quality while usage multiplied, and you know the difference between launching and improving

    • Zero-to-one instincts still matter here: you will not inherit documentation, process, or a roadmap, so you know how to map what exists and chart the path forward yourself

  • AI is genuinely how you work. You can show how your workflow has changed: prototypes, requirements, and analyses you generate and pressure-test in hours, not months

  • You have built products where engagement and retention were the scoreboard, and you know how to design the loops, touchpoints, and interactions that move them

  • You hold strong opinions and you can defend them live. You bring clear, well-reasoned bets and stand behind them under pressure

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You can structure messy problems, build alignment across learning and technical teams, and drive execution with no playbook

  • You have strong analytical instincts. You define the metrics that matter and read the data to make the call

  • You write requirements engineers trust, and you can sell a product strategy to technical and non-technical audiences alike

Preferred

  • Fluency across the modern PM toolkit: product analytics (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Hex), prototyping and design (Figma, Framer), data querying (SQL), and AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar)

  • Background in edtech, learning platforms, or consumer education products, or deep working familiarity with learning science

  • Experience with AI tutoring, adaptive learning, or personalization systems

  • Founder experience or equivalent time building in a hyperscaling environment

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every qualification listed. Strong candidates often look different from what a job description imagines, and we would rather talk to someone exceptional who checks seven of nine boxes than miss them entirely.

Compensation

CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position’s level, no matter where you live. For this role, we’re hiring for an Individual Contributor level position. Total compensation is $200,000 to $232,000.

Full-Time Employee Benefits

This is a 100% remote position—work from anywhere in the U.S.! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program

  • Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection

  • Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2)

  • Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support

  • ​​Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt

  • Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings

Director, AI & CX Services
Customer Experience & AI Enablement

Company Overview

Waterfield Tech enables companies to select, design, and deploy tailored customer engagement solutions from the world’s leading providers enhanced by cutting edge Applied AI. The results are happier customers, enhanced insights, and lower costs.

Once live, we empower companies to support, optimize, and modernize those solutions and AI applications, leading to lower risk and increased efficiency. Our client-centric process and track record of success have earned the trust of clients around the world when it comes to customer interaction.

We value our people—their diversity, their dedication, and their commitment to customer satisfaction. We encourage each other. We understand the value of hard work and the importance of a healthy balance. We’re all on the same page… even though we may get there from different perspectives. All in all, it’s a pretty cool place to be and we’re growing our global team of engineers, sales professionals, and creative souls.

Position Summary

Waterfield Tech is seeking a Director, AI & CX Services to lead and grow one or more professional services delivery practices that design, implement, and modernize customer experience and contact center solutions across leading CCaaS and UC platforms and our Applied AI capabilities. The Director owns the full P&L for the practices held and is accountable for delivery outcomes, quality, growth, and the people in each practice.

Bringing deep, hands-on delivery expertise, the Director sets the delivery approach, standards, and CX modernization roadmap for the practices held, is the senior escalation and executive point of contact for customers, owns the manufacturer/partner relationships, and partners across Sales, Product, and Operations. The role leads the technical leads and engineers who deliver the practices, including any custom development/Applied AI that extends the platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead one or more AI & CX Services delivery practices end to end, accountable for delivery outcomes, quality, utilization, and margin across the practices held.
  • Own the full P&L for the practices held (revenue, margin, cost structure, headcount investment, and partner tier economics) and own the capacity to pipeline strategy and the investment that closes the gap.
  • Set and communicate the delivery strategy and CX modernization roadmap for the practices held: secure senior leadership buy-in and resources; monitor industry trends, partner roadmaps, and customer feedback; and lead organizational change (change management plans for new methodologies, technologies, and operating models) that fosters continuous improvement and innovation.
  • Lead and develop the teams within the practices held: hire, coach, develop, and retain leaders and individual contributors; set goals, run performance and career development, and build leadership depth and succession.
  • Grow the delivery capability and own the manufacturer/partner relationships for the practices held, including certifications, enablement, partner tier, roadmap alignment, and joint delivery.
  • Establish portfolio level delivery governance and roadmap and release management standards for the practices held, including cadence, health reporting, KPIs, risk and escalation management, quality gates, release readiness, and the accelerator/IP release pipeline; report progress and outcomes to senior leadership.
  • Set and own delivery standards, methodology, reference architectures, accelerators, templates, quality bars, and the implementation to support handoff and lifecycle standards for the practices held (flows/IVR, IVA/agent assist, WFO/WEM, reporting/administration, and CRM/CTI integrations); run post-mortems and lessons learned, and feed delivery insight into renewals and expansions.
  • Own resource and capacity planning across the practices held; partner with Sales on scoping, feasibility, and level of effort while protecting margin during pre-sales.
  • Serve as the senior escalation and executive point of contact for customers across the practices held; maintain executive relationships, satisfaction, and reference-ability.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, IT, Operations, and commercial, pre-sales, and proposal colleagues, bridging technical and non-technical teams to drive aligned execution of CX modernization.
  • Drive AI enablement in both directions: delivering AI solutions to customers and applying AI to delivery operations (portfolio health signals, status roll-ups, risk analysis, documentation) across the practices held.
  • Where a custom development/Applied AI capability is held, own the team that builds integrations, APIs, conversational AI, and AI-enabled applications that extend the platforms, and align its roadmap to customer and practice needs.
  • Review the customer satisfaction and delivery results (CSAT, NPS, and KPIs) for the practices held; use that data, customer feedback, and delivery metrics to identify pain points and trends and drive data driven decisions that refine delivery and the CX strategy.
  • Ensure booking, time entry, and delivery operations within Microsoft Dynamics 365/Project Operations across the practices held.

How This Role Is Measured

  • Practice P&L & economics: Gross margin and revenue vs. plan; utilization to target; cost structure vs. plan; estimate at completion/burn variance within threshold; headcount ROI.
  • Delivery execution & quality: On time delivery and schedule variance across the practices held; reduction in escalations, rework, and margin leakage; quality gate/release readiness pass rate; estimate accuracy.
  • Customer outcomes & satisfaction: CSAT/NPS trend across the practices held; executive relationship health and reference-ability; resolution and recovery of at-risk engagements.
  • People & leadership: Team retention and engagement; certification and skills growth; leadership bench and succession depth; goal setting and performance review completion.
  • Growth & capacity: Practice expansion and revenue growth vs. plan; pipeline conversion and capacity to pipeline coverage; demand forecast accuracy.
  • Partner standing: Manufacturer certifications and partner tier maintained or improved; partner sourced pipeline and joint delivery results.
  • Strategy, standards & AI enablement: Adoption of delivery standards, methodology, and accelerators; CX modernization roadmap and change initiative milestones delivered; AI in delivery adoption and impact.
  • Operational discipline: Data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of D365 booking, time entry, and delivery operations.

Primary Delivery & Technical Experience

  • Strong Five9 practice experience required, with multiple production implementations and migrations at scale (inbound, outbound, blended, Intelligent Virtual Agent (IVA), Agent Assist, WFO/WEM, Studio/IVR, reporting and VCC administration, and CRM/CTI integrations such as Salesforce and ServiceNow).
  • Zoom (Contact Center, Phone, and Workplace) and custom development/Applied AI delivery preferred.
  • All other CCaaS/UC practice areas a plus: Genesys (Cloud CX), Cisco (Webex Contact Center/UC), Avaya (Aura/AEP/ACO), and Google (Contact Center AI/Dialogflow).
  • AI enablement: Conversational AI, virtual agents, agent assist, real-time analytics, and AI-powered self-service.
  • Multi-vendor/multi-platform delivery: Combining two or more of the above with CRM, WFM, QA, and analytics integrations; legacy to cloud migration delivery.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 12+ years delivering complex CX/contact center technology services, with 5+ years leading, building, and retaining delivery teams (people leadership) accountable for delivery outcomes and margin.
  • Grounded in hands-on delivery, with career progression through implementation consultant, technical/solutions architect, or professional services/telephony (CCaaS) engineering into delivery leadership.
  • Proven track record leading CX modernization initiatives at a leadership level.
  • Demonstrated financial and practice economics acumen: margin, utilization, burn vs. plan, and estimate at completion.
  • Experience owning manufacturer/partner relationships, including certification, enablement, and partner tier management, and leading customer executive governance and recovery of at-risk engagements.
  • Software development/Applied AI engineering leadership a plus.

Leadership Attributes

  • Executive presence and people leadership: build, coach, and retain multi-team technical organizations.
  • Strong financial and operational discipline; balances growth, margin, and headcount investment while protecting delivery quality.
  • Data driven, innovative, and future oriented; turns customer and delivery data into modern CX strategy.
  • Sets strategy and standards across diverse teams and resolves cross-team tensions constructively.
  • Outstanding communication across all levels, including C-suite and partner executives; strong change management expertise; thrives amid rapid change and ambiguity.

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree required; Master’s a plus. Emphasis in Business, IT, Engineering, or a related field preferred. Equivalent work experience will be considered.

Additional Requirements

  • Manufacturer/platform certifications strongly valued across the CCaaS/UC ecosystem.
  • PMP/PgMP, ITIL, and change management credentials (e.g., Prosci ADKAR) a plus, but not required for this role.
  • Availability to work flexible hours as needed, including senior customer escalations.

Physical Requirements

  1. Sitting: Ability to sit for extended periods (up to 80% of the time).
  2. Lifting: Ability to lift or carry objects up to 10 lbs.
  3. Equipment: Frequent use of computer, telephone, and standard office equipment.
  4. Travel: Ability to travel up to 15% for client meetings, training, or installations.

The selected candidate will play a key role in a fast-paced FedRAMP team to provide comprehensive program, analytical, technical, and advisory skills to the client and supported Cloud Service Providers (CSPs). Candidates will be required to perform pre-assessment activities including a detailed analysis of the technology stacks comprising the vendor solutions. This position requires an advanced understanding of how to engineer secure, compliant, and resilient architectures and solutions. You will be part of a team working to assess vendor systems for technical compliance with NIST, FedRAMP and agency standards.

Valiant Solutions is a company that cares about its employees- we've been named one of the Best Places to Work in the Washington DC area 12 years in a row! If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

This position allows for 100% remote work. Remote work necessitates a high-level trust in our employees and we strictly adhere to the details found below in our Remote Work Policy.

Required Experience

  • Five (5) years of experience in the IT Security field
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field, OR an additional three years of IT experience required
  • Direct experience as a Security Engineer or System Architect performing analysis on FedRAMP Cloud Service Providers (CSP) architectures and control implementations (ie. 3PAO, FedRAMP program at another federal agency, etc)

  • Ability to communicate, both written and oral, to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Artifacts include, but are not limited to, vendor security assessment plans, security assessment reports, vulnerability scans, penetration tests, etc

  • Interpret FedRAMP and other agency requirements and provide vendors with guidance regarding expectations, technical requirements, and processes
  • Stay informed of updated FedRAMP guidance, industry best practices, emerging technologies, and Government cybersecurity directives, and provide recommendations to FedRAMP Government lead regarding impacts
  • Conduct security reviews of technologies for use base consideration within CSPs authorization boundary
  • Oversee and manage relationships for assigned systems that may be contractor-owned or contractor-operated, ensuring vendors comply with agency security and privacy requirements
  • Assist stakeholders with IT security-related activities to ensure project deadlines are met
  • Ensure all systems are operated, maintained, and disposed of IAW documented security policies and procedures including but not limited to Assessment & Authorization (A&A)
  • Research assigned IT security systems to provide insight into IT security architectures and IT security recommendations for assigned systems

Named one of the fastest growing privately held companies by Inc. 5000, Washington Technology’s Fast 50, and Washington Business Journal’s Best Places to Work in the D.C. area, Valiant Solutions prides itself on providing its employees with great benefits and career development opportunities. We seek people whose talents and accomplishments will contribute to a thriving company, who have the character to support their capacity, and can make a positive impact on our culture. Alongside our talented team, you’ll learn to think quickly on your feet and expand your own personal and professional skill set. Our management team will inspire you to consider new perspectives and challenge you to become a better practitioner in the fast-paced industry of IT security. We hire people we respect – and we trust them to deliver results leveraging their expertise.
