jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Fundraising / Non Profits
jobs.excerpt: About Nexcess Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist.
jobs.description:
About Nexcess

Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist. We serve businesses worldwide, from agencies scaling client sites to enterprises running mission-critical operations. We've built our reputation on deep technical expertise and genuine partnership with every client we work with. Behind every environment we manage is a team of people who take the craft seriously and keep showing up when it matters.

The Senior Product Manager – Digital Software will lead product strategy and development for the company's fundraising and donation products, serving nonprofits, charities, faith organizations, schools, and other mission-driven organizations.

This role is responsible for product strategy, roadmap development, prioritization, product performance, and client experience within the assigned portfolio. The position requires a strong understanding of digital fundraising, online payments, donor experiences, and the operational needs of organizations that rely on fundraising technology.

The Senior Product Manager will use client insights, market information, product data, and business objectives to inform product decisions and recommendations. Company-level AI strategy and broader software portfolio strategy remain under the direction of the VP of Product, with the Senior Product Manager contributing relevant client, market, and domain expertise.

The role works closely with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, Client Success, Support, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Security, payment providers, technology partners, and other stakeholders. The Senior Product Manager is expected to lead cross-functional initiatives through influence and make product decisions within established priorities, delegated authority, company policies, and applicable governance processes.

Compensation: The compensation range for this position is between $125k-$170k in the US and £95k-£150k in the UK depending on location and experience.

Responsibilities

Product Strategy and Management

  • Develop and maintain product strategy for assigned fundraising and donation products based on client needs, market conditions, product performance, business objectives, and available resources.
  • Develop and maintain product roadmaps that establish priorities, dependencies, trade-offs, investments, and expected outcomes.
  • Define and prioritize product features, capabilities, packaging, service offerings, and client experiences within established business and approval processes.
  • Evaluate competitive and market developments and incorporate relevant insights into product recommendations.
  • Manage product lifecycle activities, including enhancements, supported versions, deprecations, client transitions, and data migration considerations.
  • Identify and communicate product risks, dependencies, resource requirements, and potential client or business impacts.

Fundraising and Donor Experience

  • Develop and maintain working knowledge of the digital fundraising lifecycle, including donation forms, one-time and recurring giving, donor accounts, acknowledgements, and donor engagement.
  • Guide product requirements for fundraising capabilities such as campaigns, appeals, peer-to-peer fundraising, events, pledges, tribute giving, matching gifts, and designated funds.
  • Improve the recurring giving experience, including subscription management, donor self-service, payment recovery, and retention.
  • Partner with appropriate internal subject-matter experts to identify product requirements related to charitable receipting, tax documentation, privacy, consent, data retention, accessibility, and other applicable requirements.
  • Ensure product requirements appropriately address donor data, reporting, exports, and authorized access in collaboration with Legal, Compliance, Security, Finance, and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Define reporting and analytics requirements that support client decision-making and organizational needs.

Payments, Trust, and Security

  • Define and prioritize product requirements for payment methods, payment providers, recurring payments, refunds, disputes, chargebacks, and related client experiences.
  • Partner with Engineering, Security, payment providers, and other appropriate stakeholders to support payment reliability, fraud prevention, data protection, and security requirements.
  • Consider applicable payment, privacy, accessibility, and security requirements when developing product plans and recommendations.
  • Escalate legal, regulatory, security, privacy, compliance, or other specialized matters to the appropriate internal subject-matter experts.
  • Support product planning for periods of increased fundraising activity and client demand.

Commercial Product Performance

  • Develop product priorities that support approved client and business objectives, which may include adoption, conversion, retention, expansion, revenue, margin, and other relevant measures.
  • Develop business cases and investment recommendations that consider client value, market opportunity, anticipated business impact, costs, resources, risks, and strategic alignment.
  • Provide product input into pricing, packaging, monetization, and go-to-market decisions within established approval processes.
  • Partner with Marketing, Sales, Client Success, and other teams on product positioning, launches, adoption, and client growth.

Product Development and Innovation

  • Identify client needs, market opportunities, and potential product enhancements or new capabilities.
  • Lead client discovery, validation, prototyping, and experimentation activities with relevant client and user groups.
  • Define and prioritize initial product scope and establish measurable success criteria.
  • Balance client value, product quality, technical feasibility, resources, risks, timing, and business objectives throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Coordinate product launches and evaluate results following release.

AI and Portfolio Strategy

  • Contribute client, market, and product expertise to the company's broader AI and software strategy under the direction of the VP of Product.
  • Evaluate opportunities to apply AI and emerging technologies to fundraising experiences and workflows while considering client value, data considerations, product quality, security, and applicable company requirements.
  • Translate approved company and portfolio strategies into actionable product plans and priorities.
  • Communicate relevant product, client, and market insights to support broader portfolio planning.

Product Performance and Measurement

  • Establish and monitor product KPIs aligned with approved product and business objectives.
  • Partner with relevant teams to support appropriate product instrumentation, data quality, reporting, and performance measurement.
  • Monitor metrics such as donation conversion, recurring donor retention, payment success, product adoption, client engagement, and other relevant measures.
  • Communicate product performance, key insights, risks, and recommendations to product leadership and relevant stakeholders.
  • Use qualitative and quantitative information to evaluate product performance and inform prioritization and investment recommendations.

Client and Market Engagement

  • Engage with nonprofit organizations, fundraising professionals, agencies, consultants, donors, and client-facing teams to understand client needs and product opportunities.
  • Incorporate client feedback and experience considerations into product strategy and prioritization.
  • Monitor relevant developments in fundraising technology, nonprofit technology, payments, WordPress, and related industries.
  • Maintain productive relationships with technology, integration, payment, and other relevant external partners.
  • Represent the company and its products professionally and in accordance with applicable company policies and communications guidelines.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead cross-functional product initiatives by establishing clear objectives, priorities, responsibilities, decision-making processes, and measures of success.
  • Facilitate alignment across stakeholders and support timely resolution of product risks, dependencies, and competing priorities.
  • Communicate product strategy, priorities, decisions, and changes clearly to relevant stakeholders.
  • Build effective working relationships across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, client Success, Support, Legal, Compliance, Security, Finance, and other functions.
  • Share product knowledge and contribute to the development and continuous improvement of product management practices.
  • Provide leadership and direction within the scope of assigned responsibilities and delegated authority.
  • Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned based on organizational and business needs.

What Success Looks Like

  • Product Strategy: Establish and execute a clear product strategy and roadmap aligned with client and business objectives.
  • Client Value: Improve the experience and outcomes for organizations and donors through effective product prioritization and development.
  • Business Performance: Contribute to agreed product and business outcomes through effective planning, execution, and optimization.
  • Trust and Reliability: Support products that meet applicable company, security, privacy, accessibility, and compliance requirements in partnership with the appropriate subject-matter experts.
  • Data-Informed Decisions: Use meaningful product metrics, client feedback, and market insights to inform decisions.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Build alignment and effectively lead initiatives across functions.
  • Execution: Translate strategy into clear priorities while appropriately managing dependencies, risks, resources, and changing business conditions.

Required Qualifications

  • Significant professional experience in product management, including experience operating at a Senior, Lead, or comparable level of responsibility, scope, and decision-making.
  • Experience with fundraising, donation, payments, ecommerce, subscription, or other transactional digital products.
  • Working knowledge of online payments, including payment gateways, recurring billing, refunds, disputes, chargebacks, and payment recovery.
  • Understanding of the needs and operating environment of nonprofits or other mission-driven organizations.
  • Familiarity with product considerations related to privacy, data protection, accessibility, security, and payment processing.
  • Experience contributing to commercial product outcomes such as revenue, adoption, retention, pricing, packaging, monetization, or margin.
  • Experience defining, monitoring, and interpreting product and business KPIs.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and launching products, features, or product capabilities from concept through client availability and ongoing improvement.
  • Demonstrated ability to gather and incorporate client feedback into product strategy and prioritization.
  • Ability to understand technical concepts, including APIs, integrations, data flows, and system dependencies, and collaborate effectively with technical teams.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and building alignment among technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to clearly communicate product strategy, priorities, recommendations, and decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with WordPress and related fundraising products, including GiveWP or comparable platforms.
  • Experience working with nonprofits, charities, faith organizations, educational institutions, or other mission-driven organizations.
  • Experience with peer-to-peer fundraising, events, campaigns, recurring giving, or donor engagement.
  • Experience integrating fundraising products with CRM, donor management, accounting, marketing, or other business systems.
  • Experience with international fundraising, multi-currency payments, or regional payment methods.
  • Experience with fraud prevention and risk management for public-facing payment experiences.
  • Experience developing or managing AI-enabled product capabilities.
  • Experience working within a multi-product or software portfolio organization.
  • Familiarity with open-source software communities, contribution models, governance practices, or commercial models.
  • Experience working with distributed or cross-functional teams in a technology or software environment.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described below are representative of those that may be encountered while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of the position, consistent with applicable law.

  • This position routinely requires the ability to communicate effectively and exchange information with others.
  • The position requires regular use of a computer, keyboard, and other standard office equipment.
  • The individual may be required to remain in a stationary position and work at a desk or computer for extended periods.
  • The position may be performed in a climate-controlled office environment or an approved remote work environment.
  • The role involves managing multiple priorities, responding to evolving business needs, and meeting time-sensitive deliverables.
  • Occasional movement of office materials or equipment weighing up to 15 pounds may be required.

This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the position and its primary responsibilities, qualifications, and expectations. jobs.description:
About Us:-

Prometheum is building the market infrastructure that brings securities onto the blockchain. Our SEC-registered broker-dealer network carries a digital asset through its entire life, from issuance and distribution to qualified custody, correspondent clearing, and secondary market trading, all within U.S. securities law.

That work has put us first more than once. We became the first SEC-registered special purpose broker-dealer, and the first to trade ETH inside a traditional brokerage account. Those milestones rest on systems our engineers build every day, and we are searching for engineers like you to help us grow our team.

Role:-

Blockchain Engineer 2 - Full time W2

Salary Range:-

$130,000 - $165,000

Overview:-

As a Blockchain Engineer 2, you take ownership of a whole feature once an epic is agreed on. Epics come from the Architect and CTO, but they are shaped in team brainstorms where you are expected to bring a view, including what is happening across the blockchain and cryptography landscape and how it should change our approach. Once we have consensus, you break the work into pieces the team can pick up, get it ready to build, guide it through to release, and keep stakeholders honestly informed along the way. You will work with the Architect on technical design, with guidance from senior engineers as you grow into that part of the job.

We are a specialist team. Other teams depend on us for custody contracts, transaction signing and orchestration, and the key management that ties them together, work they cannot do themselves, so our output is measured by how well it serves those teams and the customers behind them, not by how much of it you shipped. When something is not moving, we expect you to say so early and come with options.

Our engineering team is fully remote.

Responsibilities:-

  • Build and maintain secure and optimized blockchain applications
  • Own epics end to end, from story writing and pointing through delivery and release
  • Build across many different languages taking on the large, complex problems in your team's scope
  • Report progress on your epic regularly and accurately, and raise risks before they become surprises
  • Partner with senior engineers on technical design, architecture decisions, and future epics
  • Demonstrate a passion for learning, building, and constantly improving cutting-edge applications
  • Communicate often to encourage tight and quick feedback loops and remove potential blockers
  • Use AI coding tools as a default part of your workflow, and review what they produce with the same rigor you would apply to your own code
  • Review teammates' code in a way that catches design concerns, edge cases, and test gaps
  • Work directly with neighboring systems throughout delivery, not just at the handoff
  • Investigate and resolve issues found in QA, UAT, and production

Qualifications:-

  • 3 or more years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production software
  • Strong blockchain fundamental knowledge including in-depth knowledge of top chains (i.e. Bitcoin and Ethereum)
  • Familiarity with basic cryptography commonly utilized by blockchains
  • Strong administrative/organizational skills (ability to effectively prioritize, manage time, and meet deadlines on multiple projects)
  • Automated testing as a habit rather than an afterthought
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants, plus the judgment to know when their output is wrong
  • Clear written communication with a strong command of the English language, which matters more on a fully remote team
  • Able to reason through technical disagreements with evidence, and to update your view when the evidence shifts
  • Authorized to work in the U.S. or Canada
  • Able to pass a comprehensive background check, which is required for this role

Nice to have:-

  • Experience mentoring or onboarding other engineers
  • Background in finance, brokerage, trading, or custody
  • Exposure to regulated environments and the audit trails they require
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar

How we work:-

  • Fully remote engineering. We work together in real time, with overlapping hours for pairing, reviews, and ceremonies.
  • AI-forward. We actively champion AI and tooling that ships customer value faster without giving up quality. Engineers at every level are expected to use these tools well and to bring what they find back to the team.
  • Feedback is specific and regular. Quarterly reviews, weekly 1:1s, and a candid conversation when something is not landing, not a surprise at year end.

Benefits:-

  • Health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance
  • Stock options
  • Competitive vacation time, paid sick days, and time off for observed federal holidays
  • Equipment provided

Prometheum is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.description:
Who Are We?

Decentralized Masters is at the forefront of DeFi education globally. In just two years, we have grown from a pioneering pair of co-founders to over 120 dedicated professionals. Today, we are recognized as one of the fastest-growing enterprises in the sector, with industry insiders predicting our evolution into a unicorn company by 2030. Operating on a bootstrapped model, we are on track to achieve an impressive $50 million in revenue this year alone.

Our Impact

While our growth has been remarkable, we take even greater pride in the success of our clients. To date, we have empowered over 2,000 investors to break into the DeFi world. At Decentralized Masters, we don’t just offer education; we cultivate a powerhouse of knowledge combined with an engaging community, innovative technology, and a team of leading DeFi and blockchain experts. Our commitment is to deliver unparalleled resources designed for long-term success in the world of DeFi and Web3, ensuring our members not only safeguard but also enhance their financial future.

Our Vision

Our goal is to create the largest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen, starting with becoming the gold standard in DeFi education. This vision is ambitious, transformative, and poised to change the landscape of digital finance.

Are You Ready?

This is more than just a job; it’s an opportunity to shape the future of Web3 technology and education. Are you ready to be part of our vision to redefine what’s possible in DeFi and beyond? Apply below, and let’s explore this journey together.

Check us out here:Decentralized Masters

What will you be doing?

Decentralized Masters is hiring a DeFi Analyst and Educator for long term employment who has an obsession with customer success, is eager to take massive action and lead. This is a ground floor opportunity at a DeFi educational platform. You will be working directly with the Director of Education, Product Manager and other analysts/mentors on a daily basis.

    • Lead 10 or more hour long live sessions per week teaching DeFi concepts from beginner to advanced students
    • Take responsibility, support and track the success of approximately 400 students per 6 months
    • Explain complex DeFi and crypto concepts in a ELI5 manner
    • Create research reports of various crypto projects
    • Share your knowledge of DeFi and crypto projects with the community
    • Write 2 short articles per week about DeFi, tools, projects, ecosystems and news
    • Create video content and loom recordings about various topics as needed.
    • Perform trading/technical and on-chain analysis to evaluate investments and identify trading opportunities

Requirements

What will you bring?

    • Must be able to work EST time zone OR APAC time zone.
    • Experience leading education initiatives, programs, etc.
    • Experience in fast paced environments
    • Strong exposure in the DeFi community and social media presence
    • Must be a user of DeFi
    • Comprehensive understanding of the crypto/blockchain space
    • Excellent interpersonal skills
    • Excellent emotional intelligence
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to discuss and explain technical concepts, solutions and architectures in a simplified manner
    • Extreme open-mindedness to new ideas with a mindset of continuous learning

Benefits

What do we offer you?

    • Competitive salary package - $40-108k based on your qualifications and experience
    • Ability to earn commissions - no ceiling to your earning potential
    • Claude.ai pro subscription
    • Full time/40 hours a week
    • Unlimited PTO
    • Flexible work schedule
    • Team off-sites
    • Young & dynamic culture with team members across 23+ countries
    • Fully Remote with a very supportive team. You have the ability to work from anywhere in the world!

jobs.description:
RQ10451 - 2 x Sr. Software Developer - Full Stack (JavaScript, Java, Python, API)
2 Openings - 2 different submissions preferred
1-year contract (252 business days) 1 possible extension

Security Level: CRJMC

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain full‑stack components of the digital credentials platform using modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Vue, Angular), Python, Java, HTML5, CSS3 and similar stacks.
  • Develop and extend open source Open Wallet Foundation ACA-PY, credential exchange protocols, DID resolution services, and secure messaging workflows.
  • Implement credential lifecycle features—including issuance, presentation, revocation, and IETF Status List support—aligned with W3C Verifiable Credentials and decentralized identity standards.
  • Build secure APIs and asynchronous services to support verification flows, trust framework compliance, and interoperability across issuers, holders, verifiers, and external systems.
  • Apply strong security practices, implementing cryptographic operations, secure key management, and hardware‑backed storage patterns.
  • Ensure back‑end integrations follow best practices for authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure data exchange.
  • Support front‑end user interfaces and admin dashboards that interact with credential services, ensuring usability, performance, and accessibility.
  • Develop automated tests (unit, integration, API‑level), participate in code reviews, and uphold high engineering standards across the stack.
  • Collaborate closely with architects, DevOps, security specialists, and cross‑ministry stakeholders to ensure end‑to‑end functional integrity.
  • Document system designs, workflows, schema definitions, and operating procedures to support maintainability and knowledge sharing.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, support milestone planning, and assist in troubleshooting distributed digital credential environments.

Must-Haves:

    • In-depth development experience with JWT/JWS, PKI (X.509), OAUTH2, and SHA/SHA2.
    • Build user‑facing components, dashboards, or admin consoles that interface with digital credential services using modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Vue, Node.js), Python, Java, HTML5, CSS3 and similar stacks.
    • Integrate backend systems into broader enterprise and cross‑ministry ecosystems using REST APIs, event‑driven services, and secure messaging systems.

TITLE: Associate Manager Application Support

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

The Application Support Associate Manager is responsible for providing advanced technical support and overseeing the resolution of complex incidents related to Duck Creek Technologies’ software applications. This Associate Manager-level role operates above a Senior Analyst but below a Manager, focusing on monitoring application performance, ensuring uptime, and coordinating with internal teams to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues. This role plays a vital part in maintaining seamless application functionality across the business.

Job Functions & Responsibilities:

  • Provide advanced technical support for Duck Creek applications, troubleshooting incidents and resolving complex technical issues.
  • Monitor application performance and system health to ensure continuous availability and identify potential disruptions before they impact business operations.
  • Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and QA teams to resolve escalated technical issues.
  • Lead root cause analysis for critical incidents, documenting findings and implementing solutions to prevent future issues.
  • Coordinate application updates, patches, and releases, ensuring successful deployment with minimal disruption.
  • Maintain incident logs, reports, and documentation on resolution steps to build a knowledge base.
  • Analyze and assess support requests to identify trends and recurring issues, recommending improvements to support processes.
  • Utilize performance monitoring tools to track application uptime and performance, implementing necessary changes to enhance stability.
  • Ensure adherence to SLAs by tracking and managing response times, resolution timelines, and incident handling.
  • Support cross-functional teams during application testing phases, providing insights on potential issues and operational impact.
  • Develop and maintain detailed technical documentation and operational support guides.
  • Stay current with the latest updates and functionalities within Duck Creek applications to provide effective support.

WHAT YOU’VE DONE: 

REQUIRED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in application support, IT operations, or technical troubleshooting roles.

PREFERRED:

  • Experience with Duck Creek Technologies products or similar enterprise software solutions.
  • Knowledge of IT service management frameworks, such as ITIL.
  • Experience in the insurance technology sector or other related industries.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities & Behaviors:

  • Strong troubleshooting skills, with an ability to resolve complex technical issues efficiently.
  • Knowledge of incident and problem management practices.
  • Proficiency in using application performance monitoring tools.
  • Strong understanding of IT environments, including networking, infrastructure, and cloud technologies.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical teams to resolve application issues.
  • Strong documentation and report-writing skills for recording incidents and resolutions.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Familiarity with enterprise software release cycles and deployment processes.
  • Understanding of Agile and DevOps methodologies as they relate to application support.
  • Customer service mindset, with a commitment to resolving issues promptly and efficiently.
  • Ability to escalate issues appropriately while ensuring proper resolution paths are followed.
  • Strong organizational skills, with attention to detail in tracking incidents and following through on resolutions.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across departments, including product, infrastructure, and QA teams.
  • Adaptability to new technologies and ability to stay updated on system changes and improvements.

jobs.description:
Who is American College of Education

Founded in 2005, American College of Education continues to be a leader in professional development through our online programs. The mission of ACE is to deliver high-quality, affordable, and accessible online programs grounded in evidence-based content, real-world experience and relevant application that places our students’ needs first.

ACE is a mission-driven institution continually recognized for its commitment to social responsibility and positive impact. As an Impact Institution, we believe we have a responsibility to our students, alumni, employees, communities, and society as a whole. Guided by our core values, we strive to create meaningful impact that extends well beyond our bottom line.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please note that all official communication will only come from our verified company email domain @Rippling.com

Who You Are

You are passionate about helping students achieve their educational goals. You thrive in a competitive and collaborative team environment. You are comfortable working remotely and have experience collaborating with others in a virtual environment. You possess a strong attention to detail.

American College of Education (ACE) is seeking a strategic, data-driven marketing professional who excels at creating and optimizing multi-channel lifecycle campaigns that engage prospective students and drive conversion. You leverage insights from campaign performance, application, enrollment, and start metrics to make informed decisions that improve outcomes. You are passionate about delivering consistent, brand-aligned communications across platforms, while continuously testing and refining personalized messaging, offers, and communication strategies to enhance engagement, retention, and program participation. You thrive in a collaborative environment, balancing analytical thinking with creativity to create exceptional student experiences.

Compensation

ACE is committed to paying a competitive wage while staying true to our mission of maintaining high quality, affordable programs for our students. The following contract role starts at $75.00 per hour. This position is a month-to-month contract.

What We Look for in the Ideal Candidate

  • Demonstrates self-reliance by meeting/exceeding workflow needs.
  • Demonstrates positive attitude and motivation, concern for students, teamwork, and excellent time management skills.
  • Follows established processes as outlined by organization and leadership.
  • Completes assigned duties based on daily business needs and individual skill set.
  • Consistently produces a high volume of quality work.
  • Capable, adapts as needed, to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proven ability to work independently with limited supervision and with other department personnel.
  • Must support and embrace the College’s Impact mission to improve the people and communities we serve through our civic engagement initiatives.
  • Must have exceptional communication, organization, and time management skills.
  • Must be "self-motivated" as well as creative and efficient in proposing solutions to complex, time-critical problems.
  • Must be collaborative in driving decisions and a team-player.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.
  • Builds and maintains student satisfaction.
  • Recognizes and anticipates student needs.

Day to Day Responsibilities

In this role you will wear different hats, but your skills will be especially essential in the following areas:

  • Develops, executes, and optimizes multi-channel lifecycle marketing campaigns (including email and SMS) to nurture prospective students, drive action, and ensure conversion rates are stable.
  • Evaluates and reports on key metrics for campaign effectiveness.
  • Monitors lifecycle KPIs for applications, enrollments, and starts.
  • Leads optimizations to improve lifecycle communications using data-informed decisions.
  • Ensures consistency in lifecycle communications across all communication platforms and partner to ensure brand standards are adhered to.
  • Develops testing strategies for personalized communication, including targeted offers and messages, to enhance student retention and program participation.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

  • Expertise in CRM and marketing automation platforms, including Microsoft Dynamics and Click Dimensions.

Physical Demands

The physical demand described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to communicate with and receive communications from students and ACE employees in real time using online and other electronic media.

Commitment to Culture

At American College of Education, we’re all about building a one-of-a-kind, supportive community where everyone—students, faculty, and staff—can thrive. Guided by our mission and values, we focus on everything from innovative curriculum design to personalized instruction and student support to intentional planning, inclusive initiatives, and strategic resource allocation. We’re dedicated to creating an environment that celebrates freedom of expression, diversity of thought, open dialogue, and mutual respect. We believe in fostering a sense of belonging and wellness so that every member of our ACE family feels empowered, valued, and ready to reach their full potential. Together, we’re creating a vibrant, resilient, and connected learning community where everyone matters.

Additional Notes

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Employees are increasingly integrating AI into their roles, demonstrating its potential to boost efficiency, accuracy, and productivity. By utilizing AI technologies, we can streamline processes, gain valuable insights from data, and automate routine tasks, which allows employees to concentrate on more strategic and creative aspects of their work. While AI is a beneficial tool in the workplace, if its use—such as ChatGPT, Grammarly, Copy.ai, etc.—accounts for more than 50% of any work assignments or job responsibilities, it will need to be reported to a direct leader.

You can test the speed of your connection by visiting speedtest.net. jobs.description:
Real Estate Transaction Specialist – Remote | Transaction Coordination & Closings

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Real Estate Transaction Specialist to manage high-volume single-family real estate transactions from executed contract through closing.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role with ownership across transaction coordination, contracts, title, closings, deadlines, and stakeholder communication.

You’ll manage 30–50 active transactions simultaneously, working with sellers, buyers, title companies, agents, and internal teams to keep every deal organized and moving toward closing.

What You’ll Own

Transaction Coordination & Closings

  • Manage acquisitions and dispositions from contract to close
  • Oversee 30–50 concurrent real estate transactions
  • Track inspections, title updates, financing milestones, and closing dates
  • Identify and resolve issues before they delay closing
  • Maintain clear visibility across every active transaction

Contracts & Documentation

  • Draft and manage purchase agreements, amendments, addenda, and closing documents
  • Review documentation for accuracy, completeness, and proper execution
  • Manage e-signature workflows through Dropbox Sign (HelloSign) or similar platforms
  • Maintain organized, audit-ready transaction files

Title & Closing Coordination

  • Coordinate inspections, property access, title workflows, and closing logistics
  • Work directly with title companies throughout the transaction
  • Track and help resolve liens, title discrepancies, ownership issues, and curative items
  • Ensure outstanding requirements are completed before closing

Deadline Management

  • Track contingency periods, inspections, financing timelines, and closing dates
  • Maintain a zero-miss approach to transaction deadlines
  • Proactively flag bottlenecks and transaction risks
  • Escalate issues quickly when intervention is required

Stakeholder Communication

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for sellers, buyers, agents, title companies, and internal teams
  • Provide clear and timely transaction updates
  • Follow up consistently on outstanding items
  • Keep all parties aligned through closing

CRM & Transaction Tracking

  • Maintain accurate deal records in Salesforce or similar CRM systems
  • Update deal stages, tasks, notes, deadlines, and closing statuses
  • Maintain clean pipeline and transaction reporting
  • Provide leadership with accurate status updates across active deals

Requirements

  • 8–10 years of real estate transaction coordination experience
  • Strong experience with single-family purchase and sale transactions
  • Experience managing transactions from executed contract through closing
  • Familiarity with wholesale real estate, acquisitions, dispositions, or investor transactions
  • Proven ability to manage 30–50 concurrent transactions
  • Understanding of U.S. title and closing processes
  • Experience with:
    • Salesforce or similar CRM
    • Google Sheets
    • Gmail & Google Calendar
    • E-signature platforms
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Exceptional attention to detail and deadline management
  • Comfortable communicating daily with sellers, buyers, agents, and title companies
  • Available during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Off-market acquisition experience
  • Wholesale or investor-driven transaction experience
  • Knowledge of liens, title curative work, and ownership issues
  • Background with real estate investment firms, wholesalers, iBuyers, or high-volume acquisition teams
  • Experience building transaction workflows, reporting, or operational documentation

What Success Looks Like

  • Zero missed transaction deadlines or contingencies
  • Consistent, on-time closings
  • Accurate contracts and transaction documentation
  • 30–50 active deals managed efficiently
  • Fast, professional stakeholder communication
  • Clean CRM records and reliable pipeline visibility

Key Metrics (KPIs)

  • On-time closing rate
  • Missed deadline/contingency rate
  • Contract and documentation accuracy
  • Active transaction capacity
  • Title issue resolution and follow-up
  • Stakeholder response time
  • CRM and reporting accuracy

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Real Estate Transaction Coordinator with a background in closings, title coordination, wholesale or investment real estate, and high-volume transaction management, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and take ownership of keeping deals organized, on schedule, and moving smoothly from contract to close.

jobs.description:
Software Engineer – Backend (Computer Use & Integrations) (m/w/d)

Remote job

About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

What to expect as our Software Engineer – Backend (Computer Use & Integrations) (m/w/d):

  • Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

In this role, you can make an impact and grow with us as Software Engineer

You'll help build Recare's Operator, our agent that gets AI-generated clinical output into hospital systems by operating their existing software the way a person would, no bespoke interface required. It's the sharp end of our integration strategy: a Windows desktop application that automates UI interactions with hospital systems, running on doctors' devices and often inside RDP or Citrix environments. The first version is already live – you'll help expand its capabilities and make it reliable in production.

  • You build and improve integrations between hospital systems and Recare products.

  • You implement and harden computer-use automation flows so they work reliably in production, including edge cases, recovery, and safety rails.

  • You partner with clinical domain experts to turn ambiguous workflows into shippable plans and robust implementations that solve real customers' needs.

  • You contribute across the stack as needed, including our Go-based gateway.

  • You invest in observability foundations (logs, metrics, traces) so we can trust the system in production.

How we work:

  • AI-native – our engineers reach for frontier coding agents every day to move fast across the whole stack, and we want strong, opinionated views on how to wield them well.

  • Frontier models – we build on the best models available and adopt new capabilities as they ship, not a release later.

  • Human-in-the-loop by default – this is healthcare: AI proposes, people stay in control, and we design the approval and validation loops that make that real.

  • Unglamorous foundations – engineers get the time to build the eval harnesses, guardrails, and observability that make AI trustworthy in production, not just the feature on top.

  • Ship and observe – always deployable, telemetry-driven, fix in the open.

Requirements

Here's how we picture you as our Software Engineer

  • You're a builder with a hacker mindset: you default to building rather than waiting, and you're solution-oriented rather than problem-oriented.

  • You have professional backend experience in Go, Python, or TypeScript, and you can point to production software you shipped and owned.

  • You're comfortable working on integration-heavy systems: APIs, workflows, data models, auth, and real-world edge cases.

  • You're pragmatic about reliability: you care about monitoring, debugging, test coverage, and making systems operable.

  • You're excited to use AI coding agents daily and have opinions on how to use them effectively.

  • You're ambitious but frustration-tolerant. Hospital IT is complicated and progress is hard-won; you stay relentless, get your hands dirty, and iterate until it works.

  • You communicate confidently in English and collaborate well across Product, Engineering, and Operations.

Nice to have:

  • German language skills.

  • Experience with Electron or TypeScript on the desktop side.

  • Experience with healthcare IT systems (HIS, KIS, PVS, EMR) and interoperability standards such as HL7 v2 or FHIR.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Associate Press Secretary

Department: Communications

Location: Remote (Preferred MST or PST locations)

Reports To: Regional Director of Communications

Supervises: None

Context: At the Sierra Club, we believe in the power of interdependence. Together, we remain committed to the fight for a healthy climate built on a foundation of environmental, racial, economic, and gender justice – a future where all people benefit from a healthy, thriving planet and a direct connection to nature. As the climate crisis and deeply entrenched systemic racism all fuel injustice, we will continue to fight for a bold, transformational agenda that recognizes the interconnectedness between our planet, our humanity, and our future. By recognizing that our destinies are tied, we continue to name that all things are fundamentally connected, and the overlap between ecology, race, gender, and representative government will move to either advance our collective humanity or to oppress it. Sierra Club has close to 700 staff across the country and a network of 64 local chapters that are led and fueled by thousands of volunteers. We are also proud to be a unionized employer, with three labor unions representing more than half of our employees.

Scope: The Associate Press Secretary coordinates and executes communications strategies on key priorities determined in collaboration between themselves, their manager, and the Regional Field Director relating to the Sierra Club’s Energy and Conservation work in a set portfolio of states as designated on the Regional Turf Map. Any changes to the Regional Turf Map will be discussed and agreed upon in writing. Working with local staff, volunteers, and intersectional partners, the Associate Press Secretary is responsible for developing and disseminating strategic narratives that advance Sierra Club’s goals while remaining rooted in our organizational values: balance, collaboration, justice, transformation, and anti-racism To support that work, the Associate Press Secretary coordinates the development of creative assets to inform and influence decision makers; project manages the creation and distribution of advertising, videos, and other produced media; drafts and edits written content; and ensures messaging resonates effectively with various audiences.

This position is responsible for an array of media communications, ensuring timely and accurate materials with a consistent tone and message. A key component of the Associate Press Secretary’s role is leading media outreach by organizing press conferences and other media events; coordinating the submissions of op-eds and letters to the editor; pitching stories; tracking and reporting coverage; compiling data; and nurturing relationships to grow a diverse bench of spokespeople.

The ideal candidate should have a solid grasp of Sierra Club’s legacy conservation work, a conversational understanding of climate and environment issues, a personal commitment to and knowledge of social justice, and a passion for advancing progressive social change. They will also have the ability to articulate and reinforce the intersections of Sierra Club’s legacy work and communicate the challenges and opportunities we face, centered on justice and equity.

Job activities include but are not limited to:

  • Plan and implement communications strategy for the Sierra Club in a portfolio of states. Serve as liaison across internal teams and committees, as well as with external partners and stakeholders, to advise on communications strategies and tactics. Track media coverage of relevant issues. Develop and execute long-term and rapid-response media outreach plans to advance narratives and outcomes in a portfolio of states in adherence to the Jemez Principles for Democratic Organizing.
  • Develop messaging, written, and produced assets to advance Sierra Club goals in collaboration with state teams. Develop media messages, op-eds, press releases, video/audio, talking points, and other materials, and coordinate media events as necessary. Work with federal press secretaries to localize federal agency media opportunities.Create strategic media responses to relevant reports, Environmental Law Program work underway, and other external developments.
  • Contributes to staff strategy meetings, and stays current on substantive and political developments in major conservation campaigns by reading latest literature, attending meetings and maintaining contact with relevant sources.

  • Build relationships with local, regional, and trade reporters and influencers. Serve as a point of contact for those reporters in order to advance media coverage. Pitch relevant stories and connect reporters with spokespeople

  • Train and coach state-based staff and volunteers in strategic communications skills. Identify, train, and place compelling spokespeople. Support staff, volunteers, and partners with media training, messaging guidance, and interview preparation.

The successful candidate must have the following skills and experience:

    • Experience with media relations. You have professional experience as a journalist, media liaison, spokesperson, press secretary, or other position involving public relations. You have an understanding of best practices for using media to advance Sierra Club goals.

    • Excellent writing and verbal communications skills. You are a strong writer and communicator who is comfortable interacting with reporters, developing compelling messages, and drafting written materials for various audiences.

    • Ability to interact cooperatively and effectively with internal and external partners. You think collaboratively and can build strong relationships with staff, volunteers, and other stakeholders. You are capable of navigating challenging dynamics to achieve shared goals.

    • Committed to evolution. You are committed to continuously deepening and evolving your own understanding of systems of oppression through study, openness, and humility. And you easily recognize your own relationship to privilege and power, examining and shifting your behaviors as appropriate.

    • Uplifting and additive. You see mistakes as opportunities for growth; problems as catalysts for solutions, and inspire others along the journey. You carry a constructive approach, can-do attitude, a sense of humor, and authentic kindness wherever you go.

The strongest candidates will also demonstrate the following experience, skills, and competencies:

    • Demonstrated knowledge of energy, lands, and/or climate issues and relevant media landscape

    • Experience executing creative tactics including audio/video, podcasts, projections, murals, performance art, and advertising

    • Ability to build alignment between stakeholders while project managing competing priorities

    • Proficiency with Cision and/or other media outreach and tracking tools

    • Spanish language proficiency preferred

To Apply

The Sierra Club provides equal employment and advancement opportunities to all staff members. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, lived experience and skills. The Sierra Club does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, immigration status, socioeconomic status, ancestry, age, size, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, familial status, veteran status, disability, AIDS/HIV status, medical condition, prior conviction, arrest history, traits historically associated with race, including, but not limited to, hair texture and protective hairstyles, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The Sierra Club values applicants who are people that identify as Black, Indigenous, and other minoritized groups; women; queer, transgender, gender non-conforming, and gender fluid people.

Explore, enjoy and protect the planet.

Applications will be accepted through Monday, October 12.

Job Description

RCM Coding Supervisor

Job Summary

The Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Coding Supervisor is responsible for overseeing coding operations and ensuring the accuracy, quality, compliance, and efficiency of physician coding activities. This role serves as the primary liaison between VillageMD, outsourced coding vendor(s), providers, and internal stakeholders to support compliant coding and billing practices. The Coding Supervisor provides leadership, guidance, auditing, reporting, and process improvement oversight to optimize coding performance and mitigate organizational risk while ensuring adherence to federal, state, payer, and organizational requirements.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Coding Operations & Vendor Oversight

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for outsourced coding vendor(s), providing direction, performance feedback, and ongoing operational support.
  • Monitor vendor productivity, quality, service levels, and turnaround times to ensure contractual and organizational expectations are met.
  • Conduct routine audits and quality reviews to verify accurate assignment of Evaluation and Management (E/M) levels, CPT-4, and ICD-10 diagnosis codes.
  • Collaborate with providers and clinical teams regarding documentation requirements and coding best practices.
  • Identify coding trends, operational risks, and opportunities for process improvement.

Compliance & Quality Assurance

  • Develop, implement, and maintain coding policies, procedures, and documentation standards aligned with organizational strategy and regulatory requirements.
  • Research, interpret, and communicate coding and billing regulations, payer requirements, and compliance guidelines.
  • Investigate coding concerns, denials, and compliance-related inquiries, providing recommendations and resolution strategies.
  • Partner with Compliance, Revenue Cycle, Clinical Leadership, and Operations teams to ensure coding practices meet regulatory and organizational standards.
  • Maintain current knowledge of industry changes, including Medicare regulations, payer policies, National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) edits, and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs).

Reporting & Performance Management

  • Analyze claims, audit, and coding performance data to establish benchmarks and identify coding vulnerabilities.
  • Prepare and present audit results, compliance findings, and operational reports to leadership.
  • Develop corrective action plans and monitor effectiveness through ongoing audits and follow-up reviews.
  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to coding quality, accuracy, productivity, and compliance.

Leadership & Team Support

  • Provide day-to-day guidance, coaching, and support to coding staff and vendor partners.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, teamwork, and customer service.
  • Assist with onboarding, training, and education initiatives related to coding and documentation requirements.
  • Promote professional and respectful communication across all levels of the organization.
  • Demonstrate compassion, professionalism, and adherence to company policies and procedures in all interactions.

Qualifications

Education

  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent required.
  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in a healthcare-related field preferred.

Certifications

  • Current Certified Professional Coder (CPC) or Certified Coding Specialist-Physician Based (CCS-P) certification required.
  • Certified Professional Medical Auditor (CPMA) or additional coding/compliance certifications preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum of 3 to 5 years of physician coding experience required.
  • Previous experience conducting coding audits and supporting compliance initiatives required.
  • Supervisory, team lead, vendor management, or project leadership experience preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Expert knowledge of physician coding principles, including Evaluation and Management (E/M) services.
  • Strong understanding of CPT®, ICD-10-CM, HCPCS, National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI), and Medicare Local Coverage Determination (LCD) guidelines.
  • Knowledge of healthcare compliance, payer regulations, and reimbursement methodologies.
  • Proven analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across departments.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to perform repetitive tasks, including keyboard and computer use.
  • Manual dexterity sufficient to operate standard office equipment.
  • Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods.
  • Occasional standing, walking, and reaching may be required.

Work Environment

  • Primarily office or remote office environment.
  • Frequent use of computer systems, coding software, and reporting tools.
  • May require participation in meetings and training sessions with internal and external stakeholders.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Provides oversight and direction to outsourced coding vendor(s) and may provide functional supervision, training, coaching, and performance feedback to coding team members as assigned.

We are Skyward.

That is, a love for people, for improvement, for human advancement through information technology. We are a people-centered business with a desire to serve others. We are diverse and unified; creative and collaborative; a collection of complementary, not competing talents. And though on the surface we remain relaxed, beneath, a torrent of energy links us to our civic tech mission.
We stand by our values, and we won’t compromise on any of them.
Integrity: We’re conscientious, intentional, and empathetic. Our words and actions align. That’s our character. Please don’t ask us to play another part, we’re poor actors.
Compassionate: If we may borrow a quote from Theodore Roosevelt: “No one cares how much you know until they know how much you care.” Because our team is thoughtful and supportive, caring deeply for each other, our clients, and our work, this comes naturally.
Inquisitive: We remain students by failing openly and turning lessons into solutions.
Unconventional: For us, life isn’t what happens outside of work. Work happens inside of life and our culture erases the line often dividing the two.
Authentic: Made possible only because we embody the values listed above. We’re relaxed and fun yet intensely curious and driven. Team members are placed with thought, care, and precision to ensure that Trust, Truth, and Transparency continue to represent our brand.
Because of that, we continue Onward, Upward, and Skyward.

We need a Software Engineer who does it all.

Would your friends say you can dissect a complex problem until it quietly gives up? Have you been told (more than once) that you care suspiciously much about modernizing the crusty old systems powering public services ? Good. We’re not bored, we’re impressed.

Here’s the thing: we don’t want an engineer who only writes code and tosses it over the wall. We want the rare one who writes it, automates the pipeline that ships it, and builds the tests that prove it works, and then sleeps soundly because of it. If you believe “done” means tested, deployed, and monitored (not “it runs on my laptop”), then we want you.

Come join us if you're motivated to learn from others, to learn from mistakes, to be part of a future-looking and growth-oriented team.

Let's go Skyward together.

What you’ll do:

  • Build things that matter.Write effective, scalable code supporting CMS as it merges systems into one AI-driven platform - reducing manual effort, improving data accuracy, and bringing cutting-edge NLP and LLM techniques to public services.
  • Automate all the toil.Own CI/CD pipelines end to end, automating build, test, and deployment workflows with tools like Jenkins, plus Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) so deployments are boring in the best possible way.
  • Test like you mean it.Build and maintain automated test suites - unit, integration, regression - wired straight into the pipeline as quality gates, and provide real test-coverage analysis instead of crossed fingers.
  • Containerize and ship.Package and deploy workloads with Docker (and friends) for repeatable, scalable, what-you-build-is-what-you-run environments.
  • Hunt the bugs.Investigate and debug test failures throughout the lifecycle, update tests or file bugs as needed, and keep the build green and honest.
  • Bake in security.Integrate code-quality checks and security gates (think SonarQube, Snyk) into the pipeline so problems get caught before they ship, not after.
  • Design with humans in mind.Work closely with human-centered design experts to build solutions that are intuitive, responsive, and personalized to each user’s needs.
  • Make things faster.Develop and tune back-end components to improve responsiveness and overall performance.

What we’d like you to have:

  • 3–5 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with strong coding chops in Python (and friends).
  • Real DevOps / DevSecOps / DevTestOps experience. You know CI/CD isn’t a buzzword; you’ve actually automated build, test, and deployment workflows.
  • Test automation skill. You’ve built automated tests and integrated them into pipelines with code-quality checks and security gates, not bolted them on at the end.
  • A feel for good pipelines. Scalable, maintainable, and integrated with testing frameworks. You know, the kind that make the whole team faster.
  • Containerization experience (Docker or Kubernetes) and comfort with REST APIs.
  • Fluency in an agile flavor or two - Scrum, Lean, or SAFe.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively across a busy mix of stakeholders.

What would blow us away:

  • You’ve got AI chops, experience with NLP, LLMs, or ML-driven applications.
  • You’ve previously supported CMSor another federal agency.
  • Bonus unicorn pointsif you’ve worked inside a FISMA boundary or supported an ATO/cATO effort.

    • Even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply. At Skyward, we’re focused on hiring individuals with the right skills and passion to grow, not just checking off every box.

And now the important part. What we offer you:

  • Medical, dental, vision insurance
  • 15 days of paid leave
  • 7 days of sick leave
  • 2 days bereavement leave
  • 11 paid Federal holidays
  • Up to 40 hours for jury duty
  • 401K with 4% employer contribution (and no vesting period)

  • Company provided laptop
  • $5,000 per year for professional development
  • $600 per year for technical supplies and equipment
  • $2,000 referral bonus
  • Life and disability insurance
  • HSA and FSA
  • Legal Shield and ID Shield Voluntary Benefits
  • Opportunity to work in a collaborative, motivated team focused on modernizing government services with cutting-edge technology and innovative solutions. Who says government work can't be exciting!
At Skyward, we support flexible working hours and remote opportunities to help maintain a healthy work-life balance for all employees.
Offers of employment with Skyward are contingent upon acceptable results of a background investigation.

Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).

Scoping

Executing

The role is accountable for the reliability, security, scalability and maintainability of our Salesforce estate, with particular focus on Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and the APIs and integrations that connect Salesforce to Slack and other enterprise platforms. You will balance rapid delivery with strong governance, helping the organisation get more value from Salesforce without increasing operational or security risk.

What you will be accountable for

1. Team leadership and operating model

  • Lead and develop the Salesforce team, setting clear priorities, standards and expectations while creating an environment of ownership, learning and constructive challenge.

  • Act as the senior escalation point, providing calm, evidence-led direction during incidents, complex delivery decisions and stakeholder conflicts.

  • Shape the team operating model, including capacity planning, work allocation, skills development, recruitment support and the effective use of specialist partners.

  • Build sustainable capability, through coaching, documentation, peer review and reducing dependency on individual team members or external suppliers.

2. Salesforce platform ownership

  • Own the health and evolution of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud, ensuring the platform supports commercial, customer-service and operational processes effectively.

  • Set and enforce platform standards, covering configuration, automation, data models, naming conventions, documentation, testing and technical debt.

  • Remain hands-on where needed, including complex Flow automation, permissions, validation rules, objects, page layouts, Lightning pages, reports, dashboards, analytics and troubleshooting.

  • Own day-to-day system administration, including user administration, joiner/mover/leaver processing, delegated administration and routine platform hygiene.

  • Configure and maintain Experience Cloud portals, including external sharing rules, guest user access, community settings, and partner- or customer-facing experiences.

  • Maintain a clear platform roadmap that balances strategic improvements, regulatory or security obligations, operational resilience, and business demand.

  • Control platform lifecycle changes, including Salesforce seasonal releases, feature adoption, deprecations, sandbox strategy and environment management.

  • Evaluate and deploy AppExchange packages, assessing them against business requirements, security review status, licence cost, support model and long-term maintainability.

3. Integrations, APIs and operational monitoring

  • Own the operational oversight of Salesforce integrations, including interfaces with Slack and other core enterprise applications.

  • Administer and maintain key business integrations.

  • Establish effective Slack API monitoring to cover authentication failures, token or certificate expirations, API errors, rate limits, latency, message delivery failures, and unexpected usage patterns.

  • Define monitoring and alerting standards, with meaningful thresholds, named owners, support runbooks, escalation paths and service-level expectations.

  • Protect integration reliability by overseeing connected apps, OAuth scopes, named credentials, integration users, event-driven services and API consumption.

  • Lead incident response and problem management, ensuring root causes are understood, corrective actions are completed and recurring failures are designed out.

4. Security, access and control posture

  • Own the Salesforce security posture, working with Security, IT and Risk teams to maintain proportionate, auditable controls.

  • Design and maintain the org-wide sharing and security architecture, including organisation-wide defaults (OWD), role hierarchy, sharing rules, permission sets and permission-set groups, and field-level security.

  • Apply least-privilege access, with appropriate segregation of duties and regular remediation of accumulated or excessive entitlements.

  • Govern identities and privileged access, including SSO and MFA (working knowledge of Okta or a comparable identity provider), service accounts, integration users, delegated administration and joiner/mover/leaver controls.

  • Lead regular security audits and access reviews to evidence least-privilege compliance and drive timely remediation of findings.

  • Partner with IT and Security on platform audits and compliance, including SOC 2 and GDPR obligations, control evidence and audit response.

  • Review platform risk signals, such as login anomalies, API usage, configuration changes, installed packages and connected-app behaviour, using the monitoring capabilities available in the Salesforce estate.

  • Protect sensitive information through sound data-access design, retention controls, masking or anonymisation in non-production environments, and responsible vendor access.

5. Licensing, certificates and lifecycle management

  • Optimise licence usage and forecasting across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud, including reharvesting, right-sizing and renewal input.

  • Monitor and manage certificate lifecycles, including SSL and SAML signing certificates, to prevent avoidable authentication or integration outages.

  • Manage connected app and OAuth lifecycles, with a maintained inventory, named owners, expiry tracking and proactive renewal ahead of failure.

  • Provide clear cost and entitlement visibility, so licence, package and integration spend is understood, challenged and aligned to realised value.

6. Delivery, release and DevOps

  • Own a transparent and prioritised delivery backlog, working with business stakeholders to clarify outcomes, value, dependencies and acceptance criteria.

  • Maintain disciplined release management, with source control, peer review, automated or repeatable deployment, regression testing, rollback planning and release communications.

  • Execute version-controlled releases through GitHub, using branch strategy, pull requests, peer approval and traceable change history as the standard route to production.

  • Maintain documentation for all configuration and change management, so the estate remains understandable, auditable and supportable by more than one person.

  • Improve platform support, using clear service measures, triage processes, knowledge articles, problem records and trend analysis.

  • Manage technical debt deliberately, making risks and trade-offs visible and ensuring remediation is planned alongside new demand.

  • Partner effectively with vendors, holding delivery partners to clear outcomes, quality standards, documentation and knowledge-transfer commitments.

7. Data quality and platform insight

  • Champion trustworthy Salesforce data, including ownership, validation, duplicate management, integration reconciliation and remediation of recurring data-quality issues.

  • Provide actionable platform insight, using dashboards and regular reporting on adoption, automation failures, API consumption, incidents, release quality, access risk and technical debt.

  • Support sound architecture decisions, challenging unnecessary customisation and promoting maintainable, scalable use of standard Salesforce capabilities and enterprise-level data modelling.

8. AI, Agentforce and emerging capabilities

  • Help evaluate and safely adopt Agentforce, Salesforce AI capabilities and adjacent enterprise AI tools where they can improve employee or customer outcomes.

  • Support responsible AI governance, including data access, grounding, human oversight, prompt and agent testing, monitoring, auditability and change control.

  • Contribute practical experience with Claude or comparable models, especially where AI services interact with Salesforce, Slack, knowledge content, workflows or customer data.

  • Separate experimentation from production readiness, ensuring AI-enabled solutions meet the same security, reliability and support standards as other business-critical capabilities.

Leadership behaviours

  • Service-minded ownership: you treat Salesforce as a critical business service, not simply a collection of projects.

  • Wise pragmatism: you balance speed, usability, maintainability, cost and risk rather than optimising for only one dimension.

  • Constructive challenge: you can say no, or not yet, with clear evidence and a practical route forward.

  • Calm accountability: you take ownership when problems arise without creating blame or hiding uncomfortable facts.

  • Enabling leadership: you give people clarity and support while building their confidence, judgement and independence.

  • Clear communication: you make technical issues understandable and keep stakeholders informed before uncertainty becomes surprise.

Key working relationships

The role will work closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, Customer Service, Finance, Security, Enterprise Architecture, IT Operations, Data and Integration teams, as well as Salesforce and specialist implementation partners.

Essential

  • 7+ years as a Salesforce Administrator in large, multi-team environments, with substantial hands-on responsibility for administration, configuration and operational support in a complex production environment.

  • Salesforce Administrator certification (required).

  • Proven people leadership, including line management, coaching, performance support, work prioritisation and development of Salesforce administrators or platform specialists.

  • Deep practical knowledge of Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, including their security, automation, data and service-management implications.

  • Deep Salesforce security expertise, covering organisation-wide defaults, role hierarchies, sharing models, permission sets, field-level security, identity, privileged access, connected apps and audit controls.

  • Hands-on Experience Cloud capability, including external sharing models, guest access and community configuration.

  • Proven Salesforce DevOps and change-management experience using GitHub, including version-controlled deployment workflows, pull-request review and release governance.

  • Experience operating API-led integrations, including monitoring, troubleshooting, authentication, limits, failure handling and coordination across technical teams.

  • Experience managing SSL and authentication certificates and maintaining integration health.

  • Strong declarative delivery capability, particularly Flow, data modelling, validation, Lightning configuration, reporting and environment management.

  • Sound release and change-management experience, including sandbox strategy, source control, testing, deployment governance and production support.

  • Confident stakeholder management, with the ability to translate between commercial priorities, user needs, technical constraints and risk.

  • Strong solution and design judgement, with a good understanding of platform architecture and enterprise-level data modelling.

Desirable

  • Salesforce Advanced Administrator certification (preferred), or other relevant credentials such as Platform App Builder, Service Cloud Consultant or an appropriate Agentforce/AI accreditation.

  • Experience administering Ironclad, Qualtrics and Slack CRM / Sales Elevate, or directly comparable CLM, survey and Slack-CRM tooling.

  • Agentforce or Salesforce AI experience, including agent design, grounding, guardrails, evaluation or operational monitoring.

  • Experience with Claude or other enterprise AI platforms, particularly in governed, data-sensitive business workflows.

  • Experience with Slack platform capabilities and APIs, including enterprise integrations, apps, workflows, authentication and observability.

  • Working knowledge of Okta or a comparable enterprise identity provider.

  • Exposure to complementary enterprise platforms, such as NetSuite, MuleSoft, Celigo, Boomi, Workato, Zapier, identity providers or data platforms.

  • Experience in a SaaS, technology or high-growth environment, where Salesforce supports complex B2B go-to-market and customer-service processes

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.

More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (www.cint.com)

Additionally, in a world of AI, we want our candidates to understand our approach to the use of AI during the interview and hiring process, so we'd appreciate you reading our AI usage guide.

Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.

We are feeding the world’s curiosity!
