We've built our reputation on deep technical expertise and genuine partnership with every client we work with. Behind every environment we manage is a team of people who take the craft seriously and keep showing up when it matters.

Overview

Nexcess is building a unified implementation organization to own the customer journey from signed deal through successful go-live across all three business units.

We have implementation and migration resources in place today, but the current model is fragmented, inconsistent, and difficult to measure. The quality and duration of an implementation can vary significantly depending on who owns the project, and our current metrics do not provide a reliable view of how long it actually takes customers to reach value.

The Senior Director of Implementations will inherit the existing implementation and migration teams with an explicit mandate to dismantle the current structure and rebuild it as a single, scalable organization serving all three business units.

This leader will own the full post-sale implementation journey, including migrations, and establish a common implementation standard with distinct delivery motions underneath it. They will determine the appropriate balance between human-led implementation and self-service based on delivery economics, customer complexity, and time-to-value.

This is both an operational and transformational leadership role. The successful candidate will build the organization, establish reliable measurement, implement the tooling and processes required to scale, and create a foundation that can ultimately support a professional services revenue stream.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full post-sale journey from signed deal through successful customer go-live, including customer migrations.
  • Rebuild the existing implementation and migration teams into a single organization serving all three business units.
  • Establish one shared implementation methodology, operating standard, and set of quality expectations across the organization, with distinct delivery motions based on customer and product requirements.
  • Assess the existing team structure and redesign organizational structure, roles, responsibilities, staffing levels, and reporting lines as needed.
  • Build and execute a hiring, leveling, and career development strategy for the implementation organization.
  • Establish reliable measurement and reporting for implementation performance, recognizing that current data and metrics are not sufficiently reliable to inherit.
  • Define and own key performance indicators including time-to-value, migration success rate, implementation duration, and first-90-day churn.
  • Establish trustworthy baseline metrics within the first 90 days and create an ongoing operating cadence around implementation performance.
  • Select, implement, and manage the tooling stack required to operate the function at scale, including PSA, project management, ticketing, and related systems.
  • Define the appropriate threshold between human-led implementation and self-service based on delivery economics, customer complexity, product requirements, and expected customer outcomes.
  • Develop standardized processes for scoping, project kickoff, implementation, migration, escalation, and go-live.
  • Design a fast, customer-friendly sign-off process for complex or high-risk deals, allowing the business to move quickly while identifying situations where implementation risk is genuinely unacceptable.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Solutions Architecture, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Support to ensure commitments made during the sales process can be delivered successfully.
  • Define automation requirements and work with Engineering to prioritize and deliver the automation needed to reduce implementation effort and improve scalability.
  • Influence and drive outcomes through teams outside of direct management, particularly Engineering, Product, and other shared functions.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce implementation costs, improve customer time-to-value, and increase the percentage of implementations that can be delivered through standardized or self-service motions.
  • Establish a consistent executive-level view of implementation capacity, pipeline, delivery risk, customer outcomes, and organizational performance.
  • Develop the business case for evolving implementations from a primarily cost-center function into a professional services revenue stream where the economics and customer value support it.
  • Establish the operating model, pricing considerations, service definitions, and delivery economics necessary to evaluate and potentially build a professional services offering.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Success Looks Like

  • A single, unified implementation organization operates consistently across all three business units.
  • Implementation quality is consistent regardless of which team or individual owns the project.
  • Reliable data exists for implementation duration, time-to-value, migration success, and first-90-day churn.
  • Time-to-value and implementation efficiency improve without sacrificing customer outcomes.
  • The organization has a clear structure, appropriate staffing levels, defined career paths, and a scalable hiring plan.
  • A standardized implementation methodology and operating cadence is adopted across the organization.
  • The tooling stack provides reliable visibility into project status, capacity, risk, and performance.
  • Clear criteria exist for when customers receive human-led implementation versus a self-service experience.
  • Complex deals have a fast, well-defined sign-off process that protects the business without unnecessarily slowing sales.
  • Engineering and other shared teams are effectively engaged in building automation and capabilities defined by the implementation organization.
  • Implementation costs become increasingly predictable and scalable.
  • A credible business case exists for generating professional services revenue from implementation capabilities where appropriate.
  • First-90-day customer outcomes improve, including a reduction in early-life churn.

Required Qualifications

  • Significant leadership experience building, scaling, or rebuilding a professional services, implementation, or migration organization.
  • Experience in hosting, cloud infrastructure, B2B SaaS, or a closely related technology environment.
  • Demonstrated experience leading implementation or professional services delivery for mid-market and enterprise customers.
  • Experience managing organizational transformation, including redesigning teams, processes, operating models, and delivery methodologies.
  • Strong understanding of implementation economics, capacity planning, project delivery, and customer time-to-value.
  • Experience establishing operational metrics and building reliable reporting in an environment where existing data may be incomplete or unreliable.
  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to understand the economics of implementation and professional services.
  • Experience selecting or implementing PSA, project management, ticketing, or similar operational tooling.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to drive outcomes through teams and leaders outside of their direct organization.
  • Comfortable working closely with Sales and Solutions teams to assess implementation complexity and establish appropriate deal sign-off processes.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Services.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance customer experience, delivery quality, operational efficiency, and commercial outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience transitioning an implementation or professional services organization from a cost center toward a revenue-generating model.
  • Experience designing self-service versus human-led delivery models.
  • Experience leading migrations in cloud, hosting, infrastructure, or SaaS environments.
  • Experience implementing automation or product-led improvements to reduce manual implementation effort.
  • Experience supporting multiple business units, product lines, or delivery motions within a single services organization.
  • Experience with professional services automation (PSA) platforms and project management systems.
  • Experience operating in a PE-backed, acquisitive, or multi-brand technology environment.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to take ownership of a high-impact function and shape how it operates at scale.
  • An international and collaborative working environment with direct exposure to senior leadership.
  • 21 days of annual leave.
  • Travel reimbursement of €0.25 per kilometer for commuting, or an NS Business Card for public transport.
  • All necessary equipment to perform the role effectively.
  • Regular company and team events.

About Pair Team

At Pair Team, we’re an innovative, mission-driven company reimagining how Medicaid and Medicare serves the most underserved populations. As a tech-enabled medical group, we deliver whole-person care—clinical, behavioral, and social—by partnering with organizations deeply connected to the communities we serve.

We’re building a care model that empowers clinicians and care teams to do what they do best: provide compassionate, high-impact care. At Pair Team, we leverage AI and automation to reduce administrative burden, streamline coordination, and ensure patients receive timely, personalized support.

Our work is powered by a deeply collaborative team of nurses, social workers, community health workers, and medical professionals working alongside product, technology, and operations to close care gaps and improve outcomes for high-need patients.

We’re one of the largest Enhanced Care Management providers in California and are on track to build the nation’s largest clinically integrated network supporting high-need patients. Our model has demonstrated real impact, including a 58% reduction in emergency department visits and a 29% reduction in hospital admissions.

At Pair Team, we’re not just delivering care—we’re building the future of more equitable, community-driven healthcare.

Our Values

  • Lead with integrity: We keep our commitments and take responsibility for our actions. We are dependable and choose authenticity over perfection.
  • Embrace challenges: We leave our egos at the door and step forward into discomfort instead of back into safety. We help each other to learn and provide feedback using candor and kindness.
  • Break through walls: We go the extra mile for our patients, partners and one another, and we run toward hard things. We are resilient in our push for consistent improvement and challenge the status quo.
  • Act beyond yourself: We build each other up and respect boundaries. We seek first to understand and assume positive intent.
  • Care comes first: We hold ourselves to the highest standards for our patients. We are relentless in the pursuit of our mission, and ensure that we are taking care of ourselves in order to care for others.

In the News

  • Forbes: For Pair Team, Accessibility Is About Delivering Healthcare To Those Who Need It The Most
  • TechCrunch: Building for Medicaid’s regulatory moment with Neil Batlivala from Pair Team
  • Axios: Pair Team collects $9M for Medicaid-based care


About the Opportunity

Pair Team is building a team of deeply passionate individuals ready to change primary care operations for those who need it most. We are looking for a highly motivated part-time Family Physician (contractor) who is willing to think creatively and empathically to help our team change the way people access healthcare.

We seek a part-time Family Physician (contractor) to play a critical role in our whole-person, interdisciplinary care model. The Family Physician will be responsible for providing supervision for our Nurse Practitioners who provide multidisciplinary care to individuals living with Serious Mental Illness/ Substance Use Disorder, experiencing homelessness, and/or those who have high medical needs. We believe in the power of trust and relationships to successfully engage those who may have never received the kind of whole-health care that Pair Team can provide. The Family Physician will also have the opportunity to provide input on clinical programs that our team is developing. The Family Physician will report to our physician leadership.

As a Part-Time Physician, you’ll play an important clinical role in supporting the launch of our Medicare program across multiple states. This role will provide virtual care to Medicare patients with chronic, complex, and often overlapping medical, behavioral health, and social needs.

You’ll work collaboratively with physicians, nurse practitioners, care managers, and other members of the care team to provide thoughtful, high-quality clinical care, support care coordination, and help address the unique needs of patients with complex health conditions. This is an opportunity for a physician who is passionate about whole-person care, values interdisciplinary collaboration, and wants to help shape an innovative model of care for Medicare patients.

This role is a remote contract based role, best suited for someone who is looking for 5-10 hours of work with us per week to start.

It is required that you work from and live in the United States (USA) and are available for PST hours for urgent needs/support.

What You’ll Do

  • Enable best-in-class virtual health care for underserved patients by collaborating with our NPs, using our internal care delivery technology and your excellent clinical judgment
  • Help develop and refine clinical programs to support our patients holistically and address barriers / gaps in their care
  • Collaborate and grow with a diverse and inclusive team
  • Work from home with laptop and workstation provided
  • Be part of a high-energy, growth-oriented and diverse team

What You’ll Need

  • 2+ years of clinical experience in serving patients with complex social and healthcare needs and passionate about building a more equitable healthcare system
  • Experience and desire to work closely with a multidisciplinary team
  • Technology-savvy and experienced in digital-first healthcare (e.g. telemedicine) and comfortable working in a variety of different tech platforms
  • You are physically located in California and have a quiet, HIPAA compliant and internet connected space
  • Board certification or eligibility as a Family Physician
  • Eligible to enroll in Medicare
  • Comfortable and able to work with patients across the lifespan, from pediatrics to geriatrics
  • Experience working with and in Medicaid/FQHC clinics that are often underfunded / underserved
  • Experience working with Medicare beneficiaries managing chronic disease
  • Medical license in CA (plus additional state licensure or willingness to obtain additional licenses), and active CA DEA or willing to get one
  • Startup experience is a plus!

Because We Value You

  • Competitive hourly compensation ($125/hour)
  • Equipment provided for the role

Help Us Build the Relational Operating System for Churches and Ministries

At Called, we’re building the relational operating system for churches and ministries.

Our platform helps ministry leaders know their people, build stronger community, and foster deeper discipleship throughout the week, not just on Sundays.

Most churches serve hundreds, if not thousands, of people. Yet very few people in these communities feel truly known. People often drift away not because they reject belief, but because nobody notices they disappeared.

We’re a small, high-trust team building meaningful software with modern tools, AI-assisted workflows, and a strong sense of mission. We move fast, care deeply about quality, and believe technology should strengthen human relationships, not replace them.

If you want to help rebuild community in a disconnected world through thoughtful software, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer, Web & Mobile to build polished, reliable experiences across the Called platform.

This is a full stack engineering role with a strong emphasis on frontend development, responsive web, mobile usability, React, TypeScript, Capacitor, release quality, and user-facing craft.

You should be comfortable working across the stack, but your strongest instincts should be around the user experience: how the interface behaves, how it feels on mobile, how users move through workflows, and how to ship features that are useful, reliable, and easy to use.

A major part of this role will be owning the quality of our web and mobile experiences. That includes building responsive interfaces, testing mobile workflows, documenting mobile-specific issues, validating fixes, understanding app store requirements, and helping manage release workflows where applicable.

We are especially excited about engineers who are AI-forward and use modern tools to move faster, prototype quickly, debug effectively, improve quality, and reduce repetitive work.

This is a senior individual contributor role, not a people-management role or formal technical lead role.

What You'll Do

  • Build and improve features using React, TypeScript, React Query, CSS Modules, Python, Django, PostgreSQL, and related tools.
  • Create responsive, accessible interfaces that work well across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
  • Own frontend-heavy features from planning through implementation, QA, release, and iteration.
  • Work with backend APIs to fetch, update, validate, and manage application data.
  • Contribute to backend services, APIs, data models, and integrations when needed.
  • Test mobile and responsive workflows across devices, browsers, screen sizes, and app environments.
  • Own QA for mobile issues, including reproduction, documentation, fix verification, and regression prevention.
  • Help manage mobile release readiness, including build validation, release checklists, app store awareness, versioning, and post-release validation.
  • Improve frontend architecture, component patterns, state management, data fetching, performance, accessibility, and maintainability.
  • Use AI-assisted tools for development, debugging, prototyping, documentation, testing, and product iteration.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, testing, and team knowledge-sharing.

Our Engineering Philosophy

We believe modern engineers should be dramatically amplified by AI.

Our team actively uses AI-assisted workflows for development, debugging, prototyping, testing, documentation, automation, and rapid product iteration.

We care far more about builders who can move fast, learn quickly, and solve problems than developers obsessed with rigid specialization.

We value:

  • Ownership over bureaucracy
  • Shipping over perfectionism
  • Curiosity over ego
  • Product thinking over ticket completion
  • Mission and craftsmanship equally

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent experience building and shipping meaningful production software.
  • Strong experience with React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and responsive design.
  • Experience building high-quality interfaces for desktop, tablet, and mobile users.
  • Strong understanding of frontend architecture, component design, state management, data fetching, browser behavior, performance, and accessibility.
  • Experience testing and debugging responsive or mobile experiences across devices, browsers, and screen sizes.
  • Experience with mobile release workflows, app store deployment, mobile QA, hybrid mobile apps, or app-like web experiences.

  • Experience using Git in a collaborative development environment.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools or agentic workflows for coding, debugging, documentation, automation, testing, or productivity.
  • Strong attention to detail, clear communication, and a willingness to own quality before release.
  • A passion for building technology that supports a mission-driven organization.

People Who Thrive Here

  • Senior individual contributors who enjoy ownership without needing a management title
  • Full stack engineers whose strongest instincts are frontend, mobile, and user experience
  • Builders excited by AI and modern engineering workflows
  • Product-minded engineers who think beyond the ticket
  • Team players with low ego and high standards
  • Engineers who can move across the stack without treating user experience as an afterthought

Bonus Skills

What You’ll Love About Us

Overview

JOB TITLE: Lead Project Manager

AGENCY SUPPORTED: U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) – MEGA 6 Automated Litigation Support

POSITION TYPE: Full-Time, Contingent Upon Award

LOCATION: Remote

CLEARANCE: Public Trust – Candidates do not need to be cleared at the time of application but must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance prior to starting.

BENEFITS: Health, Dental and Vision, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Spending Account (FSA), 11 Paid Federal Holidays, 3 weeks’ Paid Time Off

ITC Federal, LLC (ITC) connects technology advancements in automation and AI, customer experience, and financial services to solve government mission challenges, enabling smoother operational efficiency and bolstering national security. We leverage the latest technology innovations and proven approaches to better serve the mission and support the DHS, DOJ, and DoW workforce, customers, and programs, regardless of scale or complexity. ITC is located in Fairfax, VA and offers an outstanding compensation and benefits plan and a challenging and rewarding professional work environment.

We are seeking an experienced Lead Project Manager to support ITC Federal’s work for the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) under the anticipated MEGA 6 automated litigation support (ALS) program. This is a fully remote position supporting DOJ’s complex litigation mission.

Important: This opening is being established in connection with the MEGA 6 contract vehicle award itself. ITC Federal must still be awarded individual task orders under the vehicle before employees can be onboarded. Accordingly, this position is full-time and contingent upon both contract award and the award of the applicable task order.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

The Lead Project Manager is a senior level Project Manager with responsibilities for coordinating the efforts of several Project Managers, either on one mammoth project, or for large numbers of projects typically at a Document Center.

PROGRAM CONTEXT:

This position supports the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) under the anticipated MEGA 6 procurement. MEGA 6 is expected to continue DOJ’s multiple-award contract vehicle for automated litigation support (ALS) services, following the structure of the MEGA 5 contract. These contracts are designed to provide DOJ offices, boards, divisions, and other federal agencies with information technology, professional services, and litigation support tools to manage complex legal proceedings efficiently.

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • The Lead Project Manager will usually work out of a Government-funded Document Center, although there may be situations in which the Lead Project Manager works out of a Contractor-provided facility.
  • Extraordinarily large, multi-facility "Document Centers" may require more than one such Lead Project Manager; small Document Centers may not require any Lead Project Managers.
  • The Lead Project Manager generally reports directly to the Division Contract Director or to a Deputy.
  • The Lead Project Manager directs and coordinates all Document Center resources, including subordinate Project Manager staff and other staff resources.
  • In Document Centers which support more than one case, the Lead Project Manager must carry his/her own caseload, in addition to performing lead/coordinating duties.
  • In addition to Project Manager responsibilities, as described below under Project Manager, the Lead Project Manager consults with the COR and Government Case Managers concerning overall Document Center operations, scheduling, work assignments, staffing, progress reporting, security, etc. The Lead Project Manager is responsible for overall quality assurance and timeliness of delivery for all work performed out of the Document Center.
  • The Lead Project Manager also performs overall coordinating functions with other Contractor components.

Qualifications

REQUIRED:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Public Trust clearance prior to start (candidates are not required to be cleared at the time of application).
  • Authorized to work in the United States.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fully remote environment.
  • At least six years of progressively more responsible experience in major litigation support projects, including at least one year of Project Manager experience or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage numerous complex and time-critical litigation support activities simultaneously, including technical/data processing support activities and cases involving e-discover.
  • Demonstrated ability to interact with attorneys on complex support activities.
  • Requires expert knowledge of litigation support; outstanding writing skills; outstanding oral communication skills; outstanding management skills.
  • Strong technical background as demonstrated through user level knowledge of eDiscovery tools and data management.
  • Demonstrated working knowledge of the Government’s and Contractor’s IT environment in which the work is to be performed, as well as Contractor’s “standard solutions” for eDiscovery, e.g., Clearwell, Relativity, etc. Must be able to anticipate litigation support needs and develop and execute detailed plans for addressing needs.
  • Requires knowledge of the Government's data processing environment in which the work is to be performed, including office automation networks, PC-based databases and other applications, and internet and server-based databases and other applications.

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

jobs.description:
About Dockwa

Dockwa is the operating system for the marine economy.

More than 1,250 marinas run their business on our software and more than 500,000 boaters use our app to find and book a slip. Nearly half a million reservations moved through us in the last twelve months. We own the boater marketplace, marina operations, and the payments layer underneath both.

That distribution is the whole argument. When anyone can generate software, the durable advantage is being the system an industry already runs on. We have that in boating and we just raised to go take it global.

About the Role

We are hiring one principal engineer, and we are hiring them to raise the ceiling of what this team can build.

Engineering is six people today and will be fourteen inside a year. Our surface area is far larger than that: reservations, payments and money movement, dock and slip management, rent roll, boater CRM, service and work orders, accounting integrations, a native iOS app, and now multi-currency for international markets. That math only works if we get dramatically better at building, not just bigger.

You will rebuild how we build. We treat AI as core development infrastructure, not a side experiment. We want someone who pushes the automation of our development lifecycle much further than it is today, proves it on real production work, and pulls the rest of the team up to that bar.

You will own the architecture that makes speed safe. We are twelve years into a system carrying real traffic and real money. Going faster only works if the foundation holds while we stack international, enterprise, and new verticals on top of it. You make those structural calls.

We are not hiring a principal to be the best coder in the room. We are hiring one so that in eighteen months a team of fourteen ships like a team of forty.

Who Thrives Here

The people who thrive at Dockwa have usually founded something, or joined something early and grew with it. They think in outcomes rather than tickets. They have opinions about the product and the business, not only the code. They would rather ship something a marina operator notices on a Saturday morning than win an argument about abstractions.

You should want to steer. There is more consequential work here than there are people to do it, which means you will decide what gets built at least as often as you build it.

What You Need

  • Production software you owned outright, end to end, including after it shipped.
  • Real AI fluency with receipts. Not tool familiarity. Work you could not have delivered without it.
  • Comfort across a full stack. Ours is Rails, React, Postgres, AWS and Swift, but we will take judgment over stack match every time.
  • Architectural decisions you had to live with afterwards, in systems you did not originally write.
  • Evidence you changed how a team worked, not only what it shipped.

How We Hire

Short, collaborative, and built around real problems rather than memory tests or puzzles. We are screening for motivation and judgment over trivia, and we want you to finish the process more excited than you started it.

How We Work

We are a small team that is winning. Problems grow exponentially with each person added, not linearly, so we keep the organization lean on purpose and put people at the source of problems with real ownership.

We automate before we hire. We ship quality at speed and treat those as compatible. We own the full loop from discovery to payment to analytics, because controlling the data is what makes the intelligence products possible.

We move fast, and context does not always land perfectly. It is always fine to ask why.

We have an institutional partner in PSG and an annual plan that’s in our control. We’re investing heavily in product and engineering because the operating system of the marine economy is ours to build and own. Acquisitions are part of how we grow, and we have dedicated budget behind that as well.

Equal Opportunity

We hire for range on purpose. Different vantage points produce better arguments, and on a team this small every viewpoint in the room changes the outcome. jobs.title: Design Team Lead - Ecommerce Marketing Agency
jobs.excerpt: The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team.
jobs.description:
The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team. There are two sides to it. One is craft, which means keeping the standard of the design work high across every client we serve. The other is people, which means keeping the team organised, supported, and able to do good work without getting stuck.

Most of what the team produces is email and SMS campaign design for ecommerce brands, along with ad images, GIFs, short video edits, and the occasional landing page. You will still design yourself, but the larger part of the job is making sure what goes out is right. You are the person who spots what is not working in a design before the client does, and who explains the fix in a way a designer can act on straight away.

You will work closely with Account Managers, who assign the day to day tasks, and with the designers who carry them out. A good deal of the role sits between those two groups: helping an Account Manager work out what a campaign actually needs, turning that into clear direction for a designer, and saying so when a request does not make sense.

The Design Team Lead reports to the Service Director, and works closely with the other departments at Hustler Marketing to make sure design work is delivered well and on time.

About the Role:Mission statement:

To keep the quality of our design work at a level clients notice, and to run a team that is organised, well briefed, and heard.
The first half of that is craft. Reviewing work, spotting what is weak in a design, and giving direction that makes it better. The second half is people. Distributing the week, reorganising it when something changes, and making sure the team's ideas and concerns reach someone who can act on them. We already have a strong team here, independent and reliable. What they need from a lead is someone who listens properly and comes back with a real answer.


General Responsibilities:

Design quality and direction

  • Reviewing the team's design work before it reaches Account Managers or clients, and giving feedback specific enough to act on
  • Diagnosing why a design is not working, whether that is hierarchy, contrast, the weight of the call to action, the balance of image to text, or how it holds up on mobile, and writing the fix down clearly
  • Advising Account Managers on what a campaign needs visually, and pushing back when a brief is thin or a request will not serve the client
  • Designing directly when the workload calls for it. This is a hands-on role, not a purely supervisory one
  • Keeping the work consistent across a wide range of client brands, niches, and visual identities
  • Setting and holding the design standards for email and SMS campaigns, ad images, GIFs, and short video assets
  • Understanding each client's visual brand identity well enough to advise on ideas, improvements, and optimisations

Running the week

  • Distributing and organising the team's workload week by week, working from the tasks Account Managers assign
  • Reorganising the queue quickly when priorities change, someone is unavailable, or a client adds something at the last minute
  • Keeping track of who is overloaded and who is not, and rebalancing before it turns into a missed deadline
  • Being the first person the Design Team comes to when something is blocking their work
  • Making sure the design targets set for each client account are met

The team

  • Running the Design Team's group calls and regular one-to-ones
  • Collecting the team's suggestions and concerns, taking them seriously, and coming back with an answer, including when the answer is no
  • Mentoring designers and helping the less experienced members build their skills
  • Onboarding new designers into how we work
  • Connecting Design with the other service teams through workshops, short tutorials, and written documentation
  • Running training and skill-building sessions for the Design Team

Process and improvement

  • Noticing where a workflow, a handoff, or a piece of communication is costing the team time, and fixing it
  • Writing and maintaining the documentation the team works from
  • Keeping up with what Figma ships and bringing the useful parts into how the team works
  • Staying current on design and email marketing trends, and sharing what matters rather than everything
  • Bringing industry best practices back to the Service Director and to the team
  • Taking on projects and initiatives delegated by the Service Director


Position Specs:

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month, consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • Contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement, meaning you cannot hold a position of a similar nature elsewhere while working for Hustler Marketing
  • A 30-day notice period after the first month
  • Performance reviews every 9 to 12 months, with the first one after 3 to 6 months

Requirements

About you:

Profile:

You are a senior designer with at least five years behind you, and a portfolio of real client work across different brands and niches rather than a handful of personal projects. At least three of those years involve email marketing design.

You are expert in Figma. Not comfortable in it, expert. You should be able to build and maintain component libraries, and it helps if you follow what Figma releases closely enough to tell the team when something new is worth adopting. Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity is a useful complement, though we do not lean on either heavily.

You know more than one kind of design output. Email and SMS campaign design is the core of it, but ad images, GIFs, and short video edits come up constantly. Some basic knowledge of web design is a plus rather than a requirement, since landing pages appear from time to time and the team already handles most of that themselves.

What matters most is your eye, and how you talk about it. You can look at a design that is not performing and say what is wrong with it, in what order, and what you would change first. Then you can put that in a message a designer understands without needing a follow-up call. That skill is most of this job.

You are organised enough to run a week of work across several people, and to rearrange it at short notice without the whole thing falling apart.

You are the sort of person a team talks to. Ours is independent and reliable, and there are a few things they would like to see improved that are hard to change quickly. What matters to them is knowing their comments are being considered and answered, not that every one of them gets a yes.

You are curious. You notice when a process could be better and you do something about it instead of working around it. You bring people together across teams with workshops, documents, and tutorials without waiting to be asked.

And you notice detail, in your own work and in everyone else's.


Key traits for this position:

Strong visual judgement, and the vocabulary to explain it. Organised, and calm when the week changes shape. Approachable, and willing to have the honest conversation rather than the easy one. Curious about tools and trends without chasing every new thing. Detail-oriented past the point of comfort. At ease working remotely with people spread across several countries and time zones.


Key Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a graphic designer, with a minimum of 3 years in email marketing design
  • Expert-level Figma skills, including building and working from component libraries
  • Working knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity
  • Experience producing ad images, animated GIFs, and short video edits
  • An established portfolio showing on-brand, effective design work for a range of clients, stores, and niches
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating other designers. A formal lead title is not required, but you should have done the work
  • The ability to review someone else's design work and give written feedback that is specific and actionable
  • The ability to distribute and reorganise a team's weekly workload, including at short notice
  • A basic understanding of web design and landing pages is a plus
  • Experience with Klaviyo, or with a comparable email marketing platform, is a plus
  • Comfortable with Slack, Asana, Hubstaff, Google Workspace, and Figma, and willing to learn whatever else we use
  • Fluent written and spoken English. It does not need to be your first language, but you will be writing feedback and running calls in it every day
  • Remote work experience, ideally with a team spread across time zones
  • Available and responsive during office hours, Monday to Friday between 3 and 6 PM Barcelona time
  • Consistently working 30 to 35 hours per week, which is 140 hours per month
  • A stable internet connection, a laptop or PC, and the ability to join video calls

jobs.title: Employability Coach (6-month Full time/Fixed-term/Remote) [United States]
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT GENERATION At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives.
jobs.description:
ABOUT GENERATION

At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have a 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. To date, Generation’s global graduates have earned more than $1.9 billion in wages. Generation graduates typically have a secondary school background, 52% are female, 28% have dependents, and the majority identify with underrepresented communities in their country.

POSITION OVERVIEW

We are looking for an exceptional Employability Coach to support learners into job placement for the Generation’s JobSprint Program.

You will be joining at an exciting time for Generation United States, as we leverage our extensive experience placing learners into jobs to develop and launch a new program offering that can serve a range of jobseekers who require last-mile support to secure employment. The training program is free to learners, part-time, online and mostly asynchronous, with personalized career coaching - by both human coaches (you!) and AI-enabled coaching and feedback tools.

Reporting to the Program Manager, the Employability Coach will support learners as they prepare for and conduct their job search, and you will help facilitate their placement into their new role at one of Generation’s employer partners. The Employability Coach will run both group and one-on-one coaching sessions, utilize an online learning platform and coaching software, and work closely with the Employer Engagement Manager to support placement.

This is a full-time, fixed-term, 6-month position funded through December 2026; continued employment thereafter is contingent upon the availability of funding. While this role is predominantly remote, there may be quarterly domestic travel and/or in-person events. Working hours are primarily from 9 to 5 pm ET; during the training program the Employability Coach will need to be available for 1 evening (ET) group session per week. This role requires regular video presence during working hours; candidates should have a dedicated, distraction-free workspace.

Preference for candidates based in Atlanta, GA or Washington D.C.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The Employability Coach will:

In-Program

  • Become familiar with and follow the course of the program as designed by Generation, in addition to sharing insights based on your expertise
  • Conduct 1:1 coaching conversations to review and provide feedback on learners’ applications/interview materials and guide them in the creation of an “employment essentials toolkit” (i.e., CV, LinkedIn profile)
  • Hold weekly group coaching sessions during 3-week program (1 per week during evening ET hours) and office hours as needed to support learners in understanding content and completing program milestones
  • Review learner progress (e.g., attendance, assignments), grading assignments when needed (e.g., CV review), and inputting data in Canvas LMS
  • Use AI Career Coaching tool to further personalize and supplement coaching; track learner usage / progress on coaching tool
  • Instill confidence during the placement process by supporting learners in career trajectory planning
  • Support Employer Engagement Manager to answer placement questions learners may have and to ensure any essential employment-related documentation is complete and up-to-date for each learner
  • Coordinate with Generation team members on learner needs and ongoing data collection, sharing feedback and implementing recommendations to guarantee quality training for our learners
  • Effectively use digital tools such as Teams, Canvas, Slack, and GDrive to perform daily tasks and collaborate in a remote working environment
  • Avoid legal liability issues through thorough adherence to Generation policy, procedure, and guidelines

Transition to Employment

  • Participate in mock interviews with learners and give feedback to help them become better-prepared and more confident
  • Oversee learners’ transition to full-time employment by closely collaborating with Generation team members to fulfill job recruitment opportunities in line with deadlines
  • Design and deliver events that connect Generation graduates to employers
  • Manage placement activities in partnership with Employer Engagement Manager, including learner usage of Employability Module, scheduling interviews and collecting data on job search and attainment
  • Track unplaced alumni and ensure that they are being notified of relevant job opportunities
  • Ensure consistent communication with learners, graduates, and the Generation team to ensure effective coordination, timely updates, and an overall successful execution of the placement process

ABOUT YOU

Required experience and skills:

  • You have at least 2 years’ experience in career coaching, and/or employment counseling, and/or experience hiring, managing, and/or coaching entry-level recruits from a range of backgrounds
  • You have strong relationship building skills and excellent communication skills (writing + oral expression that can work for different audiences)
  • You are comfortable conducting 1:1 conversations and giving evaluative feedback in an honest, open and nurturing way
  • You are able to develop and maintain relationships with learners built on trust and support
  • You have an up-to-date understanding of employability essentials (e.g., CV, LinkedIn, interviewing skills)
  • You are comfortable with, analyzing and utilizing data to inform operational decisions and learning new technology (including AI-powered tools)

Preferred experience and skills:

  • Experience in workforce development or other educational / training roles
  • Experience working with a diverse set of beneficiaries
  • Proficient with Canvas or similar LMS tools, Salesforce and Google Workspace

Mindset:

  • You are proactive self-starter, able to work autonomously and collaboratively with others in a remote work environment
  • You can work in a fast-paced, changing environment, take ownership and are entrepreneurial
  • You are results driven, able to quantify success by developing metrics/analytics
  • You have a positive, solution-oriented attitude and a drive for excellence
  • You believe in our mission, that fulfilling employment can change lives, and are passionate about doing social good

This role is eligible for a limited benefits package, which may include medical coverage, paid sick leave, paid time off, paid holidays, and access to a retirement plan. Benefits eligibility is based on a fixed‑term six‑month employment period and is subject to plan rules and change.

Finalists for the position will be asked to submit 2-3 employer references (including email and phone number).

jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Environmental Engineer (Engineer V)

Location: Remote

Description/Job Summary

POSITION DESCRIPTION

This Environmental Engineer V position will be responsible for leading technical execution in design/implementation of feasibility studies, treatability studies, civil and remediation system design, and support during construction for HGL’s portfolio of environmental remediation projects for the USEPA, USACE, NASA, and various agencies across the United States and territories. Projects may include remediation, demolition, mine-waste cleanup, in-situ thermal treatment, landfill cap construction, radioactive soil, contaminated sediment removals, O&M, groundwater treatment systems (both in-situ and pump-n-treat) and stabilization projects.

The Engineer V position is also responsible for supporting the EPA Director and CLIN 2 Program Manager in the leading and managing of the company’s Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) contracts within EPA Region 6 and other regions and ensuring all projects are executed in alignment with client expectations, contractual requirements, and company objectives. This role oversees EPA-related projects and project teams, provides strategic leadership, supports business development efforts within the EPA Region 6 portfolio, and serves as a primary point of contact for Region 6 client engagement. The position also plays a key role in mentoring and developing staff, including project managers, to ensure consistent and successful project delivery.

The Engineer V position has the potential to work fully remotely with occasional travel to project sites and HGL offices. If a candidate resides within commuting distance of an HGL office and would like to work hybrid, that option is also available to them. Preference is for candidates who reside within EPA Region 6 (Arkansas, Louisiana, New Mexico, Oklahoma, and Texas).

Responsibilities/Duties

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

The person hired for this role will be responsible for:

  • Direct, manage and lead project engineering design teams.
  • Collaborate with Project Manager and engineers, geologists, CAD/GIS specialists and other technical staff in the development of studies/strategies for remediation for contaminated media.
  • Develop engineering studies, plans, designs, and specifications for the remediation of contaminated media.
  • Develop costs estimates and construction workplans for remedial construction.
  • Supporting Civil and Environmental Design Projects.
  • Ensuring project objectives are met.
  • Project schedule development and review.
  • Quality Control.
  • Mentoring of junior engineering staff.

Staff Management:

  • Support HGL’s EPA program and direct all EPA-related contracts and CLIN (Contract Line-Item Number) project managers within region 6.
  • Support a team of staff, including formal employee mentorship to provide guidance and professional development.
  • Communicate and connect with various departments (proposal development, contracts, chemistry, data management, etc.) to ensure that they are properly coordinating and functioning to support the region.

Project Oversight and Delivery:

  • Ensure EPA Region 6 projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with project scope of work and contract requirements and client expectations.
  • Conduct routine meetings with project managers to monitor project progress, review deliverables, and provide strategic direction.
  • Guide and enforce company best practices for consistent EPA project execution across teams.
  • Address and resolve project issues and challenges.
  • Serve as a Senior Project Manager on some Region 6 Task Orders.
  • Uphold contract and company required QA/QC and Health and Safety standards.

Client and Stakeholder Engagement:

  • Serve as liaison with EPA Region 6 clients, fostering strong relationships to ensure satisfaction and repeat business.
  • Coordinate with external stakeholders for scope and cost sensitive items including EPA clients and state and local agencies as needed for specific projects.
  • Respond to client inquiries and proactively address client needs to maintain high levels of satisfaction.

Proposal and Business Development:

  • Support, organize and lead proposal efforts for EPA-related opportunities, working closely with technical teams, HGL leadership, and teaming partners to submit high-quality and competitive proposals.
  • Assist in growing the company’s Region 6 EPA portfolio, identifying new opportunities, and contributing to long-term client engagement strategies.
  • Evaluate potential project opportunities for profitability and alignment with company goals.
  • Support planning for and attendance of client sponsored Industry Day events and conferences.

Process Improvement and Standardization:

  • Contribute to the development and refinement of internal guidelines and processes for program and project management to ensure consistency across teams.
  • Mentor project managers on best practices and standardized approaches to ensure high-quality service delivery.
  • Utilize approved digital and AI-assisted tools, where appropriate, to support technical documentation, data analysis, project communications, and workflow efficiency.

Minimum Requirements

WHAT YOU NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL

The ideal candidate will need the following as a foundation for success in this role:

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, or a related field required; professional engineering (PE) registration in one or more states preferred or required.
  • At least 15 years of engineering experience, including a minimum of 5 years managing large government contracts and multidisciplinary teams, preferably on environmental remediation projects for Department of Defense (DoD) and/or U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) clients in a lead role.
  • Direct experience managing EPA Region 6 clients and working with state and local agencies within EPA Region 6.
  • Demonstrated experience with soil, sediment, and mine waste remediation; in situ and ex situ groundwater treatment; and landfill or thermal remediation.
  • Ability to direct and develop remedial design documents that are technically sound and accurately reflect project approaches and requirements.
  • Strong leadership and people-management abilities, including a demonstrated history of responsibility, initiative, motivation, creative problem-solving, mentoring, and coaching staff.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with clients, team members, and agency representatives.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities while maintaining focus on project details and overall strategic objectives.
  • Highly organized and strategic thinker with the ability to see the big picture while effectively managing project-level requirements.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, and Microsoft Project for project scheduling and management.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn and adopt new technologies and digital tools to improve project delivery and operational efficiency.

Desired Qualifications

WHAT YOU NEED TO STAND OUT – Preferred, not required

  • Master of Science in Engineering.
  • Hands on MS Project or P6 experience.
  • PFAS/PFOA experience.
  • Experience with SpecsIntact.

Physical & Environmental Requirements

PHYSICAL & COGNITIVE REQUIRMENTS

Physical

  • Prolonged sitting up to 70% of the time; Ability to interpret and analyze visual data (maps, graphs, warning indicators, etc.)
  • Analyzing and synthesizing data; Complex problem solving and decision making; Reading and interpreting technical documents or regulations; Writing reports, proposals, or technical documentation; Leading a team or coordinating multiple priorities; Communicating effectively with clients, team members, and stakeholders; Managing competing deadlines and shifting priorities

WORK ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

  • Office and remote work environment; Must be able to travel up to 15% per year; May work in environments with loud noises, dust, or hazardous materials

This description is not a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that may be required of the employee. Other duties, responsibilities and activities may be assigned or may be changed at any time with or without notice.

Details

Work Schedule:HGL office work is dictated by a 5-day work week; however, fieldwork schedules will deviate based on job requirements and may require longer hours and weekends.

Office Type:Remote

Travel:15%

A favorable pre-hire drug test is required.

All positions are subject to a pre-hire education and driving record verification.

MORE ABOUT HGL AND THE OPPORTUNITY

At HGL, we share a drive and vision to restore natural resources and provide ongoing stewardship of our environment to benefit present and future generations. We believe that we can make a difference in improving the world we live in through collaboration, teamwork, and a positive work environment. This unites and empowers us to strive for excellence in all our endeavors.

HGL - WHO WE ARE

The exceptional quality of our people is key to our strength. We value our employees as individuals and as important members of our team. We offer a work environment that is flexible, inclusive, and dedicated to creating a sustainable future. By cultivating a culture of innovation, we’re able to adapt and augment our services to solve complex environmental and natural resources challenges.

Projects at HGL primarily span the United States and its territories, tackling problems associated with emerging contaminants (like PFAS), radiological contamination, and military munitions, along with chemical contamination in groundwater, surface water, sediments, and soil.

With over 550 employees, HGL is large enough to execute high-profile projects, but small enough to develop personal working environments with our talented team members. By joining HGL, you will be working toward restoring the environment and protecting our future.

HGL - WE INVEST IN YOU

It’s not just a job, it’s your career. HGL provides career growth opportunities via mentoring, training, education, and support for your certifications and licenses. Achieve your career goals and help HGL achieve its mission of restoring the environment to beneficial use for our clients and communities.

We are an Equal Opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other protected category. Some positions may require U.S. citizenship. Applicants who wish to request a reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process should contact Human Resources directly at 703-478-5186.

EEO notices:US Equal Opportunity Employment Poster,US Equal Opportunity Supplemental Poster,Know Your Rights, andPay Transparency Notice.

A full list of benefits is available at.

Digital & AI Proficiency:HGL encourages the responsible use of approved AI-enabled and digital technologies to improve productivity, technical quality, decision-making, and project delivery. Candidates who demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and experience leveraging emerging technologies are highly valued.

The annual salary for this position ranges from $121,620 - $194,592.This position's final salary can be impacted by various factors including, but not limited to, contractual requirements, geographic location, job-related education, training, experience, and skills. If your desired salary falls outside of this range, we hope you'll still apply as there may be other positions that better align.

jobs.excerpt: About Knotch We're a growth-stage technology company helping brands optimize content performance and apply AI to modern marketing.
jobs.description:
About Knotch

We're a growth-stage technology company helping brands optimize content performance and apply AI to modern marketing. Our culture is fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and highly adaptable—we move quickly, test ideas, and evolve with our customers.

Through the Knotch platform, brands can measure the impact of their content, identify what drives results, and continuously improve performance across channels. By combining performance data, strategic insights, and AI-driven capabilities, we help marketing teams make smarter decisions and get more impact from every piece of content they produce.

About the position

You'll split your time between two front ends at very different stages.

Knotch ACE, generates web experiences from AI in real time. Rather than serving fixed pages, our backend streams typed component descriptions and the front end assembles them into a React tree as they arrive. It's Next.js App Router and TypeScript in a monorepo, live for several enterprise brands, each with its own theming and deployment.

Knotch One is a mature React application that customers use daily, built on Redux, GraphQL and styled-components, with data visualization at its core.

Between them there's a good mix of greenfield design work and the kind of careful change you make in a codebase with real users. We're looking for someone who's happy doing both.

Responsibilities

  • Build features across both applications, working to each one's existing conventions.
  • Develop the component system that renders streamed, AI-generated layouts — schemas, renderers, and the contracts between them.
  • Work on multi-tenant theming: design tokens, per-brand configuration, client-specific variants.
  • Build and maintain embeds that run our product inside customer websites.
  • Set standards for testing, accessibility, and performance.
  • Work with backend engineers on API and streaming contracts, including where the line between front end and backend actually sits.
  • Write the approach down before you build it, and raise blockers, risks and disagreements early rather than after they've cost time.
  • Ramp yourself up on unfamiliar parts of the product and codebase, and mentor others through code review, pairing, and written design.

How we Work

Knotch moves quickly and the team is small, so you'll wear a few hats — you'll own features end to end, work directly with backend, data and product, and see what you build in front of enterprise clients in weeks rather than quarters.

That pace runs on writing. Design and decisions happen in docs and threads here: you'll write the approach before you build it, keep people posted on where things stand, flag risks as soon as you see them, and say what you think when you disagree — including with us. Silence reads as agreement, so if something looks wrong, say so.

It also runs on people who find their own way in. We'll point you at the right person and the right part of the codebase, and questions are always welcome — but the engineers who do well here read the code, form a view, and bring it back for a second opinion rather than a walkthrough. Everyone teaches, and everyone is expected to come up to speed fast.

From there, the work is yours to run with.

Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years building React applications in production.
  • TypeScript day to day, including typing data that arrives at runtime.
  • Next.js App Router, or another framework with a server/client rendering split — Remix, Nuxt, SvelteKit.
  • Experience in a large codebase with history, where the work meant fitting into earlier decisions rather than starting clean.
  • CSS at scale — utility-first (Tailwind) or CSS-in-JS (styled-components, Emotion), and styling systems built on tokens or theme objects.
  • Accessible UI work — keyboard navigation, ARIA, and testing against WCAG.
  • Data visualization — ECharts, D3, Recharts or similar.
  • Writing tests alongside features — Vitest, Jest, Testing Library or similar.
  • Clear written communication, and a track record of working without close supervision: scoping your own work, unblocking yourself, and telling people what you need.

Nice to Have

  • Runtime schema validation — Zod, Valibot or similar.
  • Streaming or incremental UI — SSE, WebSockets.
  • Monorepo tooling — pnpm workspaces, Turborepo, Nx.
  • Design tokens and multi-tenant theming.
  • Embedding JavaScript into third-party sites — iframes, CSP, sandboxing.
  • Client state management at scale (Redux, Zustand or similar) against a typed API layer, GraphQL or REST.
  • Using AI-assisted tooling to move faster, and a view on where it helps and where it doesn't.

Our Benefits and Perks

  • Salary -The expected salary range for this role is $135,000 - $175,000 CAD depending on experience.
  • Health Benefits - Through our employer of record (EOR) relationship with Globalization Partners, we're proud to offer comprehensive health benefits.
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid Holidays
  • Wellness Perks
  • Daily Company Break
  • Phone Plan Credit (select team members who have high phone usage for work):
  • Company Offsite

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About the role

The Director, Risk Management owns Riot's most time-critical GRC pillar. This role steps directly into that execution environment — timelines do not pause for onboarding.

This pillar is intentionally scoped: Risk Management owns the external auditor relationship, the evidence pipeline, the enterprise risk register, the POA&M lifecycle, and the ISO 27001 audit readiness and certification audit track. You own risk identification, risk quantification, audit execution, and the remediation lifecycle that closes gaps across all pillars.

You will report to the Senior Director, GRC and serve as Riot's primary relationship owner with external auditors across SOC 1, SOC 2, and ISO 27001. You will partner directly with the CFO on SOX obligations and with Internal Audit on shared ITGC methodology. In critical operations, you will engage mining site and data center leadership to ensure operational risks are captured, assessed, and reflected in the enterprise risk register.

What you'll do

  • Own end-to-end execution of SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type II audits: scoping, control walkthroughs, evidence collection, auditor liaison, management response drafting, and remediation tracking — you are the primary point of contact for all external audit activity.
  • Lead the ISO 27001:2022 audit readiness and certification audit track — coordinating evidence, managing the certification audit relationship, and driving the program to on-schedule certification under the governance of the Sr. Director, GRC.
  • Serve as the primary liaison to Internal Audit for SOX ITGC coordination — establishing a shared control inventory, aligning testing methodologies, dividing walkthroughs to eliminate duplication, and maintaining a joint remediation cadence.
  • Build and operate the Riot enterprise risk register: define the risk taxonomy, conduct risk assessments across all business units including mining and data center operations, tier risks by likelihood and impact, and maintain a living register updated no less than quarterly.
  • Develop and maintain the KRI/KPI framework for executive and Board-level risk reporting — translating risk register outputs into leading indicators that give leadership actionable visibility into Riot's risk posture.
  • Run the POA&M (Plan of Action & Milestones) program: intake all audit findings and control gaps across all GRC pillars, assign ownership, track remediation progress, escalate stalled items, and report status to the Sr. Director on a defined cadence.
  • Build continuous audit-readiness infrastructure: design repeatable evidence pipelines, drive evidence collection automation where possible, and eliminate point-in-time audit scrambles by maintaining a year-round audit-ready posture.

What you'll bring

  • 8–12+ years of progressive GRC, IT audit, or enterprise risk management experience, with direct, hands-on ownership of SOC 1 and/or SOC 2 Type II audits — required, not supporting-role exposure.
  • ISO 27001 Lead Implementer certification — required. Must have credentialed implementation experience to own the audit execution and certification track.
  • Working knowledge of SOX ITGC requirements at a publicly traded company, with demonstrated experience coordinating GRC work with an Internal Audit function.
  • Proven experience building or operating an enterprise risk register, risk taxonomy, and KRI/KPI reporting framework for executive audiences.
  • Experience owning the external auditor relationship — managing audit timelines, evidence requests, walkthrough coordination, and management response drafting across multiple concurrent audit programs.
  • Strong POA&M and remediation lifecycle management: tracking, escalating, and closing audit findings across cross-functional control owners.
  • Familiarity with at least one additional security framework beyond SOC 2 — ISO 27001, NIST CSF, or NIST 800-53.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication — ability to present risk posture and audit status in executive-ready formats for Board Audit Committee reporting.
  • Preferred: CISA or CRISC certification; experience in critical infrastructure, data center, energy, or digital asset environments; exposure to OT/ICS risk environments.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Base range (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant.
  • Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match.
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans.
  • Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work.

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.excerpt: On this journey for over 12 years, Qventus is leading the transformation of healthcare.
jobs.description:
On this journey for over 12 years, Qventus is leading the transformation of healthcare. We enable hospitals to focus on what matters most: patient care. Our innovative solutions harness the power of machine learning, generative AI, and behavioral science to deliver exceptional outcomes and empower care teams to anticipate and resolve issues before they arise.

Our success in rapid scale across the globe is backed by some of the world's leading investors. At Qventus, you will have the opportunity to work with an exceptional, mission-driven team across the globe, and the ability to directly impact the lives of patients. We’re inspired to work with healthcare leaders on our founding vision and unlock world-class medicine through world-class operations.

About the role:

We're looking for a Senior / Staff Analytics Program Lead to own the analytics product program across our global Analytics organization. While our solution analytics leads own the definitions and insights for a single solution, this role owns the analytics product function as a system: how analytics products get built, how they hold together across solutions, and how fast we can ship the next one. You are accountable for the coherence, quality, and velocity of everything the analytics function delivers, internal and external, and for steering the function toward more self-serve and agentic analytics, where trusted metric definitions let customers, internal teams, and AI agents answer more questions without an analyst in the loop.

This is a hybrid role. Most of your time goes to running the program: enforcing and evolving the analytics standards and ways of working that let each pod ship correctly, scoping and sequencing work across solutions, and partnering with platform, data/BI engineering, and context architecture to shape the technical & semantic foundations our analytics products are built on, especially as we scale towards enabling increased self-service with AI tools. The rest is hands-on. You will jump into a domain as an individual contributor when the hardest problems need you, both to unblock the team and to stay closely aligned the work you're setting the bar for. If you are energized by taking a pattern you know works and re-establishing it at a broader scale, this is that role.

Key Responsibilities:

At Qventus, Analytics is treated as a first-class product, rather than a secondary output. As the Analytics Program Lead, you will:

  • Own delivery of coherent, high-quality, on-time analytics products across solutions, and hold the bar for products that are stable, maintainable, and easy to iterate and enhance over time
  • Increase the velocity at which we build and ship analytics products by enforcing and shaping standards, developing analytics AI skills and context, and evolving team structures, in partnership with our Data Engineering, BI Engineering, and Product teams

Our AWS work is engineered, not administered. Every environment we run is defined in Terraform, deployed through automated pipelines, hardened to NIST SP 800-53 and DISA STIG baselines, and monitored continuously. We are now applying agentic tooling that drafts control implementations, triages findings, and reduces the toil in operations and ATO work.

We are hiring an AWS Technical Lead to run this work including how our AWS programs are architected, staffed, managed, and delivered. Additionally, you will be the technical lead supporting our capture and partnership functions.

Delivery and Project Management

Technical Leadership: DevSecOps, Automation and Compliance

    • Act as the firm's senior technical authority on AWS across compute, networking, storage, data, security, identity, observability, and serverless and container platforms.
    • Set and enforce the Infrastructure as Code standard for the practice: Terraform first, with reusable module libraries, policy-as-code guardrails (OPA, Sentinel, or AWS Config rules), and automated drift detection.
    • Own the CI/CD and GitOps model for AWS programs: pipeline architecture, artifact signing, SAST/DAST/SCA gates, and automated STIG and CIS hardening of AMIs and containers.
    • Drive compliance as code: map NIST SP 800-53 controls to automated evidence, integrate Security Hub, GuardDuty, Inspector, and CloudTrail into continuous monitoring, and move programs toward continuous ATO.
    • Design and review architectures for AWS GovCloud and commercial regions under FISMA, FedRAMP, and Zero Trust requirements, aligned to the AWS Well-Architected Framework.
    • Eliminate operational toil through automation: self-healing infrastructure, automated patching, runbook automation, and cost optimization built into pipelines.
    • Stay hands-on. You should be able to open a terminal, read a Terraform plan, and diagnose what a team is stuck on.

AI Engineering

    • Lead adoption of AI across delivery: agentic tooling for operations triage, IaC generation and review, control-implementation drafting, and documentation.
    • Architect and deliver AI workloads on AWS in regulated environments using Bedrock, SageMaker, and related services, with the guardrails, data controls, and authorization boundaries federal customers require.
    • Establish practice standards for responsible and secure use of AI coding assistants and agents, consistent with customer AI-use restrictions.

Team Development

    • Mentor and help retain AWS architects, cloud engineers, and DevSecOps engineers.
    • Build a certification and skills-development program that raises the technical floor across the practice and supports partner-tier requirements.
    • Advise on career paths and technical review practices that make Easy Dynamics a destination for strong AWS engineers.

Proposal Solutioning (supporting the CSO)

    • Serve as solution architect on AWS pursuits: architecture, staffing model, transition approach, and basis of estimate.
    • Write and review technical approach volumes, respond to RFIs, and present in orals.
    • Partner with capture and BD leads to shape requirements, engage customers early, and position AWS-native approaches.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years in cloud engineering or architecture, with 6+ years focused on AWS, in DevSecOps or platform engineering roles.
  • Expert-level Terraform: module design, state management at scale, testing, and policy-as-code enforcement. CloudFormation or CDK fluency preferred.
  • Hands-on experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines for federal systems (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or AWS CodePipeline) with integrated security scanning.
  • Deep AWS security expertise: IAM design, Organizations and SCPs, KMS, network segmentation, Security Hub, GuardDuty, and logging architecture.
  • Demonstrated compliance-as-code work: automating NIST SP 800-53 evidence, STIG or CIS hardening, and continuous monitoring in support of FISMA or FedRAMP authorizations.
  • Practical experience delivering AI or ML capabilities on AWS, or applying AI tooling to engineering and operations work, in a regulated environment.
  • 3+ years leading and mentoring cloud engineering teams.
  • Deep, current, hands-on AWS expertise across core services, including AWS GovCloud (US).
  • Active AWS Professional-level certification required: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional and/or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional (both preferred).
  • Active AI certification required: AWS Certified AI Practitioner or AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate, and/or an Anthropic Claude certification.
  • AWS Certified Security - Specialty and HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate strongly preferred.
  • Experience contributing to federal proposals as a technical solution architect or technical volume author.
  • Experience working directly with AWS partner and account teams.
  • U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.
