jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.excerpt: At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers.  We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need.
jobs.description:
At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

This position is for an existing vacancy.

At Roofr, building a powerful user experience starts with data. As a SeniorData Analyst at an early-stage, high-growth company, you’ll play a critical role in turning raw data into insights that shape product decisions, drive strategy, and improve the customer experience. You’ll have a direct impact on how we use data to grow, and help influence the roadmap for how analytics evolves at Roofr.

This role sits at the intersection of data analytics and business, ideal for someone comfortable moving between modeling data, building dashboards, and advising senior leadership on growth opportunities.

What You'll Get to Do:

  • Partner directly with business and product owners to shape roadmaps, prioritize features, and measure success
  • Build an AI-first business intelligence platform to supercharge self-serve analysis
  • Deliver actionable insights on user behavior, market trends, and business performance to marketing, revenue and product teams.
  • Lead sales and marketing analytics by defining KPIs and optimizing our acquisition funnels.
  • Tell compelling data stories to communicate insights to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Transform, clean, and model raw data using DBT to create reliable, analytics-ready datasets
  • Take ownership of our analytics foundation, inheriting existing models (DBT) and data warehouse structure (Snowflake) to clean, improve, and scale them alongside a Senior Analytics Engineer.

What You'll Bring to the Role:

  • 7+ years of experience in data analysis and/or data science, ideally on sales, marketing, and growth analytics at a SaaS company
  • Expertise hacking AI/ML and automation tools for growth purposes, on top of using Claude, Cortex and other AI tools to streamline analytics workflow
  • Proficient in BI tools like Metabase, Sigma, Tableau, Omni, or Looker
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, PostgreSQL)
  • Hands-on experience with DBT for managing the Transform layer of ELT pipelines
  • Ability to work cross-functionally to define metrics, create dashboards, and ensure data quality
  • A strong analytical mindset with a keen eye for detail and accuracy

Who You Are:

  • Loves transforming messy data into clean models and insights
  • Thrives at bringing structure to chaos and able to find focus while juggling multiple projects
  • Lead with intent and proactively bring ideas to our partners and stakeholders
  • Eager to elevate your team and organization to new heights
  • A strong communicator with great presentation skills
  • Analytical with a demonstrated ability to utilize data to make informed decisions
  • A critical thinker who doesn’t settle for the status quo

Compensation Band: $130,000.00 - $140,000.00 CAD

Our compensation ranges are built using multiple market benchmarks and reflect both the scope of the role and current market data. While many hires fall within the beginning to midpoint of the band to allow for growth over time, we tailor offers based on each candidate’s experience, seniority, and demonstrated impact.

🏠 What we offer (US + Canada)

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

🏝️ Vacation/Paid Time Off:

  • 1st week of employment is mandatory PTO! Start your journey with Roofr by decompressing and recharging - we will see you in week 2!
  • 1 Friday off per month (we call those our laundry days!)
  • Company wide paid shutdown for the week between Christmas and New Years
  • Flexible time off
  • 80% employer-paid benefits in the U.S. and 100% employer-paid premiums for Extended Healthcare and Dental in Canada
  • RRSP/401k match
  • Generous Parental Leave policy

🤝 Perks:

  • We host an annual company retreat with great team building activities
  • Ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career
  • Home office setup stipend
  • Internet and phone allowance
  • Remote first culture

🤖 AI Notice

At Roofr, we’re big fans of AI. It helps us write job descriptions that don’t put you to sleep, takes notes during interviews so we can actually listen, and even helps us track down awesome humans like you.

Feel free to use AI to prep, research, or get pumped up for your interview (we see you, ChatGPT power users 👀). But when it’s time to chat, we’d love to meet you, not your AI alter ego. Bring your real, unfiltered self, we promise we will too.

  • History of stable tenure in previous sales roles, ideally three or more years in a position.
  • C2-level English fluency with minimal to no accent.
  • Strong on-camera presence and ability to confidently lead client-facing conversations.

jobs.description:
Job Title

Director, Solutions Data Centers

Job Description Summary

This individual leads the design and articulation of integrated facilities management (IFM) solutions for hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, and AI/HPC data center portfolios. This is a client-facing, pursuit-critical role that converts complex critical-environment requirements into deliverable operating models, staffing plans, and commercial constructs.

The role carries a deliberate and heavy emphasis on engineering solutioning and engineering staffing — building the critical-facilities engineering organization that sits at the center of every data center mandate: staffing and shift-coverage models, licensure and qualification matrices, wage and total-rewards strategy, labor-market feasibility, and recruiting ramp plans.

Job Description

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead solution architecture for data center IFM pursuits — new business, expansions, renewals, and rebids — across single-site, regional, and global portfolios.
  • Interrogate client requirements (RFI/RFP/RFQ, SLAs, KPIs, MOPs/SOPs, uptime standards, Uptime Institute tier and criticality classifications) and translate them into a defensible operating model.
  • Build the labor model, organizational chart, span of control, and scope matrix that underpin the price — and defend every assumption in internal governance and client-facing sessions.
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, HR, Talent Acquisition, Procurement, Finance, EHS, Sustainability, Legal, and Technology to assemble one integrated solution rather than a collection of functional inputs.
  • Author and orchestrate the technical response: solution narrative, staffing plan, mobilization and transition plan, technology stack, governance model, risk register, and assumptions and exclusions schedule.
  • Lead solution workshops, site walks, due-diligence visits, and client orals; present and defend the engineering and FM approach to client engineering leadership and procurement.
  • Conduct win/loss reviews and feed outcomes back into standard solution assets, benchmark libraries, and pricing templates.
  • Maintain a reusable library of data center solution components — role profiles, coverage models, PM libraries, scope matrices, and benchmark staffing ratios.
  • Design the critical-facilities engineering operating model: on-site engineering teams, 24x7x365 shift coverage, on-call and escalation structures, remote operations center integration, and vendor-augmented models.
  • Solution the maintenance program across all critical systems — MV/LV electrical distribution, switchgear, UPS and battery plant, static transfer switches, PDUs, generators and fuel systems, chillers, CRAC/CRAH units, pumps, cooling towers, liquid cooling and direct-to-chip systems for AI/HPC densities, BMS/EPMS, fire detection and suppression, and building envelope.
  • Set the engineering technology approach: CMMS/EAM configuration, asset hierarchy and tagging standards, BMS/EPMS integration, remote monitoring, analytics, digital twin and reliability reporting.
  • Quantify the engineering solution — headcount, overtime, shift differentials, tools, test equipment, PPE, training, spares and critical-spares strategy, and subcontracted specialist services.
  • Build engineering staffing models by site and by portfolio: role mix (Chief Engineer, Critical Facilities Manager, Lead/Shift Engineer, Critical Facilities Engineer, Controls/BMS Technician, Electrical and Mechanical Technicians, Fire Life Safety specialists, EHS and Compliance roles), FTE counts, shift rotations, relief factors, vacation and absence coverage, and overtime assumptions.
  • Define qualification and licensure matrices by jurisdiction — electrical and mechanical licenses, stationary/operating engineer licenses and client-specific critical-environment certifications.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition on the recruiting ramp plan — sourcing channels, pipeline build ahead of award, hiring sequencing against go-live, contingency and contractor bridge strategies.
  • Benchmark proposed engineering ratios (engineers per MW, per critical system, per square foot) against internal and industry data, and articulate the rationale for any deviation.

REQUIRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Facilities/Construction Management, or a related technical discipline; equivalent military or trade-progression experience will be considered.
  • 10+ years in facilities management, critical facilities operations, or engineering services, including 5+ years with direct data center or mission-critical environment accountability.
  • 5+ years in FM solutions development, bid management, or a senior operations role with direct ownership of staffing models and cost build-ups.
  • Demonstrated experience building critical-facilities engineering staffing models and defending them to sophisticated technical clients.
  • Working command of data center infrastructure: electrical distribution and redundancy topologies (N+1, 2N, 2N+1), UPS and generator systems, mechanical cooling including liquid cooling, BMS/EPMS, and fire life safety.
  • Fluency in FM commercial models, SLA/KPI regimes, and pricing mechanics; advanced Excel modeling capability.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to author a technical solution narrative and present it to C-suite and engineering audiences alike.
  • Willingness to travel domestically (typically 25-30%).

Preferred

  • Experience supporting hyperscale, colocation, or AI/HPC clients and their standardized operating requirements.
  • Certifications such as PE, CEM, CFM, ATD/ATS (Uptime Institute), CDCP/CDCS, PMP, LEED AP, or NFPA 70E
  • Experience with union environments, prevailing wage.
  • Global or multi-region portfolio solutioning experience.
  • Prior experience with major CMMS/IWMS platforms and asset data standardization.

OTHER DUTIES

At Lifebit, we're driven by the mission to make complex data analysis simpler and more accessible. We empower key institutions worldwide to revolutionize their data utilization and technology integration. Lifebit is powering the world’s federated data platforms for population-scale health and life sciences. Our Federated AI Platform is trusted across national health systems, global pharma, and research biobanks to unlock sensitive biomedical and real-world data securely, compliantly, and at scale.

As we scale through our Series B growth phase, we are expanding our product organization to meet the demands of a global market. Join us if you're inspired to tackle meaningful challenges and want to lead the next generation of health technology and cloud-based genomic solutions.

The Role

We are looking for a high-performing Product Manager to join our growing team and drive the evolution of our platform. In this role, you will be instrumental in bridging the gap between cutting-edge science and world-class software, ensuring our federated solutions solve the most pressing challenges for clinicians and researchers.

Lifebit specializes in managing the world’s most sensitive genomics data. We need a PM who thrives in an Agile environment, possesses a deep technical intuition, and can translate high-level business goals into a concrete, impactful product roadmap.

  • AI-Powered Platform Development: Lead the design and delivery of AI capabilities within a chat-based product interface, building agentic solutions that leverage tools, skills, agents, and diverse data sources to create a comprehensive agentic platform for users and researchers.
  • Data Architecture & Integration: Drive the strategy for data modeling, transformation, and standardization across the platform. Own the data ingestion pipeline and ensure seamless connectivity that makes data AI-ready and optimized for advanced analytics.

  • Regulatory Compliance:
    Work closely with Legal and Clinical teams to ensure all product features comply with UK-specific data residency requirements, GDPR, and international health data standards (ISO/IG).

What You Bring to the Table

  • Proven Track Record: Demonstrated experience owning and executing complex product roadmaps from inception to launch.
  • Technical Proficiency: Expert-level command of Jira and Confluence; ability to hold technical discussions with engineers regarding API architecture and data schemas.

  • Growth Mindset:
    Experience working in a high-growth Series B startup environment, demonstrating the ability to build scalable processes while remaining adaptable.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Biotech Acumen: Experience in genetics, medical sciences, or Bioinformatics is a significant plus, but a passion for the field is essential.

What We Offer

Lifebit is synonymous with a dynamic work culture that encourages both personal and professional growth. Our mission-driven organization is dedicated to making a significant impact in science and healthcare. We provide a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • AI Upskilling: Use up to £10,000 and 10 dedicated days per year for qualified AI-related professional development (AI certification, LLM workshop, or AI bootcamp).

  • Remote-First Culture: Work from anywhere in the UK with a home-office stipend. In accordance with 2026 UK employment reforms, we provide Day One access to paternity and unpaid parental leave.

  • Diverse Team: Join an international and diverse team passionate about transforming healthcare through data.
  • Deep Technology & Science: Get exposure to problems and applications in the cloud, data analysis, ML, life sciences, and big data fields.

Join us at Lifebit for a career that promises to be your next significant venture, dedicated to advancing the scientific and healthcare fields. Don't miss the chance to be part of our mission!

Life at Lifebit

Lifebit is dedicated to fostering an environment where employees can flourish, valuing individual strengths, skills, and passions. We prioritize health and well-being, offering comprehensive benefits and support. Our fully remote model is built on trust and asynchronous communication, utilizing virtual workshops and occasional off-sites to maximize creativity and innovation.

Lifebit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment. In compliance with the UK Employment Rights Act and Fair Work Agency guidelines, we ensure transparent pay structures and robust data privacy for all staff.

Compliance & Eligibility

Join us in reshaping the future of data analysis and technology integration.

jobs.description:
Marketing Manager, Content & Product Marketing

Remote (minimum 4-hour overlap with US Eastern hours) | Content & Product Marketing | Reports to: Director of Marketing

Time Doctor is hiring a Marketing Manager to bring our content and product marketing strategy to market. The Director of Marketing sets the strategy and priorities. Your job is to decide how to bring them to life, drive the work from brief through production, distribution and optimisation, and use AI to increase the speed and scale of everything we ship.

Who we are

Time Doctor is a workforce analytics platform that gives distributed teams the visibility they need to improve trust and performance. We serve remote, hybrid and outsourced organisations worldwide, with particular strength in BPO, healthcare and tech services. We are bootstrapped, profitable and fully remote, with team members across 30+ countries. We built a durable business on customer revenue rather than venture capital, and we are now focused on growing it.

The role

You will own our content program and editorial calendar end to end, and take our product marketing priorities to market. This is a broad B2B SaaS role spanning content, product marketing, organic growth and brand. You connect priorities across those areas and make sure search and AI visibility opportunities turn into meaningful marketing activity.

Three things define this seat.

  • The remit. Broad by design. You own initiatives, not individual tasks, across content, product marketing, organic distribution and brand, and you are the person who connects them.

  • The autonomy. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role. The Director of Marketing sets the priorities. You decide how to deliver them, make the day-to-day execution calls and drive the work through to completion. We need your expertise and judgement, not someone waiting for detailed direction.

  • The operating model. AI is part of how our marketing team works and a core expectation of this role. That means orchestrating agents, building automated workflows and using AI-enabled systems to run recurring work at greater speed and scale.

How we think about AI

We expect you to use AI for research, briefing, ideation, drafting, editing, repurposing and analysis, and to go further: building more efficient ways of working so recurring marketing work runs faster and at greater scale.

We are not looking for someone who simply uses AI to create more content faster. Judgement still matters. That means understanding the audience, finding the right narrative, challenging generic output, protecting the brand and knowing when something is not good enough to publish. You should be able to show us how AI has materially improved the quality, speed or scale of marketing execution in your previous work.

Who you are

  • You own initiatives, not tasks. Give you a priority and you work out what needs to happen next.

  • You turn strategic direction into a clear plan, then move comfortably between running the program and doing the work yourself.

  • You have strong editorial judgement. You don't need to write everything, but you recognise excellent content and you know how to make weak content better.

  • You treat publication as the start of a piece's life, not the finish line.

  • You have a performance mindset. You use data to decide what to improve, scale or stop.

  • You bring people together. Designers, writers, agencies, freelancers and cross-functional partners deliver because you coordinate them well.

  • You build with AI, and your judgement is what keeps the output good.

  • You bring ideas and recommendations of your own, and you thrive working fully remote.

What you will own

  • The content program. The content program and editorial calendar end to end, translating marketing priorities into what gets created, when, and how it is delivered across website, editorial, product marketing and campaign needs.

  • Execution. Driving work independently from brief to publication, making the day-to-day calls, solving delivery problems, and producing or shaping high-quality work directly when needed.

  • Distribution and social. Organic content distribution and social, with plans that extend the life and reach of priority content.

  • Product marketing to market. Taking product marketing priorities to market through product launches, sales enablement, product content, competitive assets and other GTM materials.

  • Campaign support. Partnering with Revenue Marketing to turn campaign and program requirements into the content, messaging and assets needed for activation, coordinating delivery and reusing existing content wherever possible.

  • Thought leadership. Turning company research, original data and executive perspectives into compelling thought leadership and derivative content across formats and channels.

  • Customer proof. Case studies, testimonials, customer stories and advocacy content, built in partnership with customer-facing teams.

  • Search and AI visibility. Bringing SEO, AI visibility, content gaps and refresh opportunities into content planning, balanced against audience and business priorities.

  • Performance. Using content, distribution, organic search and AI visibility performance to understand what is working, and recommending what we should improve, expand, repurpose or stop.

  • AI in the workflow. Orchestrating agents, building automated workflows and using AI-enabled systems to streamline recurring marketing work.

This role may not suit you if

  • You need detailed direction on how the work should get done. The Director sets the priorities, and deciding how to deliver them is your job.

  • You want to specialise in one lane. This role spans content, product marketing, organic growth and brand.

  • You see publication as the finish line.

  • AI for you means producing more content faster. We need workflows that improve execution, and the judgement to know when output is not good enough.

  • You would rather set strategy than execute. This is an individual-contributor role and you will produce or shape work directly.

  • You cannot commit to at least four hours a day of overlap with US Eastern business hours.

What a realistic week looks like

Planning next month's editorial calendar against the Director's priorities and the latest search and AI visibility gaps. Briefing a freelancer and a designer on a product launch page, then editing the first draft into shape yourself. Turning an original data report into a blog post, a social series and a sales one-pager. A working session with Revenue Marketing on the assets their next campaign needs, most of them reused from existing content. Reviewing last month's content performance across organic search, AI visibility and social, and recommending what to refresh or stop. Tightening an agent workflow that drafts content refreshes. Live collaboration during US Eastern hours, async for the rest of the day.

Requirements

Your experience

  • 5+ years of B2B SaaS marketing experience across content and integrated marketing programs, independently owning initiatives rather than individual tasks.

  • Experience taking marketing initiatives from a priority or brief through planning, production, distribution and measurement.

  • Experience owning content programs or editorial calendars in a B2B environment.

  • Strong writing, editing and editorial judgement.

  • Hands-on knowledge of organic social and content distribution, including repurposing strong source material across formats and channels.

  • Familiarity with product marketing programs such as product launches, sales enablement or product-led content.

  • Working knowledge of SEO and how organic discovery is changing with AI search. You don't need to be a technical SEO specialist, but you understand how search and AI visibility inform content decisions.

  • Demonstrated AI use beyond individual productivity: agents, automations or AI-enabled workflows that materially improved marketing execution. You can show us what you built and what it changed.

  • Confidence working with designers, writers, agencies, freelancers and other contributors, and strong project and stakeholder management when several people are involved in delivering something.

  • A performance mindset. You are comfortable using data to decide what to improve, scale or stop.

  • Remote, with a minimum four-hour daily overlap with US Eastern (ET) business hours.

Nice to have

  • Experience with customer storytelling, executive thought leadership, original research or PR-adjacent content. We wouldn't expect one person to have done all of these.

  • Experience with tools in our stack: Storyblok, HubSpot, Asana, GA4, Figma or Canva, and SEO or AI visibility platforms.

  • Background in workforce analytics, time tracking, HR tech or productivity software.

The team you are joining

You will sit within our Content & Product Marketing function and report to our Director of Marketing. You will work closely with Revenue Marketing, Product, Sales, Customer Success and Growth to turn marketing priorities into cohesive programs and bring them to market. You don't need to have used every tool in our stack, but you should be highly effective with modern marketing systems and able to quickly learn, connect and improve the tools you work with.

How we will measure success

  • The content program delivered on plan against the Director's priorities, from brief through distribution.

  • Reach and performance of priority content across organic search, AI visibility and social.

  • Product launches, enablement and GTM assets delivered on time and put to use by Sales and Customer Success.

  • More value from every piece of source content through reuse and repurposing.

  • More output, at a higher standard, because of the AI workflows you build.

Why this role

  • You own initiatives end to end, with real autonomy over how the work gets done.

  • A broad remit across content, product marketing, organic growth and brand.

  • You work AI-first, on a marketing team where AI is already part of how the work gets done.

  • We are profitable and bootstrapped. Your budget comes from customers, not from a burn rate.

  • Fully remote and flexible, working with talented people in 30+ countries.

Our hiring approach

Because AI is a core expectation of this role, our process asks you to show us how you have used it to materially improve the quality, speed or scale of marketing execution. Expect to walk us through real work you have built or shipped.

This is a full-time, 100% remote role. We are an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability.

We hire globally, and this particular role requires a minimum four-hour daily overlap with US Eastern business hours. Our Talent Attraction team will walk you through the details during your first conversation.

Job Description Summary:

About UofL Health:
UofL Health is a fully integrated regional academic health system with five hospitals, four medical centers, nearly 200 physician practice locations, more than 700 providers, the Frazier Rehab Institute and Brown Cancer Center.
With more than 12,000 team members—physicians, surgeons, nurses, pharmacists and other highly skilled health care professionals—UofL Health is focused on one mission: delivering patient-centered care to each and every patient each and every day.

Job Description:

Position Summary and Purpose
The Coder II is responsible for abstracting and assigning valid CPT, ICD-10, HCPCs and modifiers to ensure appropriate reimbursement in accordance with federal, state, and private health plans as well as organization and regulatory guidance. This position is responsible for identifying compliance concerns, trends, and education opportunities to ensure proper coding, documentation, and accuracy of billing within their areas or responsibility/specialty. The Coder II will work independently with limited oversight and may require direction from supervisor or more senior co-workers on complex cases. Responsible for coding surgical procedures in accordance with the Coding Guidelines for Surgical Procedures. Proper use of modifiers in surgical coding.

Essential Functions:
• Accurately abstracts information from the service documentation, assigns appropriate CPT, ICD-10, HCPCs codes into the appropriate billing systems, ensuring compliance with established guidelines
• Identifies and communicates deficiencies that impact the billing process
• Completes encounters in the coding work queue or reports in a timely manner
• Identifies trends and educational opportunities to ensure proper coding, documentation, and accuracy of billing within areas of responsibility/specialty

• Reviews and resolves denials

  • Ensures documentation meets current EM Guidelines for Providers
    • Ensures documentation meets Teaching Physician Rules as mandated by the Center for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) and UofL Health policies prior to release of a code for billing
    • Ensures documentation for Advanced Practice Providers meets payer specific rules prior to release of a code for billing
    • Provides comments/suggestion relative to weak areas identified in the coding reviews
    • Provides trending deficiencies to Senior Manager and Compliance Educator, as appropriate
    • Assists Coder Lead or Supervisor in training and mentoring staff.

Other Functions:
• Communicates professionally with providers, practice management, and other stake holders either verbally or in writing
• Meets or exceeds organization coding production and quality standards
• Participates in special projects and completes duties as assigned
• Develop daily/weekly communication with office managers, department, and providers.
• Responds in a timely manner to questions from manager, providers, department, and representative
• Maintains compliance with rules and regulations regarding coding
• Ability to work within a team environment and meet monthly goals
• Maintains compliance with all company policies, procedures and standards of conduct
• Complies with HIPAA privacy and security requirements to maintain confidentiality at all times

• Performs other duties as assigned

Additional Job Description:

Job Requirements
(Education, Experience, Licensure and Certification)

Education:

  • High school diploma or GED/equivalent (required)
    Experience:
    • Three (3) years of coding experience (required)
    • Previous Electronic Health Record Experience (preferred)
    Certification:
    • Certified Professional Coder (CPC) accredited by the American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC) (required)
    • Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) or Certified Coding Specialists Based (CCS-P) accredited by the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA) (required)
    Job Competency:
    Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities critical to this role:
    • Advanced knowledge of medical codes involving selections of most accurate and description code using the ICD 10, CPT, HCPC, and IHS coding conventions
    • Understands and applies regulatory changes and stays current with coding updates, including NCCI and MUE edits.
    • Advanced working knowledge of anatomy and physiology, disease process and medical terminology
    • Advanced knowledge of official coding conventions and rules established by the American Medical Association (AMA), and the Center for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) for assignment of diagnostic and procedural codes
    Ability to work independently with little oversight
    Language Ability:
    • Must be able to able to communicate effectively, demonstrating a high level of professionalism in all communications
    • Proper grammar, spelling, punctuation and composition expected in correspondence and report preparation

Reasoning Ability:

  • Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists
    • Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form

Computer Skills:

  • Must be proficient with Microsoft, Google Chrome, Internet navigation, and database management

• Able to adapt to new technologies

Additional Responsibilities:
• Demonstrates a commitment to service, organization values and professionalism through appropriate conduct and demeanor at all times
• Maintains confidentiality and protects sensitive data at all times
• Adheres to organizational and department specific safety standards and guidelines
• Works collaboratively and supports efforts of team members
• Demonstrates exceptional customer service and interacts effectively with physicians, patients, residents, visitors, staff and the broader health care community

UofL Health Core Expectation:
At UofL Health, we expect all our employees to live the values of honesty, integrity and compassion and demonstrate these values in their interactions with others and as they deliver excellent patient care by:
• Honoring and caring for the dignity of all persons in mind, body, and spirit
• Ensuring the highest quality of care for those we serve
• Working together as a team to achieve our goals
• Improving continuously by listening, and asking for and responding to feedback
• Seeking new and better ways to meet the needs of those we serve

• Using our resources wisely

  • Understanding how each of our roles contributes to the success of UofL Health

Overview

JOB TITLE: Document Management Analyst II

AGENCY SUPPORTED: U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) – MEGA 6 Automated Litigation Support

LOCATION: Remote

CLEARANCE: Public Trust – Candidates do not need to be cleared at the time of application but must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance prior to starting.

ITC Federal, LLC (ITC) connects technology advancements in automation and AI, customer experience, and financial services to solve government mission challenges, enabling smoother operational efficiency and bolstering national security. We leverage the latest technology innovations and proven approaches to better serve the mission and support the DHS, DOJ, and DoW workforce, customers, and programs, regardless of scale or complexity. ITC is located in Fairfax, VA and offers an outstanding compensation and benefits plan and a challenging and rewarding professional work environment.

We are seeking an experienced Document Management Analyst II to support ITC Federal’s work for the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) under the anticipated MEGA 6 automated litigation support (ALS) program. This is a fully remote position supporting DOJ’s complex litigation mission.

Important: This opening is being established in connection with the MEGA 6 contract vehicle award itself. ITC Federal must still be awarded individual task orders under the vehicle before employees can be onboarded. Accordingly, this position is full-time and contingent upon both contract award and the award of the applicable task order.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

In addition to performing functions of Document Management Technician, as described below, performs moderately complex litigation support tasks, including, for example, detailed review and analysis of case materials in a broad range of subject matters, such as financial records, health care materials, and other litigation files; detailed indexing of case files; drafting procedures for accomplishing litigation support assignments; document acquisition related tasks; screening for privilege documents; and conducting database searches.

PROGRAM CONTEXT:

This position supports the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) under the anticipated MEGA 6 procurement. MEGA 6 is expected to continue DOJ’s multiple-award contract vehicle for automated litigation support (ALS) services, following the structure of the MEGA 5 contract. These contracts are designed to provide DOJ offices, boards, divisions, and other federal agencies with information technology, professional services, and litigation support tools to manage complex legal proceedings efficiently.

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Proofreads and edits deliverable products.
  • Sometimes serves as "team leader" for larger group of Document Management Technicians and clerical support staff.
  • Often works with minimal supervision.
  • Reports to Task Supervisor or Project Supervisor.

Qualifications

REQUIRED:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Public Trust clearance prior to start (candidates are not required to be cleared at the time of application).
  • Authorized to work in the United States.
  • Abiliy to work effectively in a fully remote environment.
  • Three years of experience on major litigation support projects or undergraduate degree.
  • Certain assignments may require experience or substantial undergraduate coursework in, for example, finance/accounting, health care, or substantial experience in the legal environment or in information technology.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently in a team environment.
  • Must have excellent writing skills and oral communication capabilities.
  • Requires hands-on familiarity with the Government's office and network environment, including but not limited to, data processing environments, including office automation networks, PC-based databases and other applications, internet and server-based databases and other applications, such as Oracle, Relativity or other document review platform, Trial Director, etc. Should be a knowledgeable user of the Government's office and network environment, including but not limited to, word processing, spreadsheet, imaging, and hardware systems.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Familiarity with ESI tools and knowledge of eDiscovery procedures and resources preferred.

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • This is a fully remote position; work is performed from a home office.
  • Work is primarily sedentary, performed while using a computer for extended periods of time.

Highlights

  • Location: Armenia, Remote (CET)

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

About the Role

A great campaign page doesn't just tell a story. It turns a visitor into a donor.

Campaign Pages are where nonprofits launch campaigns, tell their stories and convert donors before checkout. They sit close to revenue, next to Checkout Modal and Elements in our Pre-Donation Experience. You will be the one person accountable for the Campaign Pages roadmap, quality and delivery. Your job is to make the product scalable, ready for enterprise customers and a clear driver of revenue, while traffic keeps growing and the product stays stable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the Campaign Pages strategy and a 6–12 month roadmap aligned with Product and Pre-Donation Experience priorities, and explain the reasoning behind decisions to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Run continuous discovery using customer, GTM, Support, funnel and competitive signals. Separate one-off requests from systemic opportunities and validate problems before anything gets built.
  • Drive delivery end to end with a dedicated Engineering Team Lead, Product Designer and Product Analyst: clear PRDs and edge cases, a backlog that is ready 2–3 sprints ahead, and launches with proper instrumentation.
  • Own product health and enterprise readiness, covering conversion, page performance, reliability, publishing issues and support volume. Resolve deal-breakers and churn-risk requests within agreed SLAs.
  • Partner with PM Growth on experiments, personalisation and ARPV initiatives. Prioritise incoming hypotheses against your own product data, and carry winning learnings across Checkout, Elements and Campaign Pages.
  • Keep Engineering, Design, Analytics, GTM, Support and adjacent PMs aligned. Coordinate dependencies with Platform, Checkout, Gift Cart, Billing and Integrations when work touches shared systems.
  • Make sure GTM, Support and CSMs know what is shipping, why it matters and how to explain it to customers.
  • At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool, not an experimental one. We expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work, identify where AI can change the shape of problems in their function, and grow their fluency as the tools evolve. In this role, that means using AI for research synthesis, spec drafting, analysis and communication, with your assumptions and sources made explicit.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 5+ years in Product Management or Product Ownership, ideally in B2B or enterprise SaaS, fundraising, marketing technology, e-commerce or conversion-focused products.
  • Proven end-to-end ownership of a product area: roadmap, discovery, execution, launch and measurement.
  • Strong delivery discipline: you write clear specs, cover edge cases and keep Engineering unblocked.
  • Analytical rigour: you use funnels, metrics, support signals and qualitative feedback to prioritise.
  • Systems thinking: you can see how a surface connects to checkout, payments, analytics, integrations and GTM workflows.
  • A working understanding of growth and experimentation: how hypotheses are generated, prioritised and measured.
  • Strong UX sensibility and a good working partnership with Design.
  • Hands-on, everyday AI use in product work.
  • Strong written English and professional spoken English.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with landing pages, campaign or website builders, CMS, donation or checkout flows.
  • Hands-on experimentation, personalisation or conversion-optimisation work, including converting paid traffic after it reaches the landing page.
  • Experience in nonprofit tech, fundraising, payments or marketing operations.
  • Experience handling enterprise customer requests and GTM escalations.

You'll Thrive Here If You…

  • Own outcomes, not tasks, and don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.
  • Can hold a wide context and still move quickly.
  • Say no to a loud request when the data says something else matters more, and can explain why.
  • Care as much about stability as about the next shiny experiment.
  • Give and ask for candid feedback without ego.
  • Get energy from aligning several teams around one shared goal.
  • Keep sharpening your AI workflow because you want to, not because you were told to.
  • Want your work to translate directly into more money reaching nonprofits.

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is $4,600 - $5,000 gross per month.

jobs.description:
Für unsere innovative Tochterfirma Thoesch, die mit ihrer Voice-first Guest-Experience-Plattform die digitale Gästekommunikation von morgen gestaltet, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine/n Full-Stack Entwickler (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt API-Integration, KI/LLM und GUI.

Deine Aufgaben:

Du verantwortest zentrale Entwicklungsbereiche außerhalb der eigentlichen Voice-Skill-Entwicklung – von der API- und Systemintegration über die Weiterentwicklung unserer Benutzeroberflächen bis hin zur Integration moderner KI- und LLM-Technologien.

  • Konzeption, Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung eigener REST-APIs sowie Integration heterogener Drittsysteme (PMS, Buchungs-/eCommerce-Tools, Destinationsdatenquellen)
  • Weiterentwicklung der GUI/Frontend-Komponenten von RoomGrid (Dashboard, Content-Manager, Device-Manager u. a.) in JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Praktische Integration und Weiterentwicklung von KI-Technologien: LLMs, RAG, Embeddings und Vector Stores für kontextuelle, KI-gestützte Anwendungen
  • Idealerweise Anbindung KI-gestützter Tools/Schnittstellen über das Model Context Protocol (MCP)
  • Mitarbeit an Backend, Datenbanken sowie Docker-/CI-CD-Infrastruktur je nach Bedarf
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründerteam

Unsere Architektur

RoomGrid ist die zentrale Orchestrierungsschicht unserer Plattform und verbindet mehrere Systemwelten über APIs:

  • Property-Management- & Backend-Systeme der Hotels (PMS-Konnektivität)
  • Voice-Enabled Devices der großen Ökosysteme: Amazon Alexa, Google, Samsung, Apple
  • Destination-Daten (Events, Attraktionen, POIs) für kontextuelle Antworten
  • ECommerce-, Reservierungs- und weitere externe Provider-Schnittstellen
  • Interne Module: Voice Content Manager, Campaign Scheduler, Device Manager, Ticket-System, Dashboard & Analytics

Für die KI-gestützten, kontextuellen Echtzeit-Antworten unseres Sprachassistenten setzen wir auf LLM-, RAG- und Embedding-/Vector-Store-Technologien — bei strikter Wahrung des Datenschutzes: Es werden keine Gespräche aufgezeichnet und keine personenbezogenen oder finanziellen Daten gespeichert. In der aktuellen Skalierungsphase (2026–2028) bauen wir zusätzlich eigene Hardware- und Hosting-Infrastruktur auf.

Das solltest Du mitbringen

  • Erfahrung in der Integration heterogener Systeme über REST APIs sowie in der Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung eigener APIs. Sicherer Umgang mit JSON, HTTP, Authentifizierungsverfahren und API-Dokumentationen
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in JavaScript/TypeScript und Erfahrung in der GUI-Entwicklung
  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Integration von KI-Technologien, insbesondere Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG, Embeddings und Vector Stores

Wünschenswert / starkes Plus

  • Erfahrung mit dem Model Context Protocol (MCP) und der Entwicklung KI-gestützter Anwendungen und Schnittstellen

Gute Zusatzqualifikation

  • Backend-Entwicklung und Datenbanken
  • Docker und CI/CD

Persönlich passt du zu uns, wenn du …

  • über Deinen eigenen Aufgabenbereich hinaus denkst, Themen eigenständig voran bringst und Dich in einer vielseitigen, praxisnahen Entwicklungsrolle wohl fühlst
  • gerne im Team arbeitest und technische Lösungen gemeinsam mit dem Gründerteam voranbringst.
  • die Ärmel hochkrempelst und pragmatisch anpackst
  • dich stetig weiterentwickeln möchtest
  • Ein Jahresbruttogehalt zwischen 60.000 und 66.000 Euro bei 12 Monatsgehältern (Deutscher Arbeitsvertrag) – abhängig von Deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation
  • Viel Verantwortung und echten Gestaltungsspielraum in einem wachsenden Technologieunternehmen
  • Die Möglichkeit, eine innovative Plattform in einem internationalen Zukunftsmarkt aktiv mitzuentwickeln
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit einem erfahrenen Gründerteam
  • Raum für eigene Ideen, pragmatische Lösungen und fachliche Weiterentwicklung
  • Remote Work mit Vor-Ort Arbeitsmöglichkeiten in Berg und Innsbruck
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten

Klingt nach Dir?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen! Schick uns einfach Deinen Lebenslauf und erzähl uns kurz, warum Du Lust hast, gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft sprachgesteuerter Gästeerlebnisse zu entwickeln. Uns ist dabei nicht wichtig, dass Du jedes einzelne Kriterium erfüllst – entscheidend sind Deine Erfahrung, Deine Motivation und die Bereitschaft, Dich gemeinsam mit uns weiterzuentwickeln.

Thoesch entwickelt eine der führenden Voice-first Guest-Experience-Plattformen für Hotels, Destinationen und Resorts. Als DACH-Marktführer sind wir bereits in vier Destinationen und mehr als 50 Hotels im Einsatz – unter anderem in Verona, Innsbruck, Zell am See-Kaprun und im Alpbachtal.

Unsere SaaS-Plattform verbindet Sprachassistenten wie Amazon Alexa, Google, Samsung und Apple nahtlos mit Hotel-PMS, Backend-Systemen und touristischen Destinationsdaten. Unser Sprachassistent zählt laut Amazon zu den erfolgreichsten Hotel-Skills weltweit und erreicht eine tägliche Nutzungsrate von über 45 Prozent.

Nach der Fusion mit RoomPal, Europas Nummer zwei im Markt, verfolgen wir ein klares Ziel: Gemeinsam bauen wir die führende europäische Plattform für sprachgesteuerte Gästeerlebnisse.

Bei uns arbeitest Du an einer innovativen Technologie mit echtem Praxisnutzen und gestaltest aktiv mit, wie Hotels und Destinationen künftig mit ihren Gästen kommunizieren. Dich erwarten viel Gestaltungsspielraum, kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, Deine Ideen in einem wachsenden Zukunftsmarkt direkt einzubringen.

jobs.description:
This is an individual contributor role


About the role:

Gartner is building the industry's leading Tech Market Economics capability to understand where AI creates, captures and destroys value across the technology ecosystem, from trillion-dollar infrastructure investments to the economics of technology providers. As a Senior Director Analyst, you will lead the development of a new generation of data-driven Gartner positions, partnering with our Tech Market Economics Modelling, Data Science and Data Engineering teams to uncover insights others cannot and scale their impact across Gartner's global research footprint.

The role demands exceptional judgment and intellectual curiosity. You will draw on emerging signals, novel data sources and pioneering analytical approaches, combining your expertise with the broader models, data assets and methodologies of Tech Market Economics. Success comes from recognizing when disparate signals converge to an insight worthy of Gartner's voice. The most valuable insights rarely emerge from a single dataset, model or methodology. They emerge from synthesizing multiple forms of evidence into judgements that initially appear impossible to make, but become irrefutable once the underlying economics, signals and market dynamics are understood.

This role is for the persistently curious, energized by discovering what others have yet to see, connecting seemingly unrelated signals and transforming emerging insights into market-shaping research. Through research, client engagement, media interactions and keynote

presentations, you will influence executive and industry thinking as

a definitive authority on Tech Market Economic trends.

What you will do:

  • Develop differentiated Gartner positions on the economic impact of AI and technology disruption across markets, business models and value chains.
  • Partner with the Tech Market Economics Modelling team to translate emerging signals into market-shaping research and thought leadership.
  • Synthesize economics, quantitative evidence, novel data sources and domain expertise into differentiated and defensible Gartner perspectives.
  • Develop research insights capable of influencing executive decisions, industry narratives and market conversations before they become broadly accepted.
  • Shape the evolution of Tech Market Economics by identifying the most important market opportunities and questions to address.
  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can influence the future direction of research agendas.
  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content
  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act
  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice through virtual or face-to-face interactions
  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials Gartner conferences, Industry events, media engagements, and client briefings
  • Support Gartner sales and business development activities through differentiated market insights and executive engagement.
  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review
  • Build credibility as a recognized authority on Tech Market Economic trends and represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy.
  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers across Gartner.
  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members
  • Maintain a client-centric approach focused on delivering actionable insights and measurable client value.

What you will need:

  • Demonstrated experience assessing the economic, commercial and competitive implications of Agentic AI disruption across markets, products, business models or value chains.
  • Experience synthesizing economic analysis, quantitative evidence, financial statements, market intelligence and business context into differentiated research, thought leadership and strategic recommendations.
  • Proven ability to identify emerging economic and market shifts and translate multiple sources of evidence into compelling executive-level narratives, research judgments or business insights.
  • Strong judgment in evaluating emerging signals, economic evidence and analytical findings, with the ability to determine the earliest point at which the collective weight of evidence is decision grade.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred
  • 12+ years of relevant field or industry experience
  • Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders
  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables
  • Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability
  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions
  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges
  • Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply
  • Subject matter expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements
  • Strong business and financial acumen
  • Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market
  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team
  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments
  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Flodesk is building toward a future where small business owners do not need to be expert marketers to grow. Today, our AI helps members create and edit emails, but that is only the starting point. We are building a system that can understand a member's business, brand, audience and past performance, then help turn a goal into a complete marketing campaign across email, workflows, forms, sales pages, segmentation, scheduling, analytics and recommendations.

Reporting to the Head of Product, AI Systems and Core Experience, you will shape how that system behaves and how we know it is good. You will own Flodesk's prompts, agent instructions, quality definitions, evaluation criteria and continuous-improvement loop by building the technical tooling, prototypes and evaluation infrastructure that make this work measurable and scalable. This is not a role for writing clever prompts in isolation. It is hands-on systems work at that connects engineering, product and natural language. You will need to understand how context, models, tools, product state and structured outputs come together to create a member experience, then identify the right layer to change when that experience fails.

  • Diagnose failures across prompts, context, orchestration, models, tools, data and product code, then fix the right layer or partner with the engineer who owns it.
  • Set quality baselines and release gates for prompt, model and agent changes. Turn production failures, traces and member feedback into durable regression cases
  • Partner with product, design, marketing and copy experts to encode Flodesk's point of view into the system, while bringing your own judgment about how the product should behave

What you bring

  • A track record of building or meaningfully improving production LLM or agentic products, not just prototypes

  • Systems thinking and reusable patterns guide your work, so today's email experience gets better without building in assumptions that make tomorrow's surfaces harder to build
  • Across technical and nontechnical disciplines, your communication is clear and you can explain tradeoffs involving quality, latency, reliability and cost

Bonus points if you've:

Job Description

The Customer Success Advocate is a front-line, customer-facing role responsible for ensuring that customers realize the full value of Motorola Solutions’ hybrid-cloud portfolio. This role focuses on driving product adoption, advancing workflow maturity, and strengthening long-term relationships. Success is measured by the ability to turn technology investments into measurable outcomes through high adoption, retention, and customer advocacy.


As a Customer Success Advocate, you will manage a portfolio of customers within an assigned region, working under the guidance of the Senior Manager, Regional Customer Success. You will engage end users and key stakeholders to ensure our solutions are successfully onboarded, configured for real-world workflows, and consistently used in mission-critical scenarios.

jobs.title: System Modeling (Computation)
jobs.excerpt: About UnconventionalSince 2022, AI has entered the mainstream, reshaping entire industries from education and software development to fundamental consumer behaviors.
jobs.description:
About Unconventional

Since 2022, AI has entered the mainstream, reshaping entire industries from education and software development to fundamental consumer behaviors. This revolution has created an unprecedented demand for computation - a demand that is now fundamentally limited by energy, not just in the datacenter, but at a global scale.

At Unconventional, our mission is to solve this. We are rethinking computing from the ground up to build a new foundation for AI that is 1000x more efficient. We're doing this by exploiting the rich physics of semiconductors, mapping neural networks directly to the device physics rather than relying on layers of inefficient abstraction.

The Role

As a Member of Technical Staff, System Modeling (Computation), you will be part of a hands-on R&D team building simulation frameworks that enable evaluation and rapid iteration across all layers of unconventional physics-based computing systems for machine learning workloads. “Extreme co-design” is our guiding principle.

System Modeling is a multi-disciplinary effort, and the team we’re building reflects that. The role involves development of physics-based system models, GPU-accelerated ML system simulations, and cross-layer system integration. You don’t need to be an expert in all of these, but you have to be very strong in at least one, and solid in the rest.

Responsibilities

You will be responsible for one or more of the following tasks:

  • Architecting Foundational Solvers: Building large-scale, GPU-accelerated, high-fidelity numerical differential equation solvers (ODE, SDE, CDE, PDE). You will build tools that enable rapid iteration, multiple architectures, and rich metrics/visualization, leveraging frameworks best suited for scientific ML (e.g., JAX, PyTorch, or custom CUDA/Triton kernels).
  • Bridging Physics and Machine Learning: Developing physics-based surrogate models of device- and system-level behavior in unconventional compute. You will create clean, composable abstractions that expose algorithm–hardware tradeoffs and enable cross-layer optimization via end-to-end autodiff.
  • Extreme Co-Design & Collaboration: Working closely with hardware and algorithm teams to understand their simulation needs, supporting everything from high-level algorithm development to the low-level verification of novel, analog hardware.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Education
    • MS/PhD in a quantitative field (AI/ML, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Applied Math), or BS with substantial, clear evidence of equivalent research/engineering depth.
  • Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) & Numerical Methods(replaces Dynamical computation knowledge)
  • Deep expertise in numerical differential equation solvers (e.g., ODE, SDE, DDE) and their implementation on parallel architectures (e.g., Rosenbrock methods, Euler-Maruyama, adjoint methods, implicit solvers).
  • Experience with high-performance, customized GPU kernel development for numerical methods, including GPU memory optimization and multi-GPU scaling.
  • Experience building effective neural network surrogate models (e.g., Neural ODEs) for complex dynamical systems.
  • ML and systems fluency
    • Solid understanding of modern AI/ML architectures and training/inference workflows.
    • Strong experience implementing and debugging ML models in PyTorch (preferred) or similar, with practical experience profiling, optimizing, and stabilizing non-trivial large-scale ML systems.

Preferred Qualifications

We are looking for well-rounded candidates. While the minimum qualifications focus on the core modeling and ML expertise, candidates who possess the following qualities will be the most impactful.

  • Software Engineering & API Craftsmanship
    • Exceptional Python engineering skills with a passion for Developer Experience (DX), elegant API design, strong typing, and composability.
    • Experience with compiler-friendly ML paradigms and internals (e.g., JAX vmap/pmap/jit, PyTorch autograd/torch.compile, custom XLA or Triton kernels).
    • A track record of building open-source tools, scientific libraries, or serious simulation/modeling frameworks from scratch.
  • Dynamic Systems Knowledge
    • Familiarity with analog dynamic systems, including transient responses, and nonidealities such as nonlinearity, quantization, random noise, and feedback/stability.
  • Systems Thinking
    • Demonstrated ability to reason across multiple layers of the stack: algorithm, software, compiler, runtime, and hardware.
    • Able to cleanly connect model architecture choices to system performance implications (memory bandwidth, communication patterns, latency, energy, and numerical stability).
    • Experience applying efficiency techniques natively within modeling frameworks (quantization, sparsity, pruning, distillation, kernel fusion, etc.).

Why Join Us?

  • The Mission: Redefine computing for the next 50 years by solving the fundamental energy limitation of AI at a global scale.
  • The Impact: Shape the company's future as a foundational team member. Enjoy massive ownership and an outsized opportunity to drive change.
  • The Challenge: Dive into deeply complex, intellectually stimulating, and unsolved problems at the cutting edge of multiple, converging fields.
  • The Perks: A comprehensive package including best-in-class health benefits, 401k matching, truly unlimited PTO, and complimentary meals when working from our Palo Alto office.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Our Enterprise Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our top customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

This role is a remote position open to candidates residing in Germany. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

Will require travel to customer sites in Germany, The Netherlands and the United Kingdom, for up to 20% of the time, which may include overnight stays.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether a customer achieves their sustainability goals, or whether power gets restored quickly after an incident
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform
  • Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, and timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value
  • Orchestrate executive business reviews with our customers’ decision-makers and our executive leadership where we look back at past successes and align on upcoming goals
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to get the most out of their Samsara products
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more
  • Serve as a mentor to the wider Customer Success and Support teams
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 4+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution
  • Fluency in German required

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
  • Experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies
  • Thrives in an unstructured, fast-paced, and change-heavy environment

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:


The RCM Transformation Senior Manager provides specialized depth and breadth of operational expertise across front, middle, and back-office Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) functions—including coding, charge capture/charge integrity, hospital and professional billing, cash posting, denials management, and accounts receivable follow-up. Reporting to the Senior Director of Finance Transformation, with a dotted-line relationship to the Executive Director of Revenue Cycle Transformation, this role serves as an internal subject matter expert for assigned RCM transformation initiatives / projects. Working independently, with guidance in only the most complex situations, the Senior Manager validates and stress-tests design recommendations against real-world operational conditions to ensure redesign decisions are practical, sustainable, and tailored to BMCHS's environment.

The RCM Transformation Senior Manager leads assigned workstreams and projects with moderate resources requirements, risk, and complexity within the RCM operating model redesign and helps build the financial case supporting the program's cost-to-collect and net revenue targets. This role's impact is realized through the successful redesign and stabilization of RCM operations over a multi-year horizon, positioning BMCHS for sustained financial and operational performance.


Position: Revenue Cycle Management Transformation Senior Manager

Department: Finance Administration

Schedule: Full Time


ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES / DUTIES:

  • Serve as RCM subject-matter expert. Serves as the revenue cycle operations subject-matter expert on assigned transformation workstreams, applying specialized knowledge of back- and middle-office RCM functions—including coding, charge capture, hospital and professional billing, cash posting, denials management, and AR follow-up—to validate current-state findings, stress-test recommendations, and ensure design decisions are operationally credible.
  • Support target operating model design Partners day-to-day with internal stakeholders and external consulting resources to benchmark current-state cost-to-collect and net revenue yield against industry standards, and to co-design the future-state target operating model, process workflows, and organizational structure for in-scope RCM functions.
  • Lead assigned transformation workstreams. Leads assigned RCM transformation workstreams of moderate complexity from current-state diagnostics through future-state design, pilot testing, and go-live, directing the day-to-day work of consulting resources and cross-functional contributors on an initiative basis without formal supervisory authority.
  • Build and maintain workstream financial models. Builds and maintains the financial and quantitative models to evaluate workstream impact, tracks benefit realization against the program's cost-to-collect reduction and net revenue uplift targets. Monitors operational metrics, identifies variances and recommends corrective actions to leadership.
  • Evaluate vendor and technology options. Evaluates outsourcing, managed-services, and technology/automation options (including AI and RPA) for in-scope back- and middle-office RCM functions, and contributes RCM subject-matter expertise to vendor selection and contracting discussions.
  • Drive change management and stakeholder alignment. Leads change management and stakeholder alignment across RCM operations, revenue cycle leadership, and Finance, translating recommendations into practical guidance for the operational teams affected by the redesign; leverages deep subject matter expertise to resolve operational conflicts and build consensus across RCM
  • Report progress to leadership. Prepares and presents progress updates, risk assessments, and analytical summaries on assigned workstreams to Finance and Revenue Cycle Transformation leadership and other stakeholders.

(The above statements in this job description are intended to depict the general nature and level of work assigned to the employee(s) in this job. The above is not intended to represent an exhaustive list of accountable duties and responsibilities required).


Disclaimer: Percentages are approximations used for job evaluation purposes. Actual time spent on specific duties may fluctuate based on operational needs and department priorities
