jobs.description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead strategy and product direction for Printify Sales Experience — the merchant-success layer that helps merchants convert intent into real commercial activity and build the behaviors that drive sustainable growth.

Merchants don't need another dashboard telling them what already happened — they need a system that understands where they are, tells them what matters next, and helps them act. We're starting with new merchants, guiding them from onboarding and product creation through store launch on sales channels, first sale, and early GMV. Our merchant-success system spans AI-led onboarding, merchant intelligence, gamification, lifecycle interventions, sales channels expansions as well as connections to mentorship and community, and serves other segments and channels.

This is a product leadership role with company-level impact. You will manage a team of two product managers and drive outcomes across multiple squads and functions through product judgment, strategic clarity, and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into coordinated action.

Who You Are

A product leader who pairs systems thinking with strong commercial and execution judgment — equally comfortable in merchant research, funnel data, AI opportunities, and business cases. You can take an ambiguous question like "how do we materially grow merchant success?" and turn it into a problem model, KPI tree, and prioritized roadmap. You lead through influence, aligning Engineering, Design, Data, Lifecycle Marketing, Commercial, and leadership around a shared view of the problem, and you know when the answer is a new feature versus a platform capability, better intelligence, or not building at all.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy, Discovery & Business Ownership

  • Define and evolve Sales Experience's product strategy, owning the merchant-success problem end-to-end — activation, first sale, early GMV, retention — rather than a fixed feature set.

  • Set the North Star and KPI tree, and define how the journey should differ by merchant segment, starting with Shopify while architecting for reuse across other sales channels.

  • Build a deep understanding of why merchants progress or stall using research, behavioral data, cohort analysis, and experimentation; map the journey end-to-end and identify the highest-leverage interventions.

  • Continuously reprioritize — kill low-confidence ideas and make explicit trade-offs between near-term metric gains and capabilities that compound over time.

AI-Led Merchant Success

  • Shape how AI drives the Sales Hub experience: a context-aware system, not a generic assistant, that uses merchant, catalog, and behavioral data to guide next steps.

  • Explore and validate experiences such as personalized onboarding, next-best-action recommendations, and proactive interventions; define where gamification (missions, milestones, streaks) genuinely changes behavior versus adding superficial engagement.

  • Partner with Engineering, Data, and AI/ML on feasibility, cost, trust, and scalability, ensuring AI initiatives tie to measurable merchant and business outcomes rather than adoption for its own sake.

Cross-Domain Execution & Commercial Leadership

  • Translate strategy into phased initiatives with clear outcomes, scope, dependencies, and decision gates, driving alignment across Engineering, Design, Data, Commercial, and Lifecycle before work starts.

  • Lead complex trade-offs without defaulting to escalation, and build post-launch discipline — measuring outcomes and deciding to scale, iterate, or stop.

  • Make data a decision-making tool: build rigorous understanding of funnels, cohorts, and economics, and define success metrics and instrumentation before development begins.

  • Connect product investment to commercial outcomes (GMV, retention, LTV) and be explicit about opportunity cost, including what not to pursue.

Organizational Leverage

  • Act as a trusted partner to senior leadership on merchant growth and AI strategy, bringing structure and evidence to ambiguous or contentious decisions.

  • Balance your own individual contribution with coaching and mentoring Product Managers, and create reusable frameworks so the organization gets better at solving merchant-success problems without depending on you for every decision.

What Success Looks Like

  • Sales Experience has a clear multi-year strategy, merchant segmentation, KPI tree, and prioritized roadmap that's understood across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, and leadership.

  • More high-intent merchants progress from onboarding to first sale, early GMV, and continued activity including sales channel expansion, with measurable improvement in early cohort performance.

  • AI-driven guidance shows repeated, measurable value rather than novelty-driven usage, and becomes increasingly personalized by merchant intent, behavior, and stage.

  • Shopify proves the model, with successful capabilities becoming reusable across other channels.

  • Cross-team initiatives run with clear ownership and decision rights, and experiments consistently produce explicit decisions to scale, iterate, or stop.

  • Senior leaders rely on your judgment for merchant growth and investment decisions, and PMs grow through your coaching.

What You'll Bring

  • Extensive Product Management experience in high-growth SaaS, marketplace, e-commerce, creator economy, or platform businesses, with a track record of driving significant customer and commercial impact across complex, multi-squad domains.

  • Deep expertise in activation, onboarding, retention, growth loops, and experimentation, plus strong AI product judgment — able to distinguish real customer value from technology-led novelty.

  • Advanced analytical skills (funnels, cohorts, segmentation, KPI trees, opportunity sizing) and strong commercial judgment connecting product decisions to GMV, revenue, retention, or LTV.

  • Proven ability to operate in highly ambiguous problem spaces, think in systems, and lead cross-functionally — aligning senior stakeholders around difficult trade-offs.

  • Strong technical fluency to partner with Engineering, Data, and AI teams, plus excellent written and verbal communication for both executive and delivery audiences.

  • Demonstrated experience leading and coaching Product Managers, enabling them to succeed and grow.

  • A plus: background with Shopify, Etsy, TikTok Shop, or other merchant/seller-ecosystem platforms.

What we offer:

  • A global, inclusive team that’s as supportive as it is ambitious and serious about getting things done

  • An opportunity to work remotely or in a modern and welcoming office in Riga

  • Flexible working hours (start your day as late as 11 AM)

  • Private health insurance

  • 2 extra paid days off to focus on your mental or physical well-being

  • 1 extra paid day off to celebrate a Birthday or any other celebration of your choice

  • Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons, both on-site and online

  • Free and healthy lunch if you work from the Rīga office

  • Design and order your own merch using our platforms with an employee discount

  • Exciting team-building events and parties you’ll never forget!

FYUL is the engine that powers on-demand commerce at global scale.

Formed in 2024 through the merger of Printful, Printify, and Snow Commerce, we bring together tech, talent, and infrastructure to help people turn ideas into beautiful products.

From solo creators to entertainment giants, FYUL powers merch that connects with millions, backed by advanced tech, premium production, and global reach.

We're a fast-growing global company working toward powering great brands, great experiences, and great people.

We are an equal-opportunity workplace. We’re committed to diversity and inclusion and make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and work experience.

If you think you’d excel in this role, send us your resume in English, showing us why you are the right person for the job.

Interested, but don’t think this is the right fit for you? Feel free to share it with friends and check out other open positions at our career site. We’re always looking for creative and driven minds to join our ever-growing team!

jobs.description:
job description

We are modernizing a business-critical Payroll product where correctness matters. As part of this transformation, we are building quality engineering AI-first and automation-first from the beginning.

This is not a traditional manual QA role, and it is also not a conventional test-automation role where AI is simply used to work faster. We want to use AI as a core part of how we understand existing behaviour, create test coverage, generate and manage test data, identify gaps, analyse failures and continuously improve quality.

You will help establish this capability from the ground up.

your tasks

  • Build an AI-first, automation-first quality engineering approach for Payroll
  • Create automated regression coverage for existing and newly modernized Payroll capabilities
  • Use AI as the primary tool to discover, generate and continuously improve relevant test scenarios
  • Create characterization and golden-master style tests for existing behaviour that is not sufficiently protected today
  • Build automated API, integration and service-level testing
  • Establish AI-driven test-data management as a core capability:
    • generate realistic and controlled test data
    • create variations and edge cases
    • maintain reusable test-data sets
    • identify missing scenarios
    • manage data safely and reproducibly
  • Work with Payroll domain experts to translate complex business rules into automated, repeatable validation
  • Use AI to analyse existing system behaviour and identify regression risks
  • Use AI to analyse test failures, cluster defects and help identify likely root causes
  • Integrate automated quality controls and quality gates directly into the delivery process, making quality engineering part of development rather than a separate phase at the end

your profile

  • Several years of experience in QA automation, quality engineering or software testing, with a strong understanding of automated testing principles
  • Practical experience with API, integration and backend testing as well as CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates
  • Good scripting skills and the ability to automate repetitive technical tasks
  • Strong analytical thinking and the ability to understand complex business rules, working closely with engineers and domain experts
  • An automation-first mindset: repetitive validation is automated by default, not performed manually
  • An AI-first mindset: you naturally consider AI and automation when solving quality-engineering challenges.
  • Payroll knowledge is not required, you will work closely with experienced Payroll domain experts.
Mandatory: AI-first test data management
A core requirement of this role is the ability to use AI as a fundamental part of the quality strategy when creating and managing test data. This includes generating representative Payroll scenarios, producing controlled variants and edge cases, identifying gaps in existing test data, and maintaining reusable, deterministic data sets as business rules evolve, ensuring test data remains explainable and suitable for automated regression testing.

your benefits

  • Collaboration within an empathetic and supportive team
  • You can put your knowledge and personal strengths to good use, and continue to develop your skills and grow
  • You’ll start with a structured onboarding process and learn ‘on the job’, through training sessions or informal learning formats and working in interdisciplinary and international teams

  • A wide range of benefits, e.g. pension scheme, health management – right through to staff discounts
  • Well-behaved dogs are very welcome at all our locations

CRM & Systems Management

  • Reconcile HubSpot data with Xero and other financial records.
  • Organize financial documents and shared accounting folders.

Process Improvement

  • Build and maintain Excel and Google Sheets templates, dashboards, and reporting tools.
  • Use formulas, pivot tables, and data validation to improve reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive accounting and reporting tasks.
  • Improve processes to reduce manual work and prevent errors.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Experience handling international payments and foreign currency transactions.
  • Strong understanding of financial reporting and account reconciliation.
  • Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to handle confidential financial information.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT GENERATION:At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives.
jobs.description:
ABOUT GENERATION:

At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have a 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. To date, Generation’s global graduates have earned more than $1.9 billion in wages. Generation graduates typically have a secondary school background, 52% are female, 28% have dependents, and the majority identify with underrepresented communities in their country.

Position Overview:

Generation is in the midst of a period of growth and innovation, with plans over the next 18 months to dramatically increase the number of people we serve, deepen our existing partnerships around the world, and expand and enhance the global tools, curriculum, and offerings that help drive our mission forward. To meet this moment, we are expanding our team with a number of exciting global and regional opportunities.

Under the guidance and review of a Global C&I Lead (or Senior C&I Leads in select regions), the Design Manager plans for and conducts activity mapping, develops high-level curriculum planning materials (e.g. performance goals, scope and sequence, schedule), gathers stakeholder feedback and employer input and revises and customizes programs accordingly. With oversight from an Global C&I Lead (or Senior C&I Leads in select regions), the Design Manager will manage external contractors in the writing of session plans and developing resources needed for program design.

This is a 3-month Fixed-Term, remote role in which we plan to interview from mid-late May with a target start date in June, 2026.

Location:

This role is remote, with preference given to candidates based in Delhi, India, Mexico City, Mexico, or Nairobi, Kenya (or any of our current Generation global affiliate countries).

Generation is an equal opportunity employer and actively encourages applications from people of all backgrounds.

Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities:

  • Design and write, or manage external contractors in the writing of, curriculum assets such as session guides, assessments, labs, skills application activities and more for both online and in-person learning settings.
  • Create exceptional learning experiences in virtual settings, such as an LMS.
  • Co-develop a project plan for creating a new curriculum or revising an existing one in partnership with a Global C&I Lead (or Senior C&I Leads in select regions)
  • Participate in curriculum team projects on an as needed basis, to improve curriculum development processes (e.g., documenting best practices, developing e-learning capabilities, revising universal sessions)
  • Design and write, or manage external contractors in the writing of, online instructor onboarding courses to familiarize instructors with curriculum materials, according to instructor(s), program and country needs, as needed
  • Independently track and report progress according to the plan
  • Facilitate communication and stakeholder management as it relates to project completion, with the Global C&I Lead (or Senior C&I Leads in select regions), contract designers, SMEs, technical vendors, employers, and/or delivery partners
  • Build collaborative relationships with stakeholders as it relates to project completion, by understanding their needs, representing the curriculum team’s needs, and responding to requests and questions
  • Support the Global C&I Lead in recruiting of contract designers, if needed
  • Provide feedback and peer-review for other team members to further develop their practice
  • Support program adoption and implementation, including launching the affiliate online customization process (support with LMS customization, local calendars, TTT, and more) and ensure on-time instructor course completion

Required Experience And Skills:

  • 3+ years curriculum development experience, for adult audiences (ages 18+), ideally with experience in vocational education / workforce skills development
  • 1-2 years experience managing curriculum development projects
  • Ideal candidate has knowledge of best practices and current trends in adult learning, and/or experience with online and blended learning programs
  • Graduate in any field with strong academic track record
  • Fluent English required, additional language proficiency highly desirable (Italian, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Thai, Hindi, Tamil most preferred)
  • Proficiency with online design, particularly with Canvas (LMS), is highly preferred.

***Please apply with your English resume, thank you***

The agency combines human expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver measurable business results, focusing on profitability, efficiency, and sustainable growth rather than vanity metrics.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly proactive and business-minded Executive Assistant / Chief of Staff to work directly with the founders and leadership team of a fast-moving digital marketing agency.

This is not a traditional administrative or scheduling position. It is a hands-on role that combines executive support, operational management, vendor oversight, process improvement, and business development.

The ideal candidate is a resourceful professional who takes ownership of responsibilities, exercises independent judgment, anticipates business needs, and makes decisions with minimal supervision.

You will oversee executive priorities, manage vendor relationships, optimize operational systems, and develop processes that improve efficiency across the organization. You will also contribute directly to revenue-generating initiatives by supporting prospect research, outbound outreach, pipeline development, and marketing activities.

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve productivity through technology.

  • Ensure operational systems support business objectives and remain organized, efficient, and scalable.

Process Design & Operational Improvement

  • Analyze existing workflows, identify operational inefficiencies, and independently develop improved processes.

  • Create, implement, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), operational playbooks, and training documentation.

  • Establish clear workflows, quality control checkpoints, and accountability standards.

  • Identify operational risks and proactively implement corrective actions within the scope of the role.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, reduce manual work, and support business growth.

Financial & Administrative Management

  • Monitor operational budgets, track expenditures, and flag potential variances.

  • Manage routine procurement decisions for software, supplies, and services within approved spending limits.

  • Maintain organized financial and administrative records.

  • Support leadership with operational reporting, expense tracking, and administrative planning.

Business Development & Revenue Support

  • Proactively contribute to revenue-generating activities when operational priorities are under control.

  • Research and qualify prospective clients, develop targeted prospect lists, and identify potential business opportunities.

  • Support outbound prospecting through personalized email campaigns, LinkedIn outreach, follow-ups, and lead nurturing.

  • Maintain accurate CRM records, track pipeline activity, and coordinate next steps with the business development team.

  • Prepare sales presentations, proposals, pitch decks, case studies, and other business development materials.

  • Coordinate go-to-market initiatives, including sales meetings, webinars, industry events, and strategic partnerships.

  • Support the agency's own marketing initiatives, including newsletters, social media, and content coordination.

  • Collaborate with leadership to identify opportunities to improve prospect engagement and accelerate the sales process.

Qualifications

Required

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in sales, business development, or marketing, including prospecting, pipeline development, outbound outreach, or campaign support.

  • Advanced English proficiency (C1 or higher), with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting senior executives or managing operational functions with minimal supervision.

  • Proven ability to independently manage vendor relationships, including negotiations, performance monitoring, and contract coordination.

  • Experience designing, documenting, implementing, and improving operational processes.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Sound business judgment, with the ability to make independent decisions and recognize when leadership involvement is necessary.

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace and experience administering business software and operational platforms.

  • Practical experience using AI tools, such as ChatGPT or Claude, to improve research, communication, sales, and operational efficiency.

  • A proactive, commercially minded approach, with the ability to identify opportunities to contribute to business growth.

  • Ability to work independently and maintain accountability in a fully remote environment.

  • Reliable high-speed internet and a professional remote workspace.

  • Full availability to work U.S. Pacific Time business hours.

Preferred

  • Previous experience working in a digital marketing agency, performance marketing company, eCommerce business, or B2B services environment.

  • Experience supporting founders, CEOs, or other C-suite executives with delegated decision-making responsibilities.

  • Hands-on experience with CRM and project management platforms such as HubSpot, Asana, Monday.com, or Notion.

  • Experience creating SOPs, operational playbooks, and process documentation from scratch.

  • Experience with sales prospecting tools, marketing automation, or AI-powered workflow automation.

  • Background in business development, lead generation, or outbound sales for agencies or professional services companies.

What Success Looks Like

  • Leadership can confidently delegate operational responsibilities, knowing that priorities are managed and commitments are consistently fulfilled.

You are an organized, resourceful, and entrepreneurial professional who enjoys operating at the intersection of executive support, business operations, and growth.

You are comfortable working directly with founders, taking responsibility for important business functions, and making thoughtful decisions independently.

You don't simply complete assigned tasks. You anticipate what needs to happen next, identify opportunities for improvement, and take action.

Most importantly, you understand that supporting leadership means creating capacity for the business to grow, whether through operational efficiency, better systems, stronger vendor relationships, or direct contributions to revenue-generating activities.

jobs.title: Regional Vice President of AI Enablement & Implementation
jobs.excerpt: Help Shape What AI Looks Like in Hospitality. AI is changing how businesses operate.
jobs.description:
Help Shape What AI Looks Like in Hospitality.

AI is changing how businesses operate. At Crescent Hotels & Resorts, we’re focused on something bigger than simply adopting new technology—we want to put AI to work solving real business problems across our hotels.

We are seeking a Regional Vice President of AI Enablement & Implementation to help turn that vision into reality.

This is an opportunity for a builder.

You’ll work alongside Crescent leaders, hotel operators, ownership partners, and functional experts to identify where AI can create meaningful value—and then help take those ideas from opportunity to solution to implementation to measurable results.

We aren’t looking for someone to simply tell us what AI could do.

We’re looking for someone who can help us make it happen.

What You’ll Build

Imagine helping create AI-enabled solutions that could:

  • Give a General Manager a daily “GM Pulse” that brings together revenue, labor, cost, guest satisfaction, and operational signals into one actionable briefing.
  • Help a sales team qualify an inbound RFP and develop a tailored group proposal in a fraction of the time.
  • Optimize hotel labor schedules against forecasted demand to reduce overtime, overstaffing, and unnecessary contract labor.
  • Automate repetitive accounting processes, reconciliations, cash-flow forecasting, and reporting.
  • Monitor F&B inventory and purchasing patterns to identify waste and over-ordering.
  • Help recruiting teams source, screen, schedule, and communicate with candidates more efficiently.
  • Turn financial, STR, guest satisfaction, revenue, and operating data into recurring ownership and investor reporting.
  • Make it easier for hotel associates and leaders to find information, make decisions, and spend less time on administrative work.

And those are just the opportunities we see today.

A major part of your role will be helping us discover what we haven’t thought of yet.

What You’ll Do

You’ll help establish and execute the AI roadmap for a designated portfolio of Crescent-managed hotels, identifying the opportunities with the greatest potential business impact.

You’ll work across Operations, Commercial, Revenue Management, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Human Resources, and Technology to understand how work gets done today—and where AI, automation, data, or process redesign can make it better.

You’ll help determine whether the right solution should be built, bought, configured, or integrated, and you’ll lead initiatives beyond the idea stage through implementation, adoption, measurement, and optimization.

You’ll partner closely with Crescent’s technology teams around systems, integrations, data, security, and governance while helping operators translate business challenges into practical AI-enabled solutions.

Most importantly, you’ll make sure the solutions we introduce actually get used.

Because successful AI transformation isn’t measured by how many pilots we launch.

It’s measured by what changes because of them.

Who We’re Looking For

You understand AI—but you think like a business leader.

You naturally start with:

“What problem are we trying to solve?”

Then you determine whether AI, automation, data, process redesign—or some combination—is the right answer.

You’re comfortable discussing strategy with executives one moment and sitting with an operator to understand a manual process the next.

You understand technologies such as generative AI, AI agents, workflow automation, APIs, data integration, and emerging AI platforms, but you don’t believe technology is the objective.

Business impact is.

You know how to build a business case, evaluate technology and vendors, lead cross-functional implementation, drive organizational adoption, and measure ROI.

Hospitality experience would be valuable, but we’re also interested in leaders who have successfully driven AI or digital transformation in other complex, multi-unit businesses.

What Success Looks Like

Your work should ultimately help Crescent and our hotels achieve measurable outcomes:

More revenue.

Better productivity.

Smarter labor deployment.

Faster decision-making.
Less administrative work.
Better guest experiences.
More empowered associates.
And demonstrable ROI from AI investments.

Why Crescent?

At Crescent Hotels & Resorts, hospitality is a people business—and we believe technology should make our people better at what they do, not take away from the human experience that defines great hospitality.

This role offers the opportunity to help shape our approach to AI at an important moment in its evolution.

You won’t be stepping into a mature AI program and maintaining someone else’s roadmap.

You’ll help build it.

If you are energized by the opportunity to turn emerging technology into practical solutions, challenge how work gets done, and help shape the future of AI in hospitality, we’d like to hear from you.

World Vision is hiring a Corporate Engagement Specialist to serve in the Transformational Engagement division.

Role: Corporate Engagement Specialist Reports To: National Director, Corporate Engagement Location: Remote within the U. S.; Federal Way, WA or Washington, DC considered for hybrid. In addition to education or education equivalent, requires at least 2 years of work experience in donor engagement, corporate engagement, account management, sales, digital engagement, campaign management, fundraising or related experience. Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S.A. for any employer. Travel: Domestic travel up to 5-10%. Estimated Salary Range: $63,600 to $85,860

THE JOB

The Corporate Engagement Specialist will grow World Vision’s ministry by planning and implementing a scalable, digitally led engagement strategy for corporate donors giving up to $1M annually. Manage a large portfolio of current and lapsed corporate partners, through coordinated digital communications, responsive donor service, campaign execution, CRM discipline and strategic interactions. Drive donor retention and reactivation to contribute to $15M+ in annual GIK and cash revenue. Identifying donors showing readiness for advancement to other tiered portfolio engagement. Help carry out our Christian organization’s mission, vision, and strategies. Personify the ministry of World Vision by witnessing to Christ and ministering to others through life, deed, word and sign.

RESPONSIBILITIES WILL INCLUDE

  • Keep Christ central in individual and corporate life. Actively participate in and contribute to the spiritual disciplines of the organization (Christian conduct, chapel, prayer, worship, devotions, and leadership of devotions); incorporate WV Core Values into decisions within scope of role.
  • Actively manage an assigned donor portfolio, consisting of corporate donors currently giving up to $1M annually, including both current and lapsed donors, with a focus on retention, reactivation, and portfolio-level revenue growth.
  • Contribute to approximately $15M in annual GIK and cash revenue from the donor portfolio by supporting repeat giving, reactivation, donor inquiries, and responsive handling of offers and opportunities.
  • Provide inbound donor management by responding to donor inquiries generated through campaigns and other digital communications; field and route GIK and cash offers, questions, and follow-up needs; coordinate internally with placement, logistics, valuation, and other teams to support donor success.

◦ Oversee campaign and system execution by heavily utilizing campaign management and CRM platforms to monitor campaign performance, including open rates, responses, inquiries, offers, and conversion indicators; flag underperforming messaging and recommend improvements to engagement approaches. ◦ Actively utilize World Vision CRM systems to accurately, consistently, and systematically plan, document, and track donor interactions, campaign responses, offers, inquiries, follow-up actions, segmentation updates, and portfolio status; maintain CRM hygiene as a core responsibility.

  • Work collaboratively with Corporate Engagement team members and cross-functional partners to align donor engagement, campaign execution, donor service, portfolio movement, and resource fulfillment with organizational strategy and field need.
  • Provide portfolio insights and triage by identifying trends in donor behavior, engagement patterns, retention risks, reactivation opportunities, and signals for donor advancement; surface insights to inform segmentation, messaging, and portfolio strategy.
  • Strategically escalate donors showing readiness for upgrade to other tiered portfolio engagement based on giving growth, increased engagement, partnership complexity, strategic importance, or other advancement signals; coordinate transitions in a way that supports donor continuity and organizational outcomes.
  • Understand and articulate World Vision's model of transformational development in order to increase donor's passion and involvement in WV’s mission through appropriate GIK, cash and other resource-generating opportunities.
  • Work collaboratively with team members when assigned to work as a member of a team.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Maintain awareness of corporate goals, objectives, organizational announcements, and activities.

YOU BRING THESE SKILLS

  • Attention to Detail: Accomplishes tasks thoroughly, showing concern for all the areas involved no matter how small, at the appropriate level for the task
  • Customer Service Orientation: Demonstrates concern for meeting customer needs in a manner that provides satisfaction for the customer using available resources.
  • Balancing Multiple Priorities: Balances the needs and interests of various stakeholders and makes decisions involving competing goals, objectives and alternatives. Prioritizes tasks and redirects work effort in response to changes in priorities.

REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience (8 years). In addition to education or education equivalent, requires at least 2 years of work experience in donor engagement, corporate engagement, account management, sales, digital engagement, campaign management, fundraising or related experience. Experience using CRM systems and digital outreach or marketing automation tools preferred.

SALARY & BENEFITS

WVUS Pay Grade Level: 222 Estimated hiring range is $63,600 to $85,860 The posted hiring salary range reflects pay for U.S. locations and is determined using market data and internal compensation guidelines. Actual compensation may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic location, job-related experience, and applicable laws. For information about World Vision U.S' comprehensive benefits package, please visit this link.

ABOUT WORLD VISION

We're a global Christian humanitarian organization. We partner with children, families, and their communities to empower them as they reach their full potential by tackling the causes of poverty and injustice. For over 75 years, World Vision has followed Jesus' example to show unconditional love to the poor and oppressed. We serve every child regardless of faith.

L.I.F.E. LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES:

The LIFE Leadership Competencies provide a shared framework for Christ-centered leadership at World Vision. They define the skills, behaviors, and character qualities that help leaders lead faithfully and effectively, shaping how we hire, develop, and evaluate leaders to cultivate thriving teams and greater Kingdom impact.

  • Love: How we show up every day, every interaction. Loving others the way Jesus loves—with humility, care, and grace-filled truth. We build trust. We model life with God. And we create environments where people feel seen, valued, and supported, because we see the image of our God in each of them.
  • Ignite: How we unlock and catalyze. To Ignite is to unlock purpose, passion, and potential—so people can bring their best in service of children and donors. We build healthy, thriving teams and develop character, competence, and courage.
  • Fulfill: How We Deliver. To Fulfill is to focus on what matters most—and deliver with excellence and accountability. We own outcomes. We prioritize mission-critical work. And we partner with God to produce results that advance Kingdom impact.
  • Envision: How we change and evolve towards ‘Better’. To Envision is to lead boldly into the future—discerning what’s ahead with faith, navigating complexity, and casting vision that leads to lasting impact.

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

Our person-centered, “whole-person care” and provider approach addresses the behavioral, physical, and social drivers that impact a member’s health and enhances the interaction between plan, enrollee, and provider. Our solutions are designed to help our customers improve quality, reduce costs, and optimize health outcomes for their population.

At InfoMC, we are extraordinarily proud of the company we're building, not to mention our continuous efforts to create a Best Place to Work culture. Our people are InfoMC's biggest competitive advantage and we'll continue to invest in our team and people-first culture.

About the role

The Clinical Business Analyst serves as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for InfoMC’s utilization management (UM) and care management (CM) applications, acting as a trusted advisor to payer clients. This role requires candidates who are a Registered Nurse (RN) or licensed healthcare professional with deep experience in payer-based UM/CM and familiarity with integrated health systems. The ideal candidate stays current on clinical trends, healthcare regulations, and Health Information Technology (HIT), including AI-driven analytics and interoperability standards (e.g., FHIR, MARS-E).   • Issue Resolution: Apply clinical and product expertise to troubleshoot and resolve client issues, ensuring high satisfaction and regulatory compliance.
  • Industry Expertise: Stay current on HIT trends, clinical practices, and regulations, particularly in UM/CM, AI applications, and compliance standards like MARS-E and FedRAMP.

o5+ years of clinical experience in payer or integrated health systems, with direct UM/CM expertise.

oRegistered Nurse (RN)/Clinical Background

jobs.excerpt: OverviewThe Personal Banking Officer in the Banker Service Center (BSC) Department supports customers, branches, Wealth Management, and digital banking channels by delivering responsive service, account support, and relationship-building assistance.
jobs.description:
Overview

The Personal Banking Officer in the Banker Service Center (BSC) Department supports customers, branches, Wealth Management, and digital banking channels by delivering responsive service, account support, and relationship-building assistance. This role reviews and supports digital banking and online account opening requests, processes account maintenance and banking transactions, resolves customer inquiries, and helps identify opportunities to meet customer needs through bank products and services.

Responsibilities

  • Support branches, Wealth Management Division, and digital banking channels with new and existing customer relationships, account opening, and account servicing.
  • Review digital banking and online account opening applications, including approval/decline decisions, documentation validation, and customer follow-up.
  • Process account maintenance and service requests, including address changes, stop payments, account closings, transfers, check orders, CD reinvestments, wire transfers, ACH requests, and related transactions.
  • Provide timely and professional assistance to customers and internal departments, including responding to online account opening inquiries and supporting the contact center email box as needed.
  • Build and maintain customer relationships by identifying needs, explaining product benefits, and cross-selling bank products and services.
  • Assign and monitor KACE tickets to ensure service requests are completed accurately and within established service level expectations.
  • Support BSC reporting, including key performance indicators, customer service trends, and process improvement recommendations.
  • Use AI-enabled tools appropriately to support customer research, case documentation, reporting, and internal communications, while reviewing outputs for accuracy, tone, and compliance.
  • Comply with all applicable operational, CIP, KYC, BSA/AML, privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.

Qualifications

Education/Experience:

Requirements

  • Two Year College Degree in Business Administration.
  • 5+ years of banking experience required, directly related to servicing customers in retail banking branch operations.
  • Experience using AI-assisted customer service tools (e.g., chat/knowledge assistants) with demonstrated ability to validate outputs, document decisions, and follow data privacy and compliance requirements.

    • Combination of education and experience will be considered.

    Skills & Competencies

  • Knowledgeable of banking laws and applicable compliance regulations such as the Bank Secrecy Act/AML and Patriot Act.
  • Knowledgeable with Fedlink, Pure Cloud, Finser and KACE applications
  • Must be able to understand and implement job related policies and procedures.
  • Experience working in a team (sales and service), and high-quality service advocacy.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to resolve problems and adjust tactics in response to changing circumstances.
  • Ability to prioritize, budget time and maintain work priorities.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule based on department needs.
  • Knowledgeable in internal bank operations (wire transfers, debits/credits and loan payments) and of banking products to cross-sell.
  • Knowledgeable on X-Pert AML applications.
  • AI tool literacy (prompting and query skills) to efficiently retrieve accurate information, summarize cases, and draft internal and customer-facing communications with appropriate human reviews.
  • Strong data handling discipline when using AI-enabled tools, including avoiding entry of sensitive customer information and following retention, confidentiality, and security guidance.
  • Ability to use AI-assisted quality checks and maintain clear, auditable case notes documenting rationale for approvals/declines and any escalations.
  • Must possess excellent organizational, analytical, interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills (English/Spanish required).
  • Computer knowledgeable in MS Software, (e.g. Excel, Word, and Outlook).

    • Preferences

    • Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration (Finance preferred) with
    • 2+ years of banking experience required, directly related to servicing customers in retail banking branch operations
    • Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 Training
    • Google AI Essentials

    Licenses/Certifications

    • None

    Job Posting Locations

    In this role you can work remote from Miami, Florida, United States

Strong organizational and management skills
Strong planning, strategizing, managing, monitoring, scheduling, and critiquing skills.
Self-motivated learning about current regulatory processes and intelligence
Excellent written and verbal communication skills to clearly and concisely present information
Proactive by identifying potential issues in the process and anticipating solutions

Easily adjusts to a changing environment; ability to prioritize adapt between detailed and strategic activities while maintaining delivery timelines and quality
Team-oriented work style; seeks and gives guidance to others
Strong interpersonal skills in a fast-paced, deadline oriented, and changing environment
Excellent ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced and changing environment

Preferred minimum of one year of previous experience within the pharmaceutical/CRO industry

jobs.description:
About Thanks

Thanks operates in what we consider the happiest place on the internet—the purchase flow. It’s the perfect moment to connect with eager and excited customers through rewards, offers, and experiences. That’s where Thanks comes in. We exist to help brands monetize their first-party data by delivering advertiser-fueled rewards that are both delightful and effective.

At Thanks, our DNA is 50% tech and 50% design—ensuring every experience we deliver is smart, intuitive, and beautiful. We’re not just building another ad placement; we’re building an advertising brand. When people see Thanks, they know it, they trust it, and they love to engage with it.

Founded in Australia, Thanks is now operating throughout Australia, the US, and the UK—and we’re just getting started. We’re scaling quickly and looking for exceptional, world-class talent to help us reshape the future of advertising.

About the role

Thanks (thanks.co) is seeking a Strategic Key Accounts Lead with 5+ years experience in partnerships and 3+ of experience in advertising or adtech to join our team and play a founding role in ensuring our strategic accounts achieve maximum value from their partnerships with us.

In this key position, you will act as the primary point of contact for our mid-market and enterprise Publishers and Advertisers. You will deeply understanding their business & goals, and deliver exceptional service to support and unlock growth.

Our ideal candidate will be very comfortable monitoring and analyzing ad performance, and working directly with Product & Engineering teams to build innovative products to drive incremental revenue. A strong understanding of Martech & CRM platforms, ie: Braze, Klaviyo etc would also be very beneficial in this role. Most importantly you are a people person.

What you'll do

  • Client Relationship Management: Develop and nurture long-term relationships with key publisher and advertiser partners, ensuring their needs are met and expectations exceeded.
  • Onboarding & Support: Lead the onboarding process for new advertisers, providing guidance on best practices and how to leverage Thanks’ platform effectively.
  • Expertise in Advertising & Performance Marketing: Demonstrated ability to source, create, monitor & optimize marketing strategies across various digital channels, making data driven decisions.
  • Performance Monitoring: Regularly analyze campaign performance and share insights with clients, using data to identify opportunities for improvement and growth.
  • Strategic Consultation: Act as a trusted advisor, recommending strategies to optimize advertisers' campaigns and achieve key performance metrics.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams, including sales, product, and marketing, to align on client initiatives and feedback, effectively relaying client insights to enhance our offerings.
  • Retention & Growth: Drive client satisfaction through QBR's and ad-hoc interactions to ensure retention, renewals, and upsell opportunities by understanding client objectives and identifying additional ways to deliver value.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of experience in client success or account management - working with enterprise clients within digital advertising or technology industries.
  • Strong understanding of online advertising concepts, metrics, and strategies, with experience managing large client accounts.
  • Proven track record of building relationships and driving client satisfaction and retention.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to analyze performance data, derive insights, and communicate recommendations effectively.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with a knack for explaining complex concepts clearly.
  • Self-motivated, with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple clients and initiatives simultaneously.
  • Experience in working collaboratively in cross-functional teams and navigating between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • 3-5 years minimum experience managing key clients in retail media, advertising, ecommerce.
  • Experience working with publishers, e-commerce platforms, or ticketing marketplaces.
  • Martech or experience with CRM platforms Ie; Braze, Klaviyo etc is highly desired.
  • Established network within the US tech and media industries.
  • Understanding of SaaS business models and customer success frameworks.
  • Experience in a high-growth startup environment.

Benefits

Why join thanks?

Joining Thanks means becoming part of a Sydney-based, global-from-day-one, well-funded startup tackling one of advertising's biggest challenges: ad fatigue. We're redefining ad experiences with industry-leading engagement that not only captivates but also delights and rewards consumers.

Here's why you'll love working with us:

  • Make an Impact: Your work will directly shape our brand, products, and trajectory as we scale.
  • Ownership Mentality: Everyone at Thanks takes responsibility for building something amazing, and we’ll give you the tools and autonomy to succeed.
  • Competitive Package: We offer a competitive salary, performance-based bonuses, and stock options to share in the company's success.
  • Fast-Paced Growth: Thrive in an environment of rapid change, constant challenges, and endless opportunities.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy a benefits package designed to support your needs and wellbeing.
  • Collaborative Environment: Work in an inclusive and creative team that values curiosity, transparency, and above all else work-life balance.

We're tackling big challenges in advertising technology by creating our own ecosystem - not copying what exists. If you're excited to innovate, influence, and grow at a rapidly scaling company, we'd love to hear from you - let’s build something extraordinary together!

About Kadince

Kadince (pronounced cadence) is a fully remote American software company founded in 2013. In a nutshell, we build tools to help financial institutions track and manage the good they do in their communities.

As our customer base grows, so does our team. We’re committed to delivering top-notch software quality and ensuring every feature release goes smoothly. To keep up with the growing demand and maintain our high standards, we’re looking for experienced Quality Assurance Engineers in Brazil who can help us scale QA efforts, maintain product integrity, and contribute to a collaborative dev environment.

Who We Want to Hire

To be a QA contractor at Kadince, you should have 5+ years of experience in software development or QA engineering. You know how to plan and execute test strategies, create and maintain robust test suites, perform root cause analysis, and communicate your findings clearly. You don’t just test software—you improve it.

You’re great at spotting issues, solving problems, and helping developers build better code. Your detail-oriented nature, curiosity, and passion for quality assurance set you apart.

Since you’ll be collaborating with our US-based development team, strong English communication skills are important. We’ll occasionally have meetings to align on progress, share feedback, or collaborate in real time.

Let’s Geek Out

If you’re geeky like our QA team (hopefully you are), you’ll probably want to know more about our stack and workflow.

Technologies & Tools

  • Frontend/Backend: Ruby on Rails, React, GraphQL, Postgres, Redis
  • Testing: Cypress, Minitest
  • DevOps: Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, CircleCI
  • Collaboration & QA Tools: Jira, Rubymine, Sentry

You’ll be using these tools to build, execute, and automate tests while helping us maintain and improve QA documentation and practices.

Our Core Values

Our values aren’t just nice words on a wall (we don’t have one). They drive how we work and who we hire:

  • Integrity – We’re honest with ourselves and others.
  • People – We understand that people are the foundation of Kadince.
  • Care – We do our best work with purpose and intention.
  • Remarkability – We provide standout experiences.
  • Growth – We accept yesterday and improve today.

Even as a contractor, you’ll be expected to uphold these values in your work and interactions.

What You’d Work On

As a QA contractor, you’ll work alongside our development and product teams on:

  • Planning, executing, and automating manual and regression tests
  • Writing test cases and acceptance criteria
  • Identifying, triaging, and tracking bugs
  • Monitoring releases using tools like Sentry and Slack
  • Collaborating on documentation and QA process improvements
  • Mentoring junior team members (as needed)

You’ll receive assignments, collaborate through Slack and Jira, and give feedback directly to your Kadince point of contact. We’re open to your ideas—your voice matters.

Flexibility

This is a fully remote contractor role with flexible hours. You’ll need to coordinate occasionally with our US-based team, but we value asynchronous work and understand time zone differences. You’ll be free to manage your schedule as long as you deliver consistent, high-quality results.

Compensation

Kadince offers competitive USD-based compensation, above typical rates in the Brazilian market. Here’s what you can expect based on your experience and skills:

If you’re excited to work with Kadince, we want to hear from you. When applying, send us:

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking an experienced Software Quality Assurance Engineer to independently execute and take expanded ownership of quality assurance and test automation activities on the BASIS program. Operating with minimal supervision, the QA Engineer carries direct responsibility for automated test design and delivery, test documentation ownership, defect lifecycle management, and security testing integration — all in support of the program's automation-first QA mandate. All quality assurance activities must be automated.

The selected candidate will independently manage test automation deliverables across Agile sprint cycles, contribute to QA strategy discussions, support junior engineers, and interface with developers and Government stakeholders on quality metrics and release readiness across the deployment pipeline.

This is a 100% remote role.

Test Automation Development & Strategy

  • Independently design, develop, implement, and maintain automated test scripts for unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end functional testing across the application portfolio.
  • Ensure all automated test cases are executable by the end of each Agile sprint and fully integrated into the Government-managed DevSecOps pipeline with minimal oversight.
  • Drive and apply Test-Driven Development (TDD) methodology — authoring test cases prior to code development and collaborating closely with software engineers to align test coverage with functional requirements.
  • Lead the Test Automation State Assessment for assigned application areas; produce assessment reports with automation completion estimates.
  • Own the automation of adjacent legacy test cases per Government-approved schedules to systematically expand regression coverage across the portfolio.
  • Evaluate automation approaches and recommend improvements to test architecture, reusability, and pipeline integration within the Government-provided automation framework.
  • Serve as a technical resource and mentor to junior QA engineers on automation best practices, test script development, and tool usage.

Test Planning & Documentation

  • Develop and own Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTMs) at the end of each development cycle/sprint, ensuring full traceability and complete testing coverage of all functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Document all test activities, execution results, and defect findings within the Government-provided Test Case Management System with accuracy and completeness.
  • Independently prepare Testing Reports, Release Notes (Draft and Final), and Software Version Descriptions (SVDs) per release cadence requirements.

Quality Assurance & Defect Management

  • Enforce and monitor hard contractual quality thresholds with zero defects released to production.
  • Lead defect triage and root cause analysis in JIRA; manage the full escalation workflow to product teams with complete documentation and submit JIRA tickets prior to all escalations.
  • Own and submit weekly defect escalation reports to customers and the Government Product Owner.

Section 508 / Accessibility Testing

  • Lead Section 508 / WCAG 2.0 Level AA accessibility testing at planned intervals throughout the development lifecycle, ensuring continuous integration of accessibility compliance into the QA process.
  • Own preparation of Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates (VPATs) including test results, remediation reports, and conformance level documentation for all applicable deliverables.
  • Report Section 508 compliance testing status and metrics.

Performance & Environment Testing

  • Lead stress and load testing activities in the ProdSim (Production Simulation) environment; prepare and submit detailed test schedules for Government approval and execute per approved schedule.
  • Coordinate and support Disaster Recovery (DR) testing activities in collaboration with technical and operations teams.
  • Support Independent Verification & Validation (IV&V) of all application prior to production deployment; ensure all IV&V findings are tracked and resolved.

Agile / DevSecOps Participation

  • Maintain sprint-level defect tracking, test case completion status, and burn-down metrics in JIRA; provide QA-focused sprint reporting to program leadership.
  • Enforce quality gates across the SDLC pipeline; flag and escalate non-conforming deliverables before stage promotion.
  • Own and submit monthly Quality Status Report (QSR).

  • Must be US CItizen

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and implementing automated test frameworks and scripts using tools such as Selenium, JUnit, TestNG, Cucumber, Python, Java, or equivalent.
  • Working knowledge of Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices and their application within Agile sprint cycles.
  • Proficiency with JIRA for defect tracking, sprint management, and reporting.
  • Experience developing Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTMs), UAT plans, and formal testing documentation.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated test integration within a DevSecOps environment.
  • Experience with Section 508 / WCAG 2.0 Level AA accessibility testing and VPAT preparation.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills; ability to report QA status and metrics to program leadership and Government stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Employment Type

  • Fully remote - any US state
  • Direct, full-time employment with Mobiz IT, Inc.
  • Third-party agency submissions are not accepted.

Role Summary

The Staff Accountant owns the recurring transactional accounting and reconciliation work that drives Mobiz’s monthly close, performed end-to-end in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. This is an ownership role, not a support role: you prepare and reconcile; you don’t just assist.

Mobiz is a global IT consulting and Microsoft licensing firm operating across multiple legal entities and currencies. Revenue and costs are tracked dimensionally — every customer is a department, every engagement is a project code — so accurate coding on every entry is essential to reliable customer and project profitability reporting.

What You’ll Own

Month-End Close and Journal Entries

  • Prepare and post the recurring close journal entries: revenue deferrals on multi-month and annual license contracts, expense accruals, prior-month accrual reversals, and prepaid amortization.
  • Prepare vendor rebate allocation entries and distribute rebate income to the correct customer departments.
  • Code every entry with the full dimension set — department, project, and site — and attach supporting documentation in Business Central before submitting.
  • Route all entries to the Controller for approval before posting; maintain the approved-entry archive in SharePoint.
  • Track close tasks against the published close calendar and flag at-risk items early. Reducing close cycle time is an explicit goal of this role.

Reconciliations

  • Reconcile operating bank accounts, corporate credit cards, brokerage accounts, and the line of credit monthly, moving toward a weekly continuous-reconciliation cadence.
  • Validate direct bank feeds into Business Central against source statement exports and resolve sync gaps.
  • Create correcting entries for unrecorded items — fees, interest, and timing differences — and clear each account to a zero difference before posting.
  • Reconcile AR and AP aging to the balance sheet, and reconcile prepaid, accrual, and deferred revenue accounts each month.

Multi-Entity and Intercompany

  • Prepare intercompany cross-charge entries between Mobiz entities on the close schedule, referencing the governing agreement in each entry description.
  • Reconcile due-to / due-from balances and resolve imbalances before period close.
  • Support foreign-currency transactions and translation at approved rates.

Cost Allocation and Customer Profitability

  • Own the monthly payroll allocation: pull time data from ServiceNow, run it through the allocation model, and reallocate wages and payroll taxes from administrative accounts to the customer departments and COGS accounts that earned them.
  • Validate that total allocated equals total payroll before submitting the entry.
  • Maintain separation of billable and non-billable cost so gross margin by customer stays accurate.

Reporting and Analysis

  • Produce monthly P&L by department and prepare variance analysis comparing the current month to the prior three months, investigating and documenting every variance above 5%.
  • Analyze gross margin by customer and surface trends and anomalies to the Controller.
  • Validate the reporting package before distribution: active client dimensions, department mappings, zero gross profit on corporate departments, and a balance sheet that nets to zero.
  • Assist with budgeting and forecasting by compiling actuals and identifying trends.

Tax and Compliance Support

  • Prepare and file sales and use tax returns; monitor economic nexus thresholds and register in new jurisdictions as they are met.
  • Assemble schedules and supporting records for the external CPA firm for federal, state, and local filings.
  • Track filing deadlines and maintain the record of submissions and advisor correspondence.
  • Provide documentation and reconciliations for audits and due diligence requests.

Controls and Continuous Improvement

  • Follow established internal controls, approval thresholds, and documentation standards without exception.
  • Document procedures and identify automation candidates in Business Central and Power Automate that remove manual steps from the close.

Business Central Requirements

Direct, hands-on experience with Dynamics 365 Business Central is required. You must have a minimum of 3 years of experience working independently in:

  • General journals, batch import of journal entries, and posting.
  • Bank Account Reconciliation and Payment Reconciliation Journals under Cash Management.
  • Dimensions and dimension values — assigning, correcting, and filtering by them.
  • Chart of accounts navigation and financial report / account schedule export to Excel.
  • Standard financial statements: trial balance, P&L, and balance sheet with dimension filters.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Minimum 4 years of progressive accounting experience, including ownership of month-end close tasks.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. GAAP, including revenue recognition for subscription and multi-period contracts, accruals, and deferrals.
  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on Dynamics 365 Business Central experience as described above.
  • Demonstrated accuracy under deadline, with the judgment to escalate rather than assume.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in IT services, consulting, software resale, or another project-based business.
  • Multi-entity, multi-currency, or intercompany accounting experience.
  • Exposure to ServiceNow, Power BI, Power Automate, or Power Query.
  • CPA candidate or actively pursuing licensure.

Success in the Role

  • 30 days — Independently reconcile assigned bank and credit card accounts and post approved recurring entries.
  • 60 days — Own payroll allocation and intercompany cross-charge entries end-to-end.
  • 90 days — Deliver monthly variance analysis with documented explanations and identify at least one opportunity to improve the close cycle.

Compensation and Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, and retirement.

Mobiz IT, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.description:
IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way: responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

Platform Engineering builds what the rest of IREN builds on. We own data engineering, automation, developer tooling, AI enablement, and product engineering, the systems that turn a fleet of data centers and GPU clusters into a platform our customers and our own teams can move quickly on. Much of it is being built now, for the first time, so there is no legacy stack to maintain and no established playbook to follow.

We are hiring senior software engineers across Platform Engineering. This is an individual contributor role. Seniority here is measured by the scope of what you own and by how much better the engineers around you get, not by how many people report to you. At this level you own the design of whole systems, including the parts that cross team boundaries and the parts you will not build yourself.

The part of the role we weight most heavily is what you do for the engineers around you. We expect you to raise the standard of the people you work with, through design review and code review that teach rather than correct, through pairing, and through handing hard problems to engineers who are ready to stretch. We look for evidence of this during the interview, and we continue to assess it after you join.

Because Platform Engineering builds for other teams, the boundaries matter as much as the internals. You will own the interfaces between your systems and everyone else's, negotiate what those contracts guarantee, and manage versioning and compatibility when something has to change. That work is as much communication as design, so we expect you to write clearly and to be comfortable in a room where people disagree. We also expect depth: senior engineers here are the person the company asks about a particular domain, whether that is data engineering, automation, developer tooling, AI enablement, or product engineering. Engineers at every level at IREN stay hands on, senior ones included.

Responsibilities

  • Own system design from end to end: the problem statement, architecture, interfaces, data model, and rollout, including the parts other engineers will build.
  • Coach and develop the engineers around you. Give review that teaches, pair on hard problems, and hand over work that stretches people rather than keeping it because you would finish it faster.
  • Own the API contracts between your systems and other teams: negotiate what they guarantee, version them, and manage the migration when they change.
  • Set technical direction for your area, and write it down so other teams can build against it without needing a meeting first.
  • Break large, ambiguous problems into work that a team can sequence, estimate, and deliver.
  • Lead delivery across team boundaries, including the coordination and follow up that this actually requires.
  • Stay hands on. Write and review code, and carry the pager for what you own.
  • Own operations for your systems: monitoring, on-call, incident response, and the follow up that stops the same incident recurring.
  • Be the person the company can ask about your domain, and make what you know available to others rather than holding it.
  • Raise the standard through the systems around the code: CI/CD, observability, testing practice, and documentation.

Requirements

  • 6 or more years of professional software engineering experience, including several years operating in production what you built.
  • A record of owning system level design rather than components alone. You have been the person accountable for how a whole system fits together.
  • Deep experience with distributed systems, including failure modes you have personally debugged rather than only read about.
  • Demonstrated coaching. Be ready to name engineers who grew because of how you worked with them, and to say what actually changed.
  • Experience owning APIs that other teams depend on, including versioning and breaking change migrations.
  • Excellent communication, particularly in writing. You can write a design document another team can act on without a meeting.
  • Depth in at least one domain relevant to this team: data engineering, automation, developer tooling, AI enablement, or product engineering.
  • Experience leading delivery across more than one team, without formal authority over the people involved.
  • Strong fundamentals, and the judgement to recognize when the simple answer is the right one.
Nice to have:
  • Experience as a formal tech lead, or in a staff level role.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, and infrastructure as code (AWS, Azure, or GCP; Kubernetes; Terraform).
  • Experience with high volume data pipelines, streaming systems, or telemetry and time series data.
  • Experience putting machine learning or LLM systems into production.
  • Experience working close to physical infrastructure, where the software must account for hardware that fails.

Benefits

At IREN, we offer a highly competitive compensation package that includes base salary, annual performance incentives, and opportunities to build long-term wealth through equity programs. These offerings are part of our broader Total Rewards package, thoughtfully designed to support your health, well-being, and long-term success.

About Oversight

Oversight is the world’s leading provider of AI-based spend management and risk mitigation solutions for large enterprises. Based in Atlanta, GA, Oversight works with many of the world’s most innovative companies and government agencies to digitally transform their spend audit and financial control processes.

Oversight’s AI-powered platform works across our customers’ financial systems to continuously monitor and analyze all spend transactions for fraud, waste, and misuse. With a consolidated, consistent view of risk across their enterprise, customers can prevent financial loss and optimize spend while strengthening the controls that improve compliance. LearnMore.

PositionOverview:

We are seeking a skilled and forward-looking ML Engineer with experience in Large Language Models (LLMs), generative AI, and agentic architectures to join our growing R&D and Applied AI team. This role is critical in helping Oversight deliver the next generation of agentic AI systems for enterprise spend management and risk controls.

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in machine learning, modern deep learning frameworks, and data pipelines, coupled with hands-on experience experimenting with LLMs, small language models (SLMs), multi-agent frameworks, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

You will work closely with AI/ML researchers, data engineers, and product teams to design, implement, and optimize models that power autonomous exception resolution, anomaly detection, and explainable insights. This is a hands-on engineering role where you will not only build and scale ML systems but also actively contribute to cutting-edge applied research in agentic AI.

Core ML/LLM Engineering

  • Contribute to the design, training, fine-tuning, and deployment of ML/LLM models for production.
  • Implement RAG pipelines using vector databases.
  • Work with frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, MCP to prototype and optimize multi-agent workflows.
  • Develop prompt engineering, optimization, and safety techniques for agentic LLM interactions.
  • Integrate memory, evidence packs, and explainability modules into agentic pipelines.
  • Work hands-on with multiple LLM ecosystems:
    • OpenAI GPT models (GPT-4, GPT-4o, fine-tuned GPTs).
    • Anthropic Claude (Claude 2/3 for reasoning and safety-aligned workflows).
    • Google Gemini (multimodal reasoning, advanced RAG integration).
    • Meta LLaMA (fine-tuned/custom models for domain-specific tasks).

Data & Infrastructure

  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to build and maintain real-time and batch data pipelines that serve ML/LLM workloads.
  • Conduct feature engineering, preprocessing, and embeddings generation for structured and unstructured data.
  • Implement model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining pipelines.
  • Leverage cloud ML platforms (AWS Sagemaker, Databricks ML) for experimentation and scaling.

Research & Applied Innovation

  • Explore and evaluate emerging LLM/SLM architectures and agent orchestration patterns.
  • Experiment with generative AI and multimodal models to extend capabilities beyond text (images, structured financial data).
  • Collaborate with R&D to prototype autonomous resolution agents, anomaly detection models, and reasoning engines.
  • Translate research prototypes into production-ready components.

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Work cross-functionally with R&D, Data Science, Product, and Engineering to deliver business-aligned AI features.
  • Participate in design reviews, architecture discussions, and model evaluations.
  • Document processes, experiments, and results effectively for knowledge sharing.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to ML engineering best practices.

Education,ExperienceandSkills

Required

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, MachineLearning, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience building and deploying ML systems.
  • Proficiency in Python and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs/SLMs (fine-tuning, prompt design, inference optimization).
  • Demonstrated experience with at least two of the following ecosystems:
    1. OpenAI GPT models (chat, assistants, fine-tuning).
    2. Anthropic Claude (safety-first AI for reasoning and summarization).
    3. Google Gemini (multimodal reasoning, enterprise-scale APIs).
    4. Meta LLaMA (open-source, fine-tuned models).
  • Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, and RAG pipelines.
  • Ability to work with structured and unstructured data at scale.
  • Knowledge of SQL and distributed data frameworks (Spark, Ray).
  • Strong understanding of ML lifecycle: data prep, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, AutoGen).
  • Knowledge of AI safety, guardrails, and explainability techniques.
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/LLM solutions in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Experience with CI/CD for ML (MLOps), monitoring, and observability.
  • Familiarity with anomaly detection, fraud/risk modeling, or behavioral analytics.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or publications in applied ML research.
